chapters.title: Chapter 4901: Attaining Dao again
paragraphs: Wh had he attained Dao?
Ling Han found this extremely strange. He had clearly advanced into the position of Great Emperor long ago, and had even become an invincible Great Emperor. Then, what was this attaining Dao about?
Return to sixth tier?

However, the fortune of heaven and earth rolled out in waves. The Nine Star Regulations materialized in front of him, clear and distinct. This could not be clearer. The fortune of heaven and earth wanted him to become the Great Emperor.
Er, did he have to lower his own status to accommodate for this?
Fine then, he would prove his identity as a Great Emperor again.
Ling Han couldn’t refuse. This was the will of heaven and earth. Even if he deliberately didn’t break through, heaven and earth wouldn’t favor a second person.
To the people of the universe, no matter what, they would have to wait for at least another ten million years, before heaven and earth would allow the birth of a new Emperor again.
Xiu, Ling Han stepped out, and entered into the galaxy. At this time, the empress, the large black dog, Brother Monkey and the others also came over.
Seeing the golden lotuses bloom beside Ling Han, they were all surprised.
Attaining Dao?
Ling Han was about to attain Dao?
However, he had clearly become an invincible Great Emperor long ago.
What the hell was this?
Everyone was speechless. Why did all kinds of strange things happen to Ling Han?

But upon further thought, it was true that Ling Han had not attained Dao in the outside world yet, and had not even participated in the battle for the fortune of the Great Emperor. He directly went to the Primitive Abyss, leaving the chance to Pu Jingtian.
Thus, it didn’t seem strange for heaven and earth to favor him now.
You see, among the Great Emperors that had not "attained Dao", who was more outstanding than Ling Han?
Furthermore, Ling Han was born in the Stone of Life, having a closer affinity to the heaven and earth, so it was only natural that he would be favoured by the heaven and earth.

"Hehe, it’s not strange for anything to happen to Little Han," the large black dog said proudly. As someone who had watched Ling Han grow step by step, the large black dog felt a great sense of accomplishment.
"Niu’s Ling Han is the strongest!" Hu Niu also said delicately.
Though the others did not speak, they had tacitly agreed on this point.
Ling Han was indeed freakish, creating who knew how many impossible feats along the way.
It was also because of this that he had become the only Great Emperor that had stepped into the first tier in this Stacked Era.
However, everyone was curious. Ling Han was clearly already an invincible Great Emperor. If the heavens allowed him to attain Dao again, would that increase his strength?
Er, a Great Emperor of the zero tier?

Or would it be adding another tier to the current level of Great Emperors? The original first tier Great Emperors would be reduced to second tier, and Ling Han would be occupying the first tier all by himself?
Boom!
In the inner world of Ling Han’s body, an intense change was taking place.

The heaven and earth in his body had long since formed, and possessed the complete four elements. Stars densely covered the universe, and vitality was exuberant. However, there were also birth, aging, sickness, and death, forming a cycle.
However, he kept feeling like there was something missing.
Only at this moment did Ling Han realize that he hadn’t constructed Regulations for his internal world.
The four elements only created a world, allowing the world to possess a model of the cycle. However, to allow a world to flourish, the support of Regulations was indispensable.
Realization dawned on him. Referring to the Nine Star Regulations in front of him, he began to add Regulations to his inner world.
Life and death, Five Elements and Lightning, Light and Darkness... after adding Regulations, Ling Han discovered that the heaven and earth in his body was more orderly.
Boom, his body connected with this heaven and earth, and the four elements surged madly, as if they wanted to drown him.
Ling Han suddenly realized that he had truly become the embodiment of heaven and earth in this moment.
Attaining Dao this time, what was proven was not cultivation, but rather the Dao of heaven and earth.
After three days, the four elements in Ling Han’s body finally stopped increasing violently. Instead, they increased and depleted, forming a balance.
He suddenly opened his eyes. Golden lotuses bloomed fiercely in the heaven and earth, and there were murmurs that could not be heard clearly, as if they were blessings.
His attaining Dao had come to an end.
"Er, should we say congratulations?" the large black dog said with a smile.
Ling Han had long since become invincible. There didn’t seem to be anything to congratulate him on this attaining of Dao.
Adding onto invincibility, wouldn’t that still be Invincibility?
Ling Han smiled, and said, "You’re the cheeky one!"
When the news spread out, all those in the world who were determined to break through to the throne all beat their chests and stamped their feet.
Heavens, just how unjust was this?

Ling Han had long since attained Dao, and was more so a Great Emperor among Great Emperors. He was revered as the Heavenly Emperor Han, but the heavens actually allowed him to attain Dao once more. What was going on here!
It could only be said that the heavens were blind.
However, everyone only dared to mumble in their hearts. Who would dare say it out loud?

By now, Ling Han had already ruled over the entire galaxy, and was undoubtedly an overlord. Everyone was living under the rules that he had set. If one dared to insult the Heavenly Emperor in public, he would definitely be chopped into mush.

The entire galaxy returned to order. After three to four generations, ruthlessness was no longer the greatest instinct that was deeply ingrained in everyone’s hearts. Everything had returned to how it had once been.
However, the silence of the Star Moon Empress and the others made Ling Han feel like there would be endless troubles in the future.

Another 200 years had passed, and the heaven and earth had welcomed a golden age of cultivation. Though it was impossible for any new Emperor to attain Dao, Saints appeared endlessly. It was very possible that this was the highest point in history.
"Boundless Great EMperor!" A loud voice reverberated in the skies above the Four Origin Planet. "Ling Han, come out and meet me!"

At this moment, the Four Origin Planet had already become the Holy Land of martial arts in the entire universe. The invincible Heavenly Emperor was overseer here, and under the Heavenly Emperor, there were also a great many Great Emperors, who all held the responsibility of maintaining order in this heaven and earth.
Thus, hearing someone actually dare to directly address Ling Han by his name, a great many people were instantly enraged, and began to rebuke him in unison.
"Who are you? How dare you directly address the Heavenly Emperor by his name!"
"This is treason!"
"Though the Heavenly Emperor is benevolent, tolerant and magnanimous, we will definitely not allow anyone to insult the Heavenly Emperor!"
"Which b@stard is it?"

Weng, a terrifying Imperial Might descended, wanting to suppress and eliminate all life on the Four Origin Planet. This could even insta-kill Great Emperors, because this was the attack of an invincible Great Emperor. Even second tier was not enough.
However, the Imperial Might had just descended, and Ling Han had already moved. With a casual press of his hand, this Imperial Might had disappeared without a trace.
"What is it?" Ling Han asked. This person was naturally the Boundless Great Emperor.
After lying low for so long, the other party had finally appeared.

"You’ve played for so long, and now that the heaven and earth has reached its most prosperous period, you can destroy it and play again, right?" The Boundless Great Emperor’s voice traveled over, yet he was nowhere to be seen.
In the eyes of the Boundless Great Emperor, whether it was the previous battles or the re-establishment of order, that was all a game.
Thus, Ling Han had already played, and now it was his turn.
In his eyes, there was no hierarchy among all living things. They were all his playthings.
The Great Emperors, Saints, Cauldron Forging Tiers, Meridian Opening Tiers and so on were all the same.
Ling Han shook his head: "Sorry, I can’t agree."

"Junior, previously, seeing that you have become our fourth companion, I gave you face and allowed you to play around for a while. However, you can’t be ungrateful and monopolize these toys," the Boundless Great Emperor said in a baleful voice.
This person was truly temperamental.
Ling Han smiled and said, "I’m the Heavenly Emperor, and I’m responsible for safeguarding the order of heaven and earth. If you disobey, I’ll erase you."
"Hahahaha, Boundless Great Emperor." The Boundless Great Emperor smirked menacingly. Xiu, a divine sword suddenly tore a rip into the Void and slashed over.

chapters.title: Chapter 4902: Battling Boundless
paragraphs: This strike was hundreds of times larger than Four Origin Planet. Not only could it shatter Four Origin Planet into pieces, but it could even sever more than half of the nearby galaxy.
How could the Boundless Emperor care?
The heavens were born because of them, and naturally, could also be destroyed because of their mood.
No matter how prosperous this world was, and no matter how it wilted, when heaven and earth collapsed to the extreme, nothing could escape that inherent fate.

Ling Han moved. He stretched out a hand and grabbed. Pa, that divine sword turned into millions and millions of shards. Then, the Void split apart, and swallowed these shards, which instantly disappeared without a trace.

"Junior, you’re so helpless, so how are you going to fight against me?" The Boundless Emperor smiled, and said, "We can create these ants with a single thought. Is there any need to care about their lives?"
"Thus, we are different," Ling Han said darkly.

"No, there is not much difference between us. When one has reached the height that we have, they would ultimately be the same type of person." The Boundless Emperor said calmly, "You have just experienced too little. When your spiritual mark has been sealed for a few Stacked Eras, you would no longer have this kind of unnecessary mercy."

"No one can say for sure what will happen in the future," Ling Han said calmly. "If you disrespect life and order, I’ll kill you! In the future, if I also disregard life, someone will naturally kill me."
"Hahahaha!" The Boundless Great Emperor laughed madly, "Junior, I am about to go crazy laughing at you. You are actually so naive?"
"We have grasped four key elements, and possess an undying and indestructible body. Who would be able to kill us?"
"You won’t be able to kill me, and even if a fifth or sixth person appears, they won’t be able to kill you either."
Ling Han smiled faintly, "Can’t be killed?"

In the past, he indeed wouldn’t have been able to kill an invincible Great Emperor. However, now that he had achieved dao again, his strength had increased by who knew how many times. He was now confident that he could send an invincible Great Emperor into his heaven and earth.
In his heaven and earth, he was the only ruler, and his words were law.
"Junior, come and stop me!" The Boundless Great Emperor laughed loudly. He began to attack. Xiu, xiu, xiu! Multiple divine swords slashed out, slashing towards every corner of the universe.
Being strong to this extent, he really could destroy the whole universe with a single thought.
However, Ling Han was even stronger than him. He stretched out a hand and pressed down, and all the divine swords shattered, unable to cause the slightest bit of damage.
"Hmm?" A hint of surprise appeared on the Boundless Great Emperor’s face.

When one had reached their height, there was actually no longer any difference in strength. They were all invincible beings. At most, there would be some difference in proficiency in grasping the four key elements. It would indeed affect battle prowess, but it was definitely impossible to decide the outcome of a battle.
However, Ling Han casually erased his attack, causing him to feel shocked.
He could not do it!
He wasn’t the only one who couldn’t do it. The Star Moon Empress and the Mysterious Clouds Great Emperor couldn’t do it either.
This attacker could do as he liked, but the defender had too many considerations. Furthermore, defending would always be a step slower.
With the strength of their battle prowess, could they afford such a step?
Thus, he was astonished that Ling Han had so easily blocked his attack.

"I am coming to find you!" Ling Han said softly. He took a step forward, and four ribbons of great dao spread out into the boundless distance. In a flash, he had arrived in front of a massive sun in a single step.
"Are you going to come out on your own, or should I beat you out?"
As his words fell, a figure walked out of the sun. The raging flames couldn’t even burn the corner of his clothes.
"Junior, you’re really strange!" the Boundless Great Emperor said. He pondered for a moment, before continuing, "A few years ago, the person who became a Great Emperor was you, right?"
Previously?
It had been tens of thousands of years, all right?
However, he was easily suppressed for one or two Stacked Eras, so tens of thousands of years was indeed nothing. It was more or less as long as the blink of an eye for him.
This was an insignificant detail.
"That’s right." Ling Han nodded.
"Strange, how can you attain Dao twice?" The Boundless Emperor was extremely confused. Although he had invincible power, there was no way for the heaven and earth to allow him to attain Dao again.
"Because I’m strong!" Ling Han said calmly.

"What an idiotic answer." The Boundless Great Emperor shook his head, and stopped thinking about this problem. In any case, he was already invincible, and could not make any further progress in cultivation.
"You want to battle with me?" he asked.
Ling Han shook his head and said, "I will be the one to suppress you."
"Hahaha!" The Boundless Great Emperor laughed in spite of himself.
"This isn’t funny at all," Ling Han said seriously.
The Boundless Great Emperor slowly withdrew his smile, and said, "You’re really not a likable person!"
"Same to you," Ling Han said.
"I have also witnessed your battle with Mysterious Clouds." The Boundless Great Emperor continued, "You do indeed have a slight advantage, but it is still impossible for you to suppress us."
Ling Han sighed, "Are you fighting or not? Don’t just keep spouting nonsense. This will make the spectators think that we are wasting time."
At a very far location, the Great Emperors were indeed watching the battle, but they did not dare to approach.
In a clash between invincible Great Emperors, even ordinary Great Emperors could not stand close enough to watch the battle. Otherwise, that would only be courting death.

The Boundless Great Emperor humphed, and said, "Your mouth is truly restless. However, when all that’s left is your soul imprint, you won’t be able to speak at all. It won’t be long before you go crazy."
Ling Han did not speak further. He stretched out a hand towards the Boundless Great Emperor. Boom, his hand blotted out the skies.
"How dare you!" The Boundless Great Emperor sneered. ’You’re underestimating me far too much.’
He moved. Shua, a silvery river slashed over.
Peng!
The silver river crashed into the giant hand, yet it directly crumbled. It was unable to affect Ling Han in the slightest, and the giant hand was still pressing down.

The Boundless Great Emperor frowned upon seeing this. He had already known that Ling Han’s battle prowess was slightly powerful. However, after exchanging blows, he finally understood just how powerful Ling Han was.
How was this possible!
They were clearly both Great Emperors, and even if there was a gap, it was only in terms of proficiency in using the four elements, but in terms of level, they should be equal.

—At the time, it was the same when this brat battled against Mysterious Clouds. At the beginning, he was at a disadvantage because he was not proficient enough, but once he became familiar with it, he exploded with battle prowess that surpassed Mysterious Clouds.
What was going on here?

Ling Han’s palm slammed down, instantly sending the Boundless Great Emperor flying. Peng, peng, peng! The Boundless Great Emperor shattered over a hundred planets along the way, and the living beings on them were naturally all killed.
Ling Han was aloof.
Once he made up his mind, he would be decisive and resolute, and would not have any reservations.

To suppress an invincible Great Emperor, there would definitely be sacrifices. It was impossible that he would continue to leave them be just because of various concerns. That would only cause even greater damage.
"Young, junior!" The Boundless Great Emperor immediately charged back. His face was filled with rage. Ever since he had become an invincible Great Emperor, he had never suffered like this before.
"Humph!" Ling Han remained silent, and continued to attack.
Hong! Hong! Hong!
Hundreds of iron fists that had four elements wrapped around them immediately materialized above the Boundless Great Emperor’s head and slammed down at him.

The silver river crashed into the giant hand, yet it directly crumbled.
It was unable to affect Ling Han in the slightest, and the giant hand was still pressing down.
The Boundless Great Emperor frowned upon seeing this.
He had already known that Ling Han’s battle prowess was slightly powerful.
However, after exchanging blows, he finally understood just how powerful Ling Han was.
How was this possible!
They were clearly both Great Emperors, and even if there was a gap, it was only in terms of proficiency in using the four elements, but in terms of level, they should be equal.
—At the time, it was the same when this brat battled against Mysterious Clouds.
At the beginning, he was at a disadvantage because he was not proficient enough, but once he became familiar with it, he exploded with battle prowess that surpassed Mysterious Clouds.
What was going on here?
Ling Han’s palm slammed down, instantly sending the Boundless Great Emperor flying.
Peng, peng, peng!
The Boundless Great Emperor shattered over a hundred planets along the way, and the living beings on them were naturally all killed.
Ling Han was aloof.
Once he made up his mind, he would be decisive and resolute, and would not have any reservations.
To suppress an invincible Great Emperor, there would definitely be sacrifices.
It was impossible that he would continue to leave them be just because of various concerns.
That would only cause even greater damage.
"Young, junior!" The Boundless Great Emperor immediately charged back.
His face was filled with rage.
Ever since he had become an invincible Great Emperor, he had never suffered like this before.
"Humph!" Ling Han remained silent, and continued to attack.
Hong!
Hong!
Hong!
Hundreds of iron fists that had four elements wrapped around them immediately materialized above the Boundless Great Emperor’s head and slammed down at him.

chapters.title: Chapter 4903: My heaven and earth
paragraphs: The Boundless Great Emperor’s expression finally changed slightly.
That was because the four fundamental elements wrapped around these fists were a hundred times more powerful than him!
How was this possible?

Even for an invincible Great Emperor, there was still a limit to how far he could draw on the four elements. However, the volume of each punch from Ling Han exceeded the limit by a hundred times, and he could deliver several hundred punches in a single go. What kind of concept was that?
He did not dare to parry, fearing that he would be directly blasted into a state of severe injury. Though severe injury was nothing to him, as an elite, this was an instinctive reaction.
He rapidly retreated, but Ling Han had shot out too many fists, so he was still hit by a few fists head-on, instantly causing him to bleed madly.
’Holy f*ck! It hurts!’
The Boundless Great Emperor gritted his teeth, but there was actually a hint of enjoyment on his face.
This was pain, a real feeling. He had not experienced it for a very, very long time.
However, the element of life channelled on its own, and quickly healed the severely injured areas, as if nothing had happened.
This was the freakish trait of an invincible Great Emperor. He couldn’t be killed at all, not even severely wounded.

"Gagaga, junior, you are indeed very strange. However, we are all undying and indestructible beings, so no matter how strong you are, so what?" The Boundless Great Emperor laughed. Though he was mocking Ling Han, there was a sliver of defiance in his words.
When he had become an invincible Great Emperor, it was who knew how much earlier than Ling Han. Yet now, Ling Han had surpassed him in terms of battle prowess.
How could he accept this?
Ling Han ignored him, and merely shot out another punch.
Boom! Another barrage of iron fists rained down. Each punch could kill thousands of Great Emperors, yet right now, they were only targeting one.
The Boundless Great Emperor blocked these attacks, yet he was still struck a few times. Although he immediately healed, this still caused him to yell in anger.
This was an indescribable fury.
Compared to Ling Han, he was a senior, but now, the senior was being beaten down on. What face would he have left?
However, no matter what he did, he was still no match for Ling Han.
In terms of quantity of the four elements, he was really, really too far behind Ling Han. He was completely unable to face him head-on.
He did not dare believe it, and was unwilling to accept it, but the truth was so. He had been suppressed all this while, and with every attack that landed on him, he would be severely injured.
Moreover, what was even more terrifying was the fact that he was sustaining more and more punches.

What did this mean? Ling Han was familiarizing himself with this kind of battle technique, and also had a comprehensive grasp of his battle style. Only then would he be more targeted, making his attacks even more destructive.
Peng, peng, peng! Iron fists rained down.

The nearby galaxy had already been completely turned into smithereens. Countless living beings had died, but Ling Han’s expression was cold. When it was time to make a decision, he would definitely not show mercy.
The Boundless Great Emperor deliberately fled, guiding Ling Han to another galaxy. He wanted to use this to make Ling Han wary.
However, if he stopped now, it would be equivalent to those people who had died previously dying for nothing.
Ling Han didn’t show any mercy at all, and his iron fists continued to attack madly.

Five punches, ten punches, 20 punches. The Boundless Great Emperor suffered more and more punches at the same time, and his injuries also became heavier and heavier. Even if there was the element of life that could heal him immediately, this time of recovery was still being extended.
Of course, even if it was extended, it would only be a negligible instant.
Ling Han grabbed this instant, allowing him to draw the other into the heaven and earth of his inner world.
He didn’t act rashly, as he didn’t want to alert the Boundless Great Emperor. Otherwise, if this old b@stard battled to the death, he might destroy the entire universe.

Now, he still had some sense of propriety, because for him, the prosperous age that he had painstakingly created was the beginning of a good game. It had not even been played, and it had already ended. He would feel that it was a pity.

30 punches, 50 punches... The Boundless Great Emperor was severely wounded, and the surrounding galaxies were all filled with blood that he spat out. Each drop of blood possessed a terrifying destructive power, or a copious amount of the elements of life and creation.
It was about time.

Ling Han’s eyes suddenly turned cold. He unleashed his full power, and after severely wounding the Boundless Emperor with a single strike, he attempted to draw him into the heaven and earth of his Inner world.

The Boundless Great Emperor instinctively resisted this pulling force. However, he was severely injured, and this was the time when his abilities were at their weakest. Furthermore, a large amount of element of life was presently healing him, so he couldn’t free himself to engage in a full-scale resistance.
Xiu! Ling Han drew him into the heaven and earth of his inner world.
In just an instant, the Boundless Great Emperor’s wounds had already healed.
His chance had passed just like that.
This was the power of Great Emperors!
However, since he had entered into his inner heaven and earth, everything would be up to Ling Han to decide.
"What is this place?" The Boundless Great Emperor was also astonished. He quickly discovered that this was also a colossal world, yet it wasn’t the heaven and earth that he was familiar with.
In fact, an expression of shock appeared on his face. His communication with the four elements had actually been cut off!
How was this possible!

The invincibility and indestructibility of the first tier was built on communicating with the four elements. Without the replenishment of the four elements, how much stronger could he be than an ordinary Great Emperor?
Though there was no problem of lifespan, as he had grasped the four fundamental elements, and was no longer under the control of the heaven and earth, this feeling of anxiety could not be dismissed.
"This is my world." Ling Han appeared, but he was in the form of a soul.
The Boundless Great Emperorr’s eyes turned, and he immediately came to a realization. "You actually constructed your own heaven and earth!"
This was too inconceivable.
In fact, it wasn’t that he, the Star Moon Empress, and the Mysterious Clouds Great Emperor hadn’t tried this before. However, they were completely unable to do so.
Even an invincible Great Emperor like them could not do it, so there was naturally no one else in this world that could.
However, Ling Han gave him a "surprise".
"How did you do it?" the Boundless Great Emperor asked in a solemn voice.
Ling Han smiled and said, "Firstly, you have to be born from the Stone of Life."
He kindly told him about the Genesis World.
After hearing this, the Boundless Great Emperor frowned deeply, and a pensive expression appeared on his face.
After a long while, he shook his head and said, "Even if you were born from the Stone of Life, this is still an impossible feat. Absolutely impossible!"
With his understanding of the heaven and earth, he was sure that this was an impossible feat.
Because they had done similar experiments many times.
Ling Han didn’t care what he thought. He simply smiled faintly, and said, "Alright, can you die now?
The Boundless Great Emperor pondered for a moment, and didn’t reprimand Ling Han for boasting shamelessly. After all, Ling Han was genuinely capable of killing him right now.
This was already another heaven and earth, and Ling Han was the overlord of this heaven and earth.

However, he was also confident that there were still some of the four elements in his body. He still possessed the power to destroy the heaven and earth, and was completely capable of breaking through the heaven and earth and returning to his original great world.
With this in mind, his confidence increased a hundredfold.
No matter how strong Ling Han was, he definitely could not compare to a great world.
"Junior, you are indeed a lucky person, but to kill me, don’t even think about it!" He shouted loudly, and shot out a punch, forcibly tearing a rip into space.
However, though there were ripples in the space, it was not damaged at all.

chapters.title: Chapter 4904: Killed
paragraphs: The Boundless Great Emperor didn’t believe it, and he continued to attack. However, the result was the same. There were only ripples in space, yet there were no signs of it breaking apart at all.
This time, he was finally panicking.
In the endless years, this was the first time that he had felt this kind of emotion.
This refreshed him, and he reminisced for a moment. However, he was immediately enveloped by fear.
Ling Han’s inner heaven and earth was sturdier than he had imagined.
Could it be that it was actually comparable to the heaven and earth of the outside world?
Hiss!
He couldn’t help but think that Ling Han could easily wound him. This kind of strength was abnormal in the first place.
An invincible Great Emperor was just like them.
As for Ling Han... he was already a different heaven and earth.

It had to be admitted that this was the ultimate direction of the evolution of life. Everyone could form their own heaven and earth, and even if the heaven and earth outside collapsed, they would not be afraid. They themselves would be able to stand against it.
Would he die?
The Boundless Great Emperor’s mind was filled with thoughts. When he had first been trapped, he had once thought of death.

As a Great Emperor, they were naturally all heroes of their generation. Moreover, he had forged an invincible body, and there were only a mere four people among the dozens of Stacked Eras, which showed how outstanding he was.
However, he could not commit suicide. When he was trapped, this was an indescribable grief.
As time passed, he no longer wanted to die, and his ideas also became radical and ruthless.
If one wanted to die but couldn’t, they would definitely become crazy.
However, now that it was time to truly face death, fear rose up in the Boundless Great Emperor’s heart.

"Break!" He increased the power of his attack and fired out all his remaining stores of the four elements. If he couldn’t open an opening as soon as possible, he would be trapped here. Even if Ling Han didn’t kill him, he would still be trapped for several Stacked Eras, or even dozens or even hundreds of Stacked Eras like how he had been suppressed by heaven and earth before.
However, no matter how much havoc he wreaked, it was useless.
This was Ling Han’s inner heaven and earth, and now his inner heaven and earth was no longer inferior to the outer world’s heaven and earth.
Could the Boundless Great Emperor be capable of forcibly tearing apart the heaven and earth of the outside world, and venture into an unknown territory?
No.
Since that was the case, it was naturally impossible for him to tear open Ling Han’s inner heaven and earth. Furthermore, Ling Han’s inner heaven and earth was channeled by his will.
"Are you done yet?" Ling Han asked calmly. "The era that belongs to you has already ended, so it’s time for you to accept your fate."
"No!" the Boundless Great Emperor roared in fury. "I’m an invincible being! No one in the world can kill me!"
"Since that’s the case, I’ll allow you to completely awaken from your dream." Ling Han moved, and shot out a punch at the Boundless Emperor.
The Boundless Great Emperor wanted to dodge, but this heaven and earth puppet represented Ling Han’s will, so how could he dodge?
This punch directly landed in front of him, without any reason, ignoring distance.
In my world, I am naturally the one in charge.
Peng!
The Boundless Great Emperor spat out blood like mad. This time, though his injuries were still healing on their own, the speed was extremely slow.
—There was not much element of life left in his body.
Ling Han threw another punch. Pu! The Boundless Great Emperor spat out blood madly again, and he felt as if his organs were all over the place.
"Impossible! Impossible!" He was still exclaiming in shock, "How could you possibly construct an inner heaven and earth? This is absolutely impossible!"
Ling Han shook his head. Things had already come to this, and he was still unwilling to face reality?
"Goodbye!" he said softly, and delivered another punch with his iron fists.
Peng! Peng! Peng!
After a dozen over punches, the Boundless Great Emperor broke bones and shattered flesh.

The essence of life had already been exhausted, and he could no longer heal himself in an instant. However, the strength of a Great Emperor was still present, and he was still recovering with great difficulty.

Ling Han also gritted his teeth. First tier Great Emperors were truly difficult to kill. Even second tier Great Emperors would be blasted into smithereens with a single strike from him. However, just how many times had he attacked?
And this was still within the heaven and earth of his inner world. Otherwise, in the outside world, if the vitality was not exhausted, a first tier Great Emperor could not be killed at all.
Hong! Hong! Hong!
Ling Han attacked continuously, and finally, the Boundless Great Emperor couldn’t hold on any longer. His life force began to rapidly decline.

Great Emperors all had their pride, and the Boundless Emperor naturally had his pride as well. He no longer defended passively, nor did he tear open space. Instead, he launched a counterattack at Ling Han.
This was a futile attempt, but even if a Great Emperor died, he would die with honour.
After several hundred attacks, the Boundless Great Emperor finally stumbled back. His body was covered with wounds, and his vitality had already been severed.

"This day... has finally come!" A relieved smile appeared on the Boundless Great Emperor’s face. Being undying and indestructible was also a kind of curse for him, and now that he had finally cast off the curse, it was naturally a form of relief for him.
As his words fell, his life force had completely disappeared, but his body was still standing upright.
Ling Han sighed. After all, he was a Great Emperor, so he still had the grace that he should have.

With a swipe of his hand, the spiritual mark of the Boundless Great Emperor was also completely shattered. Even if the corpse was placed in the heaven and earth outside, it could not possibly be revived.
Ling Han’s divine sense returned. He sighed softly. The death of an invincible Great Emperor made him feel that it was a pity.
"Ling Han!" The large black dog and the others all gathered around him. It was clear that Ling Han had already slain the Boundless Emperor. They were all numb with excitement.
Even an invincible Great Emperor had been killed, so just how powerful was Ling Han?
Unfortunately, it was unknown where the Mysterious Clouds Great Emperor was cultivating in seclusion, and the Star Moon Empress had disappeared without a trace a very, very long time ago.
They could only wait.
Ling Han guarded the Four Origin Planet, and the world’s martial arts order was well-organized.
Since that was the case, Ling Han no longer interfered in worldly matters. Like the other Great Emperors, he entered into a state of complete seclusion.

He still had two missions, and that was to suppress the Mysterious Clouds Great Emperor and Star Moon Empress. However, if these two people were determined to hide, then even Ling Han wouldn’t be able to find them—unless he waited until heaven and earth collapsed to a point.
Thus, Ling Han was waiting.
One million years, two hundred years... ten million years.
Time passed quietly, and Ling Han’s legend slowly became a legend. As for legends? Naturally, people would think that they were exaggerated and had been superimposed.

Meanwhile, the lifespan of Great Emperors was only 10 million years. Because Ling Han hadn’t appeared for too long, people were gradually beginning to think that the once-invincible Heavenly Emperor Han had already died.
Of course, not everyone thought so, causing a great many ambitious people to cower, not daring to act rashly.
In the blink of an eye, another ten million years had passed.
A sign appeared in heaven and earth, allowing a new Great Emperor to attain dao.
This time, everyone was sure that Ling Han had definitely died.
If the old Emperor didn’t die, how could a new Emperor be born?
The heaven and earth welcomed another golden age of cultivation. Geniuses appeared in large numbers, and everyone was engaged in a fierce contest for the position of the new Emperor.
Three thousand years later, a prodigy rose above the masses, and became the Great Emperor. He was respectfully addressed by the world as "Shatter Wind Great Emperor".

The heaven and earth had once again entered into an era where the Great Emperor was standing guard. Everything was in order, and the name of Heavenly Emperor Han was no longer mentioned. Everyone only knew that the current ruler of the universe was the Shatter Wind Great Emperor.
Another 4000 years passed in this manner. Boom, suddenly, an astonishing fluctuation erupted in the universe.
"Ling Han, let’s battle again!" A booming voice reverberated through the universe.
The Mysterious Clouds Great Emperor appeared!

Being undying and indestructible was also a kind of curse for him, and now that he had finally cast off the curse, it was naturally a form of relief for him.
As his words fell, his life force had completely disappeared, but his body was still standing upright.
Ling Han sighed.
After all, he was a Great Emperor, so he still had the grace that he should have.
With a swipe of his hand, the spiritual mark of the Boundless Great Emperor was also completely shattered.
Even if the corpse was placed in the heaven and earth outside, it could not possibly be revived.
Ling Han’s divine sense returned.
He sighed softly.
The death of an invincible Great Emperor made him feel that it was a pity.
"Ling Han!" The large black dog and the others all gathered around him.
It was clear that Ling Han had already slain the Boundless Emperor.
They were all numb with excitement.
Even an invincible Great Emperor had been killed, so just how powerful was Ling Han?
Unfortunately, it was unknown where the Mysterious Clouds Great Emperor was cultivating in seclusion, and the Star Moon Empress had disappeared without a trace a very, very long time ago.
They could only wait.
Ling Han guarded the Four Origin Planet, and the world’s martial arts order was well-organized.
Since that was the case, Ling Han no longer interfered in worldly matters.
Like the other Great Emperors, he entered into a state of complete seclusion.
He still had two missions, and that was to suppress the Mysterious Clouds Great Emperor and Star Moon Empress.
However, if these two people were determined to hide, then even Ling Han wouldn’t be able to find them—unless he waited until heaven and earth collapsed to a point.
Thus, Ling Han was waiting.
One million years, two hundred years... ten million years.
Time passed quietly, and Ling Han’s legend slowly became a legend.
As for legends?
Naturally, people would think that they were exaggerated and had been superimposed.
Meanwhile, the lifespan of Great Emperors was only 10 million years.
Because Ling Han hadn’t appeared for too long, people were gradually beginning to think that the once-invincible Heavenly Emperor Han had already died.
Of course, not everyone thought so, causing a great many ambitious people to cower, not daring to act rashly.
In the blink of an eye, another ten million years had passed.
A sign appeared in heaven and earth, allowing a new Great Emperor to attain dao.
This time, everyone was sure that Ling Han had definitely died.
If the old Emperor didn’t die, how could a new Emperor be born?
The heaven and earth welcomed another golden age of cultivation.
Geniuses appeared in large numbers, and everyone was engaged in a fierce contest for the position of the new Emperor.
Three thousand years later, a prodigy rose above the masses, and became the Great Emperor.
He was respectfully addressed by the world as "Shatter Wind Great Emperor".
The heaven and earth had once again entered into an era where the Great Emperor was standing guard.
Everything was in order, and the name of Heavenly Emperor Han was no longer mentioned.
Everyone only knew that the current ruler of the universe was the Shatter Wind Great Emperor.
Another 4000 years passed in this manner.
Boom, suddenly, an astonishing fluctuation erupted in the universe.
"Ling Han, let’s battle again!" A booming voice reverberated through the universe.
The Mysterious Clouds Great Emperor appeared!

chapters.title: Chapter 4905 The Mysterious Clouds Great Emperor comes out of seclusion
paragraphs: The Mysterious Clouds Great Emperor had cultivated in seclusion for over 20 million years, and he had finally emerged.

Boom! He was an invincible Great Emperor, and he didn't possess the benevolence for all life in the world at all. With this shout, boundless ripples appeared in soundwaves. Wherever he passed, planets would explode, and the living beings on them would naturally be crushed into pieces.
What was going on?
The Saint in the distance wanted to run over and take a look, but after taking a look at the Mysterious Clouds Great Emperor, his body exploded, and he was instantly killed.
The terror of a first tier Great Emperor was inconceivable.
"Ling Han, come out for a battle!" The Mysterious Clouds Great Emperor shouted again. Boom! Another soundwave surged out, rushing in all directions.
Peng, peng, peng! Countless planets were naturally struck with great misfortune, exploding from the shockwaves.
Moreover, this was something that the Mysterious Clouds Great Emperor hadn't done deliberately. If he had wanted to, he could have obliterated the entire galaxy in a matter of minutes.
Very far away, the Saints were all watching, not daring to approach at all.
They were all numb with shock. How had such a demonic god-like existence appeared?
This was far too terrifying. He had only unleashed a roar, yet planets had already exploded into smithereens. When the Saint approached... the Saint's body had also exploded into smithereens.
Such might, this was the might of a Great Emperor!
However, shouldn't there be only one Great Emperor? Shouldn't there only be one in each era?

Only in the ancient times, as well as the era of the last Great Emperor, did the situation of multiple Great Emperors standing side by side appear, but as the era came to an end, this kind of situation was gone forever.
However, they had now discovered the existence of what they suspected to be a Great Emperor.
"Who is this guy?" a Saint muttered softly.
"It should be a Pseudo-Emperor, right?"
"Probably."
"He has a grudge against that Ling Han, so he went into seclusion to cultivate, and rushed up to the position of Pseudo-Emperor. Now, he is going to seek out this Ling Han for revenge."
"In that case, this Ling Han should be a Saint."
"Is there such a Saint?"
"I can't remember."
"It's normal that you can't remember. After all, the majority of Saints use titles, and very rarely use their names."
"That's right."
"However, why do I feel like the name Ling Han sounds a bit similar?"
"Yi, so do I!"

All the Saints nodded, but now that a Pseudo-Emperor had appeared, that had far surpassed the level that they could deal with. They could only watch the excitement from the sidelines. Furthermore, they could not get too close, or they would die without even knowing how they had died.
Fortunately, there was a Great Emperor in this era. If a Pseudo-Emperor wanted to commit evil, there was naturally a Great Emperor to kill them.
Xiu, right at this moment, a golden path spread out, and then a lanky man walked over.
Her face was as beautiful as jade, and his aura was astonishing.
The current Great Emperor, Shatter Wind!

"En?" The Shatter Winds Great Emperor frowned slightly as he looked at this burly and majestic man in front of him. As a Great Emperor, he could clearly sense that there was the fluctuation of Imperial Might emanating from this man.
But the problem was that the era of Great Emperors coexisting together had long since passed. He was presently the only Great Emperor in this era, so how could another Great Emperor appear?
"Who are you?" the Shatter Winds Great Emperor asked calmly. As a symbol of invincibility, he was naturally calm.
"Junior, are you seeking death?" the Mysterious Clouds Great Emperor said in a baleful voice. He didn't differentiate between good and evil, and everything depended on his mood.
The Shatter Wind Great Emperor couldn't help but laugh loudly, "I am the Great—"
Peng!
He had not even finished his words, when his whole person had already been sent flying.
"Noisy!" The Mysterious Clouds Great Emperor withdrew his hand, as if he had only done something negligible.
'Holy f*ck!'
The Saints in the distance all felt their hair stand on end upon seeing this. They were about to go crazy.
That was the Great Emperor, who had just attained Dao 4,000 years ago. Now, he was at the peak of his life, and his battle prowess was naturally at the peak as well.
However, it was precisely this invincible existence that had been sent flying with a single slap.
Everyone could clearly see that there was still Imperial Blood left behind in the galaxy.
Heavens! Not only had he been sent flying, but he had even severely wounded the Shatter Wind Great Emperor!
How could they not tremble in fear?
This, this, this, what kind of terrifying existence was this?
"Sigh!" A sigh rang out, as if it was far away, yet at the same time, seemed to be right next to one's ear.
All the Saints were confused, when they suddenly saw a figure appear. This was a young man that looked to be in his twenties, and he was holding a heavily injured man in his hand.
The person who had been wounded was none other than the Shatter Wind Great Emperor!
Yi, who was this young man? He actually just happened to catch hold of the Shatter Wind Great Emperor who had been sent flying.
"Ling Han, you've finally appeared!" the Mysterious Clouds Great Emperor shouted.
Ling Han smiled faintly, and the essence of life surged out, instantly flowing all over the Shatter Wind Great Emperor's body. Instantly, the injuries on this Great Emperor's body all disappeared.
"Wu!" The Shatter Wind Great Emperor woke up, and couldn't help but look shocked.
What was going on here? He, a dignified Great Emperor, was actually sent flying with a single strike, and had even sustained a serious injury!
How was this possible?
He was the only Great Emperor in the world. He was synonymous with invincibility, so why had he received such a harsh attack?
Moreover, hadn't he been severely injured? How had he suddenly recovered?
He turned his gaze to Ling Han, and once again, a puzzled expression appeared on his face.
This, this was another Great Emperor!
F***, what the hell was this?
He didn't dare to believe this. Shouldn't he be the only Great Emperor in the world? Why had another two appeared? Furthermore, one of them was overwhelmingly powerful.
Ling Han withdrew his hand, and looked at the Mysterious Clouds Great Emperor. "You should have continued to cultivate in seclusion."
"Hahahaha!" The Mysterious Clouds Great Emperor laughed loudly. "What is it? Are you threatening me?"
Ling Han smiled faintly, "I'm just telling the truth."
"Come, let's battle again!" The Mysterious Clouds Great Emperor's fighting spirit soared as he said this. Boom! His aura was indescribably terrifying.
The Shatter Wind Great Emperor instantly felt suffocated. He couldn't help but widen his eyes in disbelief.
He, a dignified Great Emperor, actually couldn't even block the aura of others?
Heavens, how could he accept this!
Ling Han waved his hand, sending the Shatter Winds Great Emperor into the distance. Then, he looked at the Mysterious Clouds Great Emperor, saying, "Let's go to the Primitive Abyss to battle again!"
"I don't have the time!" the Mysterious Clouds Great Emperor roared as he charged at Ling Han.
Boom, a punch landed. The fist hadn't even reached him, but due to the shockwave of power, all the stars in the distance exploded.

"Greetings, Great Emperor!" All the Saints hurriedly paid their respects to the Shatter Wind Great Emperor. Even if this Great Emperor had suddenly become much lower in status, he was still a lofty Great Emperor. How could they underestimate him?
However, the Shatter Wind Great Emperor was in no mood to pay any heed to this. He looked ahead, and an expression of shock and disbelief spread across his face.
How could there be such a powerful Great Emperor?
No, it should be said that how could a Great Emperor be as strong as this?
He was also a Great Emperor, but in front of these two, he was like a baby, completely unworthy of mentioning.

His eyes widened, as he carved the battle between the two invincible Great Emperors in his mind. He swore that after this battle, he would definitely cultivate in seclusion for a long time, and improve his strength.
"Ling Han, Ling Han, Ling Han... Ah, I remember now!" A Saint suddenly slapped his thigh, an excited expression on his face. He felt his scalp go numb.

chapters.title: Chapter 4906 Reappearance of the legend
paragraphs: "What have you thought of?" the Saints hurriedly asked. Even the Shatter Wind Great Emperor showed a hint of interest.
He also wanted to know the origins of these two Great Emperors, who were so powerful that even he was trembling.
"Ling Han, Heavenly Emperor Han!" the Saint from before spoke word by word.
When they heard the words 'Heavenly Emperor Han', the Saints immediately came to their senses.
"Heavenly Emperor Han!" They all looked captivated.

The Heavenly Emperor Han was the Great Emperor of the previous era, and was also a symbol of invincibility. It was rumored that he had quelled the greatest darkness in history, and was also the leader of all the Great Emperors, leaving behind a longstanding legend.
Of course, many stories were thought to be exaggerated by later generations, but this did not hinder the greatness that the Heavenly Emperor Han possessed in everyone's hearts.
However, what everyone was more familiar with was the Heavenly Emperor Han. On the other hand, Ling Han's name was rarely mentioned.
That was because whoever mentioned the Heavenly Emperor Han would speak of him with great respect, so how would they dare to mention his name?
And now, the legend of the Heavenly Emperor Han was still known to everyone. However, Ling Han's name had disappeared in the long passage of history.
This was normal. Just like in the last era, when everyone knew about the Four Directions Great Emperor, how many people would know the actual name of this Great Emperor?
It was the same even for Ling Han. What would be more memorable about the Great Emperor was his title.
Heavenly Emperor Han!
All the Saints murmured, showing expressions of admiration.
Heavens, they had actually seen this legendary character with their own eyes!
There was no doubt. Aside from Ling Han, who else could such a powerful Great Emperor be?
This was too shocking. How many years had passed? Even a new Emperor had been born, yet Ling Han was actually still alive.
Inconceivable.
This was a living legend.
The Shatter Wind Great Emperor also heard this, and when he saw this, a powerful bitterness rose up in his heart.
As Ling Han's successor, he naturally had always been compared to Ling Han.
Though no one said it, everyone had their own measurements internally, and would make a comparison.
However, the Shatter Wind Great Emperor was unconvinced.

He had advanced into the Great Emperor Tier, so he was also very clear that grasping the Nine Star Regulations was the limit of the Great Emperor Tier. Then, as fellow Great Emperors, who would be weaker than the other?
Thus, he was sure that the majority of Ling Han's legends had been added on by later generations. How could it be so exaggerated?
However, after personally experiencing the battle prowess of the Mysterious Clouds Great Emperor, he knew very well that the legends weren't false.
—He had almost been insta-killed by the Mysterious Clouds Great Emperor in a single move, and what about Ling Han?
They could fight back and forth, and this was the gap between them. Furthermore, it was as far as the gulf between heaven and earth.
Aside from being stunned, he was also filled with a strong sense of confusion. Why had Ling Han and the Mysterious Clouds Great Emperor been able to cultivate to such a powerful level?
Boom!
In the distance, Ling Han and the Mysterious Clouds Great Emperor engaged in an intense battle.

After so many years, he had always been waiting for this battle. As long as he dealt with the Mysterious Clouds Great Emperor and the Star Moon Empress, the universe would truly be at peace. At that time, he could also lead a peaceful life with his wives.

To him, imperial dominance was only a fleeting scene. Furthermore, he still had his own heaven and earth. If he wanted to become an Emperor or an overlord, he could just casually create a bunch of living beings.
Hong! Hong! Hong!

The battle between the two Great Emperors was incredibly intense. Ling Han unleashed his full battle prowess, and his iron fists rained down, instantly suppressing the Mysterious Clouds Great Emperor.
"What!"

The Mysterious Clouds Great Emperor felt it was inconceivable. He had cultivated in seclusion for tens of millions of years, and he felt that his battle prowess had increased slightly. Thus, he decided to find Ling Han for a battle. However, he didn't expect that not only had Ling Han's battle prowess improved as well, but the extent of his improvement was practically terrifying.
In his first battle with Ling Han, he had been on the upper hand at first, right until Ling Han unleashed his full power. Only then did he fall into a disadvantage, but it wasn't too far off.
Now, however, once Ling Han became serious, he would only be able to parry.

Hong long long, countless iron fists attacked from all directions. They were simple and violent, but their might was overwhelming, blasting the Mysterious Clouds Great Emperor to the point that he was throwing up blood like mad.
All the Saints were numb with shock. Even if they did not understand Emperor Tier battle prowess, they could tell from the comparison that Ling Han was unprecedentedly strong.
The Heavenly Emperor Han truly lived up to his reputation.
"This was taught by Grandpa Dog." An incredibly smug voice rang out.
"Who is it?!" All the Saints were shocked. Even the Shatter Wind Great Emperor looked stunned, because he had not discovered when another person had appeared in the vicinity.
Oh, no, it wasn't a human. It was a dog.
There was a large black dog with glossy fur. However, what made people grit their teeth was the fact that this dog was actually wearing a pair of metal underpants, which dazzled with a bright light.

"How is it? Handsome, right?" The large black dog wagged its behind on purpose, then put on a narcissistic expression, "It's really handsome. Grandpa Dog hasn't gotten tired of seeing it for even hundreds of millions of years!"
F***, this was too painful to the eyes!
This was a despicable dog!
Yi, despicable, despicable dog?
"You're the Number One Depicable Emperor of history!" a Saint exclaimed in astonishment.
However, he immediately covered his mouth.
This was a Great Emperor, so how could he slander him?

However, the large black dog didn't mind this at all. Instead, a smug expression appeared on his face, and he said, "As expected, Grandpa Dog is more awesome. I am recognized the moment I appeared! That's right, the person standing in front of you is the Number One Despicable Emperor of all eternity!"
It very much liked the word 'Despicable'. This was the motto of its dog life.
This!
All the Saints felt cold sweat pour down their backs. He was indeed very despicable.
"Friend!" The Shatter Wind Great Emperor spoke up, his expression slightly bitter.
F***, could it be that all of the Great Emperors of the last era had not died?

He was really too pitiful, wasn't he? He had clearly attained Dao and become the strongest in this era, but people stronger than him appeared one after another. Could he, the new Great Emperor, even have the slightest feeling of superiority?
Wasn't cultivating Dao painstakingly for the sake of becoming the strongest?
Sigh, even a despicable dog could be superior to him. This was too f.
"Brat, are you saying bad things about Grandpa Dog in your mind?" The large black dog stared at the Shatter Wind Great Emperor.
"No!" The Shatter Wind Great Emperor naturally shook his head in denial.
"He, with your little tricks, you think you can deceive Grandpa Dog?" The large black dog scoffed.
The Shatter Wind Great Emperor hadn't even finished speaking, when he saw another figure appear.

"Old Black, you're scaring people again!" The little azure dragon appeared, followed by Brother Monkey, the Battle Saint Emperor, the Great Emperor Wu Ya, and so on. Practically all the Great Emperors of the previous era appeared.
This was a crucial battle.
There were so many Great Emperors!
All the Saints were about to pass out. With such Imperial Might permeating through the air, the pressure on them increased greatly.
Meanwhile, the Shatter Wind Great Emperor wasn't feeling too good either. The might of the Great Emperors here were all stronger than him, so he was definitely a junior.
How was this possible?
So much time had already passed, so why hadn't these Great Emperors died yet?
In the previous era, there were many Great Emperors, and they were incomparably glorious. Could it be that their glory would continue in this era?
Heavens, he was such a pitiful Great Emperor!

Only the large black dog and the little azure dragon were rivals. They would always bicker, and the other Great Emperors all wore solemn expressions as they watched the fierce battle in the distance. They didn't relax in the slightest.

"Though Ling Han has the absolute upper hand, Mysterious Clouds is also an existence that has grasped the four elements. As long as he is given the slightest bit of chance, it is absolutely impossible to kill him."
"He must... kill him with a single strike!"

Aside from being stunned, he was also filled with a strong sense of confusion.
Why had Ling Han and the Mysterious Clouds Great Emperor been able to cultivate to such a powerful level?
Boom!
In the distance, Ling Han and the Mysterious Clouds Great Emperor engaged in an intense battle.
After so many years, he had always been waiting for this battle.
As long as he dealt with the Mysterious Clouds Great Emperor and the Star Moon Empress, the universe would truly be at peace.
At that time, he could also lead a peaceful life with his wives.
To him, imperial dominance was only a fleeting scene.
Furthermore, he still had his own heaven and earth.
If he wanted to become an Emperor or an overlord, he could just casually create a bunch of living beings.
Hong!
Hong!
Hong!
The battle between the two Great Emperors was incredibly intense.
Ling Han unleashed his full battle prowess, and his iron fists rained down, instantly suppressing the Mysterious Clouds Great Emperor.
"What!"
The Mysterious Clouds Great Emperor felt it was inconceivable.
He had cultivated in seclusion for tens of millions of years, and he felt that his battle prowess had increased slightly.
Thus, he decided to find Ling Han for a battle.
However, he didn't expect that not only had Ling Han's battle prowess improved as well, but the extent of his improvement was practically terrifying.
In his first battle with Ling Han, he had been on the upper hand at first, right until Ling Han unleashed his full power.
Only then did he fall into a disadvantage, but it wasn't too far off.
Now, however, once Ling Han became serious, he would only be able to parry.
Hong long long, countless iron fists attacked from all directions.
They were simple and violent, but their might was overwhelming, blasting the Mysterious Clouds Great Emperor to the point that he was throwing up blood like mad.
All the Saints were numb with shock.
Even if they did not understand Emperor Tier battle prowess, they could tell from the comparison that Ling Han was unprecedentedly strong.
The Heavenly Emperor Han truly lived up to his reputation.
"This was taught by Grandpa Dog." An incredibly smug voice rang out.
"Who is it?!" All the Saints were shocked.
Even the Shatter Wind Great Emperor looked stunned, because he had not discovered when another person had appeared in the vicinity.
Oh, no, it wasn't a human.
It was a dog.
There was a large black dog with glossy fur.
However, what made people grit their teeth was the fact that this dog was actually wearing a pair of metal underpants, which dazzled with a bright light.
"How is it?
Handsome, right?" The large black dog wagged its behind on purpose, then put on a narcissistic expression, "It's really handsome.
Grandpa Dog hasn't gotten tired of seeing it for even hundreds of millions of years!"
F***, this was too painful to the eyes!
This was a despicable dog!
Yi, despicable, despicable dog?
"You're the Number One Depicable Emperor of history!" a Saint exclaimed in astonishment.
However, he immediately covered his mouth.
This was a Great Emperor, so how could he slander him?
However, the large black dog didn't mind this at all.
Instead, a smug expression appeared on his face, and he said, "As expected, Grandpa Dog is more awesome.
I am recognized the moment I appeared!
That's right, the person standing in front of you is the Number One Despicable Emperor of all eternity!"
It very much liked the word 'Despicable'.
This was the motto of its dog life.
This!
All the Saints felt cold sweat pour down their backs.
He was indeed very despicable.
"Friend!" The Shatter Wind Great Emperor spoke up, his expression slightly bitter.
F***, could it be that all of the Great Emperors of the last era had not died?
He was really too pitiful, wasn't he?
He had clearly attained Dao and become the strongest in this era, but people stronger than him appeared one after another.
Could he, the new Great Emperor, even have the slightest feeling of superiority?
Wasn't cultivating Dao painstakingly for the sake of becoming the strongest?
Sigh, even a despicable dog could be superior to him.
This was too f.
"Brat, are you saying bad things about Grandpa Dog in your mind?" The large black dog stared at the Shatter Wind Great Emperor.
"No!" The Shatter Wind Great Emperor naturally shook his head in denial.
"He, with your little tricks, you think you can deceive Grandpa Dog?" The large black dog scoffed.
The Shatter Wind Great Emperor hadn't even finished speaking, when he saw another figure appear.
"Old Black, you're scaring people again!" The little azure dragon appeared, followed by Brother Monkey, the Battle Saint Emperor, the Great Emperor Wu Ya, and so on.
Practically all the Great Emperors of the previous era appeared.
This was a crucial battle.
There were so many Great Emperors!
All the Saints were about to pass out.
With such Imperial Might permeating through the air, the pressure on them increased greatly.
Meanwhile, the Shatter Wind Great Emperor wasn't feeling too good either.
The might of the Great Emperors here were all stronger than him, so he was definitely a junior.
How was this possible?
So much time had already passed, so why hadn't these Great Emperors died yet?
In the previous era, there were many Great Emperors, and they were incomparably glorious.
Could it be that their glory would continue in this era?
Heavens, he was such a pitiful Great Emperor!
Only the large black dog and the little azure dragon were rivals.
They would always bicker, and the other Great Emperors all wore solemn expressions as they watched the fierce battle in the distance.
They didn't relax in the slightest.
"Though Ling Han has the absolute upper hand, Mysterious Clouds is also an existence that has grasped the four elements.
As long as he is given the slightest bit of chance, it is absolutely impossible to kill him."
"He must... kill him with a single strike!"

chapters.title: Chapter 4907: Killing another
paragraphs: Hearing the words of the Great Emperors, the Shatter Wind Great Emperor was completely baffled.
Four key elements?
And... to kill a Great Emperor?
Heavens, who could do the commentating for him?
"Seniors!" he greeted. "Then who exactly is the Mysterious Clouds Great Emperor?"
"That’s a long story," the large black dog immediately said. "Do you want to hear it? Are you sure you want to hear it?"
The Shatter Wind Great Emperor wiped away the cold sweat on his forehead. What was wrong with this dog?!
"Please go ahead, Senior Dog," he said very modestly. These Great Emperors all seemed to have strength that could crush him. He could still tell this fact.
If it were anyone else, they would definitely fly into a rage if they were called a "dog", regardless of whether they were addressed as "Senior" or not.
However, the large black dog was not anyone else. He very much enjoyed this form of address, and showed a hint of satisfaction. He even said smilingly, "You can be taught, you really can be taught!"
’Tell me then!’
The Shatter Wind Great Emperor didn’t dare to rush him, so he could only smile awkwardly on the sidelines.
Thankfully, the large black dog’s despicable nature was mostly reserved for his enemies. Thus, he soon began to talk.
Hearing the large black dog’s words, the Shatter Wind Great Emperor looked stunned.
As it turned out, grasping Regulations was only the beginning for a Great Emperor. The four main elements were the true rise of a Great Emperor.

He secretly decided that when this battle was over, and he had cultivated Regulations to consummate level, he would go to Primitive Abyss. He had to cultivate one of the elements, and advance into the fourth tier.
Because he understood the sequence of events, when he looked at the battle in the distance this time, he couldn’t help but feel a hint of worry.
What if... Ling Han wasn’t able to kill the Mysterious Clouds Great Emperor?

This kind of Great Emperor had an undying body, and no matter how serious his injuries were, he would be able to recover with a single thought. Furthermore, if this kind of existence was completely focused on fleeing and hiding, even Ling Han would not be able to find him.
Then, if the Mysterious Clouds Great Emperor vented his anger on the universe, he could completely destroy this world.
Thus, Ling Han definitely had to succeed!
Hong! Hong! Hong!

Ling Han’s rain of iron fists became denser and denser, finally breaking through a critical point, causing the Mysterious Clouds Great Emperor’s recovery speed to slightly slow down. Instantly, Ling Han took the chance, opening his inner heaven and earth to draw in the Mysterious Clouds Great Emperor.

The Mysterious Clouds Great Emperor was presently healing his injuries, his power dispersed, and under severe injury, his battle prowess definitely dropped drastically. Instantly, he was sucked into the heaven and earth of Ling Han’s body.
"What is this place?" Like the Boundless Great Emperor, he revealed an incredibly stunned expression.
His communication with the four elements... had been cut off!
In his eyes, this was inconceivable. After cultivating the four elements, one could maintain communication with the four elements at all times. How could there possibly be an interruption?
Ling Han smiled faintly, "Boundless was killed by me here."
"Huh? Boundless is dead?" The Mysterious Clouds Great Emperor faltered for a moment before shaking his head and saying, "So what if he’s dead? I’ve never liked this person anyway."
This reaction!
Seeing Ling Han’s startled expression, the Mysterious Clouds Great Emperor couldn’t help but laugh loudly. "Do you think I’m stupid? You can kill Boundless, so you can naturally kill me as well."
"I do indeed have such intentions." Ling Han nodded.

The Mysterious Clouds Great Emperor shook his head, and said, "After living for so long, I don’t care about life or death anymore. However, I’m curious... Is this the heaven and earth you have created?"
"That’s right," Ling Han admitted. After entering this place, he would be the one in charge.
"How is that possible?" A puzzled expression appeared on the Mysterious Clouds Great Emperor’s face, and he said, "The three of us have also studied this before. It’s impossible."
"I came from the Stone of Life, and from the Primitive Abyss. Of course, it’s possible," Ling Han said with a smile.
The Mysterious Clouds Great Emperor pondered for a moment before shaking his head and saying, "Impossible! Even if you were nurtured by the Stone of Life, this is still an impossible feat."
Yi, his reaction was the same as that of the Boundless Great Emperor. He was certain that even the Stone of Life wouldn’t be able to nurture a freak like him.
"However, the fact that I’m standing here is clear proof," Ling Han said with a smile.

The Mysterious Clouds Great Emperor was still pondering over this. Indeed, Ling Han had truly constructed a new heaven and earth, allowing the impossible to become reality. However, he truly couldn’t understand this. After so many Stacked Eras, how many experiments had they done?
Ling Han didn’t speak any more nonsense. With a thought, a divine sword slashed towards the Mysterious Clouds Great Emperor.
In this internal heaven and earth, Ling Han was the absolute ruler. No matter how powerful the Mysterious Clouds Great Emperor was, he would ultimately be killed.

However, a Great Emperor was a Great Emperor, after all. The Mysterious Clouds Great Emperor was clearly already at the end of his rope, yet showed no signs of begging for mercy. In fact, he did not even bother to temporarily feign civility, and had no intention of even escaping.
He was going to battle, right until the last drop of blood flowed out.
Ling Han had to admit that though Boundless and Mysterious Clouds were ruthless, their moral character was still present.
Those who could become Great Emperors were all proud and unyielding.
Oh, the prerequisite was that this Great Emperor was one that had cultivated on his own, and not something like the old Divine Beast.

Too bad, this kind of Great Emperor was undying and indestructible. He had lived for too long, and was trapped for too long, and forcibly turned into a maniac. He posed a threat to all life, and had no choice but to be eliminated.
Ling Han retreated out of the inner heaven and earth, and returned to his own mind.
"Dealt with another one." The large black dog approached, whistling, "There’s still one more to go, and we’ll be able to remove our armor and return to the fields, and go back to civilian life."

The little azure dragon looked at the iron underwear on the large black dog’s body and shook its head, saying, "As Grandpa Dragon sees it, you won’t be able to remove your armor for the rest of your life."
The large black dog glared at him, "Are you coveting Grandpa Dog’s treasure?"
"Get lost!" The little azure dragon kicked him.
Meanwhile, the Shatter Winds Great Emperor arrived in front of Ling Han. He bowed first, and said, "Junior pays respects to Heavenly Emperor Han! Thank you for helping me, Heavenly Emperor Han."
If Ling Han hadn’t been here, it was possible that he would have died from his severe wounds.
Ling Han raised his hand, "No need for such formalities."
In the distance, those Saints were also rushing over. This was the Heavenly Emperor Han. Thus, they naturally had to pay their respects and admire the graceful bearing of the Great Emperor.
However, right at this moment, an incredibly powerful aura swept over, instantly causing those Saints to tremble and prostrate in the galaxy.
A breathtakingly beautiful figure appeared, standing proudly in the galaxy, domineering yet enchanting.
The Star Moon Empress had finally appeared.
Ling Han found this strange. Why had the last invincible Great Emperor appeared at this time? Why hadn’t she appeared earlier?
If it had been earlier, she might have been able to save the Mysterious Clouds Great Emperor.
—With the two invincible Great Emperors "joining forces, one inside and the other outside", Ling Han really might not be able to continue imprisoning the Mysterious Clouds Great Emperor.
The atmosphere instantly became tense again.
Another invincible Great Emperor appeared. This was an existence that could destroy the universe at the slightest provocation.
Ling Han looked at Star Moon Empress, and Star Moon Empress also gazed at him, as if she was deeply in love with him.
However, everyone knew that once the two sides started fighting, it would be world-destroying.
"Ling Han, you have not disappointed me." Star Moon Empress smiled beautifully.
What was the meaning of this?

Ling Han was unconcerned. Previously, he had been worrying. If the Mysterious Clouds Great Emperor and the Star Moon Empress did not appear all this while, he would not be able to deal with these two great calamities either. But now, these two people had actually appeared, one after the other.
It was time to end the turmoil eternally.
