chapters.title: Chapter 4908: Star Moon Empress
paragraphs: "Come battle!" Star Moon Empress took a step, and instantly left.
Ling Han hurriedly followed behind her. He naturally wouldn’t let her escape.
The Star Moon Empress actually went to the Primitive Abyss, and it was the Imperial Island at that.
Ling Han naturally wouldn’t hesitate. He also stepped onto the Imperial Island.
However, the large black dog and the others weren’t as quick. They were blocked by the sea of death, so they needed to slowly make their way over.
"Ling Han, let’s go all out in battle here!" the Star Moon Empress shouted. She was already charging toward Ling Han.
Ling Han’s expression became serious.
The Star Moon Empress had clearly seen the Mysterious Clouds Great Emperor die by his hand, yet she still dared to appear for a battle. It was clear that she was extremely confident.
This was the first invincible Great Emperor in the world, so he couldn’t be careless.

Of course, Ling Han had already formed his own heaven and earth. He was the true undying and indestructible one. Thus, what he couldn’t be careless about was preventing Star Moon Empress from having the chance to escape.
Boom!
The two of them immediately began a fierce battle.

This was the Primitive Abyss, and the Imperial Island at that. The structure of heaven and earth was incredibly sturdy, and even if the two invincible Great Emperors were exchanging blows, it only caused cracks to appear on the ground, and did not shatter instantaneously.
However, if this battle continued, it was possible that Imperial Island would be destroyed as well.
Fight, fight, fight!
Ling Han unleashed his full battle prowess, unleashing a furious barrage of attacks at Star Moon Empress.
The Empress was unafraid, and countered with her terrifying battle prowess.
In terms of quantity of the four elements, she was far inferior to Ling Han. However, in terms of proficiency in using them, she was superior.

This was the first invincible Great Emperor in history, so her use of the four elements had naturally reached a state of perfection. Even the combined efforts of the Boundless Great Emperor and Mysterious Clouds Great Emperor couldn’t compare to her.
However, the problem was that Ling Han’s advantage in numbers was far too great, reaching the point where he could disperse all techniques with his own strength.
No matter how good your technique was, it was useless. In a head-on confrontation, they were not on the same level at all.
Ling Han attacked her madly, while the Star Moon Empress dodged left and right. If she took a blow head-on, she would definitely be severely injured.
Of course, she wasn’t afraid of severe wounds either. This was the Imperial Island, which was filled with element of life in the first place, so it could immediately heal her.
In this place, the undying and indestructible nature of a first tier Great Emperor had been greatly strengthened.
Ling Han had to admit that the older one was, the more knowledgeable one would be. It was less likely for him to suppress this Empress if they battled here.
However, he had to battle.
Fighting here would have the least impact on the outside world. Otherwise, if they fought in the universe, who knew what kind of terrifying casualties would be caused.

The Star Moon Empress displayed the graceful bearing of an invincible Great Emperor. She was clearly at an absolute disadvantage in terms of power, but through the perfect use of the four elements, she was not always on the back foot, but could still organize a decent counterattack, causing Ling Han to bleed a little.
This was a tug-of-war, and the battle was incredibly difficult.
Several years later, the large black dog, the Great Emperor Wu Ya and even the empress and the others all rushed over.
That was because this would be the final battle.

If they could destroy the Star Moon Empress, the universe would enjoy eternal peace. Otherwise, an invincible Great Emperor might cause trouble at any time. Just the thought of it was enough to make one’s scalp go numb.
A thousand years, ten thousand years, a hundred thousand years!

This battle was incredibly drawn out. When the battle began on the Imperial Island, the battle prowess of the two Great Emperors had both been boosted, especially the Star Moon Empress. It was equivalent that she too possessed an endless supply of the four elements.

Ling Han, on the other hand, was the one who had formed his own heaven and earth. In truth, there was already no need for him to draw on the four fundamental elements from the outside world. Thus, when they battled on the Imperial Island, though he also had some battle prowess boosted, it was practically negligible.
Although they had battled for 100,000 years, the two of them were in the same state as when they had started fighting.
Indestructible and undying, their energy was also eternally abundant.
Just how long would this battle continue for?
However, right at this moment, the Star Moon Empress actually revealed a weakness!
This was a very big flaw, and with her strength, this was a super mistake that she should not have made.
Could it be that after a long battle, she had developed a feeling of boredom, and that was why she had made such a low-level mistake?
Ling Han definitely wouldn’t miss this opportunity. He immediately launched a series of powerful attacks, causing the Star Moon Empress to violently vomit blood and suffer severe wounds.
Even if this place was filled with the element of life, it would still take ten thousandth of a heartbeat to heal her injuries, but for Ling Han, this little bit of time was enough.
He spread out his inner heaven and earth. Xiu, he had taken in the Star Moon Empress.

"This is... the heaven and earth that has been constructed!" After the Star Moon Empress entered into Ling Han’s inner heaven and earth, she did not show the slightest bit of shock. Instead, she looked him up and down curiously, as if this had satisfied a great wish of hers.

Ling Han was astonished. It should be known that after the two Great Emperors, Boundless and Mysterious Clouds, entered this place, they immediately exclaimed in shock and even called out ’impossible’.
When it came to Star Moon Empress, it became a kind of admiration, as if... she was admiring her own work.
"Don’t you think that this is impossible?" Ling Han asked.
"Why would it be impossible?" Star Moon Empress countered with a smile.
This!
A strange feeling rose up in Ling Han’s heart. It was as if all of this was under the other’s control, but the problem was this was his heaven and earth.
In his heaven and earth, even an invincible Great Emperor could only bow down in submission.
"Ha!" the Empress shouted, and once again charged towards Ling Han.
However, in Ling Han’s heaven and earth, who could hurt him?

Ling Han attacked randomly, and Star Moon Empress was blasted quite badly. Soon, blood dyed her whole body. Without the replenishment of the element of life, it was only a matter of time before she died in battle.
However, this Empress was not angry, nor was she dissatisfied. She was only calm.
This made Ling Han feel even stranger. However, no matter how strange it was, he couldn’t stop.
Of the three great calamities, only one was left. He had to deal with her.
Hong! Hong! Hong!
Under Ling Han’s full-power attack, the Empress was severely injured, and her vitality was severely depleted. Death was close at hand.
"Finally... freed!" Star Moon Empress showed a hint of joy, her expression calm, without the slightest fear of facing death.
Ling Han frowned, and said, "You’ve come to seek death!"

No wonder she had walked out even though she had clearly seen the Mysterious Clouds Great Emperor being killed. It wasn’t because she believed that she could defeat Ling Han, but rather because she wanted to seek death.
The Star Moon Empress cracked a smile. Her blood was bright red, and she was both beautiful and poignant.
"For this day, I’ve set up arrangements for a total of seven Stacked Eras, and I’ve finally succeeded."
Ling Han hurriedly said, "Hey, hey, hey, tell me clearly!"
"Did Mysterious Clouds and Boundless tell you that this inner heaven and earth can’t be constructed?" Star Moon Empress countered.
"Indeed," Ling Han said with a nod.
The Star Moon Empress nodded, and said, "Ordinarily speaking, this indeed can’t be constructed! However..." She wore a haughty expression, and she continued, "It’ll be different if I participate!"
"What do you mean!" Ling Han asked, suddenly feeling a headache coming on.

"Several Stacked Eras ago, I already didn’t want to live anymore. However, after cultivating to this level, I can’t die even if I want to," the empress said calmly. "Since I can’t kill myself, I’ll nurture someone who can."
F*ck!

sentences.text: "Come battle!" Star Moon Empress took a step, and instantly left.
Ling Han hurriedly followed behind her.
He naturally wouldn’t let her escape.
The Star Moon Empress actually went to the Primitive Abyss, and it was the Imperial Island at that.
Ling Han naturally wouldn’t hesitate.
He also stepped onto the Imperial Island.
However, the large black dog and the others weren’t as quick.
They were blocked by the sea of death, so they needed to slowly make their way over.
"Ling Han, let’s go all out in battle here!" the Star Moon Empress shouted.
She was already charging toward Ling Han.
Ling Han’s expression became serious.
The Star Moon Empress had clearly seen the Mysterious Clouds Great Emperor die by his hand, yet she still dared to appear for a battle.
It was clear that she was extremely confident.
This was the first invincible Great Emperor in the world, so he couldn’t be careless.
Of course, Ling Han had already formed his own heaven and earth.
He was the true undying and indestructible one.
Thus, what he couldn’t be careless about was preventing Star Moon Empress from having the chance to escape.
Boom!
The two of them immediately began a fierce battle.
This was the Primitive Abyss, and the Imperial Island at that.

The structure of heaven and earth was incredibly sturdy, and even if the two invincible Great Emperors were exchanging blows, it only caused cracks to appear on the ground, and did not shatter instantaneously.
However, if this battle continued, it was possible that Imperial Island would be destroyed as well.
Fight, fight, fight!
Ling Han unleashed his full battle prowess, unleashing a furious barrage of attacks at Star Moon Empress.
The Empress was unafraid, and countered with her terrifying battle prowess.
In terms of quantity of the four elements, she was far inferior to Ling Han.
However, in terms of proficiency in using them, she was superior.
This was the first invincible Great Emperor in history, so her use of the four elements had naturally reached a state of perfection.
Even the combined efforts of the Boundless Great Emperor and Mysterious Clouds Great Emperor couldn’t compare to her.
However, the problem was that Ling Han’s advantage in numbers was far too great, reaching the point where he could disperse all techniques with his own strength.
No matter how good your technique was, it was useless.
In a head-on confrontation, they were not on the same level at all.
Ling Han attacked her madly, while the Star Moon Empress dodged left and right.
If she took a blow head-on, she would definitely be severely injured.
Of course, she wasn’t afraid of severe wounds either.
This was the Imperial Island, which was filled with element of life in the first place, so it could immediately heal her.
In this place, the undying and indestructible nature of a first tier Great Emperor had been greatly strengthened.
Ling Han had to admit that the older one was, the more knowledgeable one would be.
It was less likely for him to suppress this Empress if they battled here.
However, he had to battle.
Fighting here would have the least impact on the outside world.
Otherwise, if they fought in the universe, who knew what kind of terrifying casualties would be caused.
The Star Moon Empress displayed the graceful bearing of an invincible Great Emperor.

She was clearly at an absolute disadvantage in terms of power, but through the perfect use of the four elements, she was not always on the back foot, but could still organize a decent counterattack, causing Ling Han to bleed a little.
This was a tug-of-war, and the battle was incredibly difficult.
Several years later, the large black dog, the Great Emperor Wu Ya and even the empress and the others all rushed over.
That was because this would be the final battle.
If they could destroy the Star Moon Empress, the universe would enjoy eternal peace.
Otherwise, an invincible Great Emperor might cause trouble at any time.
Just the thought of it was enough to make one’s scalp go numb.
A thousand years, ten thousand years, a hundred thousand years!
This battle was incredibly drawn out.
When the battle began on the Imperial Island, the battle prowess of the two Great Emperors had both been boosted, especially the Star Moon Empress.
It was equivalent that she too possessed an endless supply of the four elements.
Ling Han, on the other hand, was the one who had formed his own heaven and earth.
In truth, there was already no need for him to draw on the four fundamental elements from the outside world.
Thus, when they battled on the Imperial Island, though he also had some battle prowess boosted, it was practically negligible.
Although they had battled for 100,000 years, the two of them were in the same state as when they had started fighting.
Indestructible and undying, their energy was also eternally abundant.
Just how long would this battle continue for?
However, right at this moment, the Star Moon Empress actually revealed a weakness!
This was a very big flaw, and with her strength, this was a super mistake that she should not have made.
Could it be that after a long battle, she had developed a feeling of boredom, and that was why she had made such a low-level mistake?
Ling Han definitely wouldn’t miss this opportunity.
He immediately launched a series of powerful attacks, causing the Star Moon Empress to violently vomit blood and suffer severe wounds.
Even if this place was filled with the element of life, it would still take ten thousandth of a heartbeat to heal her injuries, but for Ling Han, this little bit of time was enough.
He spread out his inner heaven and earth.
Xiu, he had taken in the Star Moon Empress.
"This is... the heaven and earth that has been constructed!" After the Star Moon Empress entered into Ling Han’s inner heaven and earth, she did not show the slightest bit of shock.
Instead, she looked him up and down curiously, as if this had satisfied a great wish of hers.
Ling Han was astonished.
It should be known that after the two Great Emperors, Boundless and Mysterious Clouds, entered this place, they immediately exclaimed in shock and even called out ’impossible’.
When it came to Star Moon Empress, it became a kind of admiration, as if... she was admiring her own work.
"Don’t you think that this is impossible?" Ling Han asked.
"Why would it be impossible?" Star Moon Empress countered with a smile.
This!
A strange feeling rose up in Ling Han’s heart.
It was as if all of this was under the other’s control, but the problem was this was his heaven and earth.
In his heaven and earth, even an invincible Great Emperor could only bow down in submission.
"Ha!" the Empress shouted, and once again charged towards Ling Han.
However, in Ling Han’s heaven and earth, who could hurt him?
Ling Han attacked randomly, and Star Moon Empress was blasted quite badly.
Soon, blood dyed her whole body.
Without the replenishment of the element of life, it was only a matter of time before she died in battle.
However, this Empress was not angry, nor was she dissatisfied.
She was only calm.
This made Ling Han feel even stranger.
However, no matter how strange it was, he couldn’t stop.
Of the three great calamities, only one was left.
He had to deal with her.
Hong!
Hong!
Hong!
Under Ling Han’s full-power attack, the Empress was severely injured, and her vitality was severely depleted.
Death was close at hand.
"Finally... freed!" Star Moon Empress showed a hint of joy, her expression calm, without the slightest fear of facing death.
Ling Han frowned, and said, "You’ve come to seek death!"
No wonder she had walked out even though she had clearly seen the Mysterious Clouds Great Emperor being killed.
It wasn’t because she believed that she could defeat Ling Han, but rather because she wanted to seek death.
The Star Moon Empress cracked a smile.
Her blood was bright red, and she was both beautiful and poignant.
"For this day, I’ve set up arrangements for a total of seven Stacked Eras, and I’ve finally succeeded."
Ling Han hurriedly said, "Hey, hey, hey, tell me clearly!"
"Did Mysterious Clouds and Boundless tell you that this inner heaven and earth can’t be constructed?" Star Moon Empress countered.
"Indeed," Ling Han said with a nod.
The Star Moon Empress nodded, and said, "Ordinarily speaking, this indeed can’t be constructed!
However..." She wore a haughty expression, and she continued, "It’ll be different if I participate!"
"What do you mean!" Ling Han asked, suddenly feeling a headache coming on.
"Several Stacked Eras ago, I already didn’t want to live anymore.
However, after cultivating to this level, I can’t die even if I want to," the empress said calmly.
"Since I can’t kill myself, I’ll nurture someone who can."
F*ck!

chapters.title: Chapter 4909: The True Number One
paragraphs: Even Ling Han couldn’t help but inhale sharply.
He had only heard of some people nurturing disciples, while the more freakish ones were nurturing future wives and husbands. However, he had never heard of anyone nurturing enemies to kill them.
However, in the case of the Star Moon Empress, it was understandable.
She was undying and indestructible, and even if she wanted to commit suicide, she could not.
Thus, she could only nurture an even stronger person to help her end her life.
It was logical, but Ling Han felt extremely frustrated.
"I’m that person?" Ling Han asked in a solemn voice.

At first, he had not believed it, but after he had dragged Boundless and Mysterious Clouds into the inner heaven and earth, that kind of shock and disbelief could not be faked. They were really shocked, and really thought that no one could form the inner heaven and earth.
These two people were qualified to make such a judgement, because they were invincible Great Emperors, and who knew how many Stacked Eras they had stayed on this cultivation level for.
Thus, in terms of understanding of the four main elements, as well as the heaven and earth, they were definitely far superior to Ling Han.
Thus, they refused to believe that Ling Han could construct heaven and earth within his inner world, even though they were inside Ling Han’s inner world.
Star Moon Empress broke into a smile, "That’s right!"

She paused for a moment, then continued, "I tried countless times, and finally, there was one time that I successfully preserved a stone seed at the end of a Stacked Era. It was wrapped by my spiritual mark, and endured the change of heaven and earth."
"Repeating Stacked Era after Stacked Era, I nurtured it with the four elements of my body, allowing this stone seed to possess the ability to manifest heaven and earth."
"Then, in this Stacked Era, I released it."
"You have not disappointed me. You have walked out of the stone seed, and constructed your own heaven and earth!"

Ling Han gritted his teeth. In other words, the old Divine Beast had been released by these three people, and the release of the Stone of Life was also the handiwork of this character. She had been imperceptibly influencing the Great Emperors.
Why did the Great Emperors not sense anything?

This was not impossible. Just look at how the old Divine Beast was acting. He only knew to excavate the caves of the four elements, but if he really had to explain the reason, he was actually a little muddled. He only had a feeling that he wanted to do so, and it became the motivation that supported him, and he pursued this goal for hundreds of billions of years.

All the Great Emperors had been living on the Imperial Island all this while, so it was really too easy for them to be influenced unknowingly. After all, the Star Moon Empress was a first tier existence.
Additionally, when the three invincible Great Emperors had appeared, the Mysterious Clouds Great Emperor had initially wanted to kill him. However, he had been stopped by the Star Moon Empress.
—A Great Emperor, who was indifferent to all life in the world, would actually deliberately dissuade him?

This was originally a very small and unreasonable action, but it could also be understood as the Star Moon Empress being in a good mood because she had just appeared, and that was why she had stopped the Mysterious Clouds Great Emperor from attacking.
And now, this new explanation was even more logical.
Ling Han was the person that Star Moon Empress had painstakingly nurtured to kill her, so how could she allow him to die first?
"Since you have such thoughts, it means that you still have the heart to do good. Why do you want to bring calamity to the world?" Ling Han asked solemnly.
"Hahahaha!" The Star Moon Empress laughed madly, "No, no, no, after being trapped for so many years, I have long since lost all feelings. I am merely tired of living like this!"

"To us, so what if it is all the living beings in the world? So what if it is all the living beings in the universe? It is just a cycle of repeated destruction. Whether it is damaged or not, whether it is destroyed or not, there is no difference in the final fate."
"Rather than that, wouldn’t it be more meaningful to be our playthings to help us pass some time?"
Ling Han shook his head. At first, he still had a sliver of pity and wanted to spare the Star Moon Empress, but now, his killing intent was firm again.
"Since that is the case, I will send you on your way to the afterlife!" he said word by word.

"Young man, don’t underestimate your enemy!" Star Moon Empress said haughtily. "I was the first person in the world to grasp the four fundamental elements. In fact, Mysterious Clouds and Boundless were able to reach this level thanks to my secret guidance. If you want to kill me... it won’t be so easy!"
"Though I have nurtured you to kill me... I will not stretch out my neck and wait to be beheaded either. You have to have absolute strength to be able to do that!"
Boom!
The Star Moon Empress launched a counterattack, with astonishing power surging out of her body. The four elements appeared, solidifying and fusing together to form a heavenly spear.
The Empress brandished her spear, and swept it towards Ling Han.

Ordinarily, weapons that were suitable for women were short swords, daggers, scimitars, and so on. However, the Empress wielded a spear, and her domineering aura was unparalleled, possessing an indescribable beauty.
Ling Han clenched his hand into a fist, and shot out a punch.
Peng!
Fist and spear clashed, and blood actually spurted from Ling Han’s fist.
He was a soul now, so it naturally wasn’t true blood. Instead, it was a sliver of damage to his soul.
So powerful!

Ling Han couldn’t help but nod. As expected of the Star Moon Empress, the invincible Great Emperor that had lived the longest. If it was Mysterious Clouds and Boundless, after they entered into the heaven and earth of the inner world, they would be completely no match for Ling Han.
However, the weapon that the Star Moon Empress had manifested with the four elements could wound him. This was indeed extraordinary.
However, this was Ling Han’s inner heaven and earth!
Boom!

Ling Han swung his fist again and again. Similarly, there were four elements entwined around his fist, and it was as if a black film had been plated on the surface of his fist, exuding a cold metallic texture.
The Empress brandished her spear and clashed. Peng, the four elements instantly clashed fiercely.
Obviously, Ling Han had the upper hand in terms of quantity of the four elements. In the exchange of a single blow, the spear was instantly shattered, and the iron fist penetrated deeply.
"Plunder!" the empress shouted. She forcefully extracted the four fundamental elements from Ling Han’s heaven and earth, transforming them into a divine sword that charged at Ling Han.
Peng!

The heavenly sword shattered, but cracks also appeared on Ling Han’s iron fist. After exchanging another blow with the empress, the four elements that were wrapped around it were completely dispersed.

Even with Ling Han’s composure, he was still stunned internally. The Star Moon Empress was actually able to forcibly plunder the four elements inside his body, as if she was still in the outside world.
This was truly an unparalleled prodigy. Compared to her, Mysterious Clouds and Boundless were clearly much inferior.

If it was not for the fact that the first tier was the finishing line, he believed that this empress would still be able to leave others behind in her dust, and reach a height that others could not even look up to.
Furthermore, she had also said that the fact that Boundless and Mysterious Clouds had been able to grasp the four key elements was also thanks to her guidance.
—Without her guidance, there would be no new invincible Great Emperor among these 34 Stacked Eras.
As for Ling Han?
The Stone of Life was nurtured by her invincible martial intent, and she had already branded it with her mark from the very beginning.
Hence, this Empress was the number one person throughout the innumerable Stacked Eras!

You see, it was possible that there were already over a hundred, or even several hundred, Stacked Eras in which heaven and earth had evolved, but it was only in the thirty-fourth Stacked Era that an invincible Great Emperor like her appeared.
Afterward, it was because of her that three invincible Great Emperors had appeared.
Now, though Ling Han was stronger, he had to admit that in terms of natural talent in cultivation, he was really inferior to this person.

chapters.title: Chapter 4910: A battle at the end of the line
paragraphs: Ling Han was indeed stronger than the Star Moon Empress now, but this strength was based on the fact that the Star Moon Empress had nurtured him for a few Stacked Eras..
Standing on the shoulder of a giant, and added with his similarly outstanding natural talent, how could he not surpass his predecessors?

In truth, it was the Empress’s disadvantage that she was the first person to become an invincible Great Emperor. Otherwise, if there was someone to help her, she would definitely be able to construct her own heaven and earth.
Even though they were enemies, Ling Han was still filled with admiration.

"If you don’t work hard, you won’t be able to kill me!" the Star Moon Empress said calmly. "I’ll give you one year. If you can’t kill me within one year, I’ll charge out of here and destroy this heaven and earth!"
She said the last few words very casually, as if it would not be difficult for her to break through and escape.
This was something that even Boundless and Mysterious Clouds couldn’t do, but Ling Han was very sure that this Empress wasn’t exaggerating.
This person’s natural talent in cultivation was truly indescribably strong.

Merely from the fact that she could forcibly plunder the four elements inside Ling Han’s body, it was clear that even if she was limited by the upper limit of heaven and earth, she could still do what others could not.
With a soft exclamation, the Empress charged towards Ling Han. With a light wave of her slender hand, at least a few hundred Heavenly Swords appeared, shooting towards Ling Han.
Each Heavenly Sword was made up of four elements, and was filled with destructive power.
In Ling Han’s heaven and earth, of course, nothing could hurt him — as long as he willed it.

However, the Empress had forcefully snatched his four fundamental elements and turned them into weapons to attack him. This had become a situation that could not be resolved, and could only be repeated endlessly.
How was he supposed to kill her?
To say nothing of one year, he wouldn’t be able to do it even if it was 100 million years or a Stacked Era.
Ling Han frowned upon seeing this. This was the first time he had been so helpless.

Boundless and Mysterious Clouds were both invincible Great Emperors, but the moment they entered into the heaven and earth of his inner world, they had already confirmed the time of their deaths, but in the case of this Empress, that was completely not the case.
This was undoubtedly the most powerful Great Emperor.
Hong! Hong! Hong!

The Empress’s counterattack became stronger and stronger. She plundered the four elements and turned them into her weapon, using Ling Han’s own power to attack his own defence. She herself was completely unaffected, as if she had transcended.
One month, two months, three months... Time flew by, yet Ling Han still couldn’t find a countermeasure.
He was already in his strongest state, and he had even trapped the Star Moon Empress in the heaven and earth of his innver world. If he still couldn’t kill her, what else could he do?
"Ling Han, you disappoint me!" the Empress said with a shake of her head. "There are still nine months. If you still can’t kill me, I won’t play with you anymore!"
There was a subtle change in her expression, and she was exuding a murderous aura.

This kind of her had a bit of austerity, but it did not decrease her beauty in the slightest. Instead, she had an additional air of martial arts and dominance, which would make others submit even more.
Boom!
The Empress delivered a series of strikes with both hands. The four fundamental elements were freely manifested in her hands, and she attacked Ling Han in a myriad of ways.
Ling Han took a deep breath. If this continued, it was destined to be an irresolvable cycle.
He definitely wouldn’t allow the Star Moon Empress to go out and destroy this world. Thus, he definitely had to suppress her.
Then, the first step would be to sever her communication with the four elements.

—At first, he had thought that it would be fine once he entered into the heaven and earth of his inner world, but now, he discovered that this empress was practically ten times stronger than even Boundless and Mysterious Clouds added together, oh no, a hundred times stronger!
However, he still had to think of some way to solve this problem. If this problem was not resolved, there was no need to mention anything else.
Ling Han pondered as he fought. Finally, he showed a hint of ruthlessness.
He was going to give it his all!
With a soft exclamation, his whole person actually began to solidify.
’Hmm?’

He was originally a spiritual body, but because this was the heaven and earth of his inner world, a single thought from him was equivalent to the highest level of heaven and earth’s will. Thus, there was absolutely no difference whether he had a physical body or not.
Why had he suddenly materialized?
The Empress was also slightly taken aback. Then, a look of understanding appeared on her face, "You used yourself as a prison, and locked the four elements, forcibly imprisoning them."
Pa, pa, pa! She clapped her hands, and said, "Not bad, not bad. This is a very good idea. I indeed can’t extract any more of the four elements."
"However!" The Empress revealed a baleful expression, "That goes for you too!"

Ling Han used the four elements to form his body, and his original body was a prison, locking in the four elements. This determined that even Ling Han himself could not possibly extract more of the four elements. Once they were used up, they would be gone.
Hence, this became a battle to the death.
Without the replenishment of the four elements, an invincible Great Emperor would also die.
Ling Han had already made up his mind. He smiled slightly, "You have the heart to die, and I too have the determination to fight to the death!"
"Good!" The Empress laughed loudly, "These words are finally a little domineering!"
With a soft exclamation, she once again charged towards Ling Han.
Hong! Hong! Hong!

The two Great Emperors battled fiercely. This time, it was really a close-combat battle after they ran out of ammunition. Neither of them had the supplies of the four elements. In that case, they had to be extremely careful. Not only did they have to decrease the expenditure of the four elements, they also had to be careful not to sustain heavy injuries, or even light injuries.
Because one would have to expend the element of life to recover from injuries, it would have an effect on battle prowess.
"You are contending with me in the use of the four elements?" The Empress shook her head, "You overestimate yourself!"
When it came to the use of the four elements, she was undoubtedly number one.
Hong! Hong! Hong!
"Since you can’t kill me, I’ll kill you and destroy this world!" The Empress’s killing intent became even more intense.
Being trapped for a few Stacked Eras at the drop of a hat, even the most sane person would go crazy. Even this supreme Empress was no exception.
—I have spent so much effort to nurture you, yet you are still unable to kill me?
’Then go die!’
The Empress was furious, and her battle prowess increased madly.
Ling Han faced her calmly. Since he had sealed himself off, he was already prepared.
A Great Emperor would definitely not be affected by any factor once he had developed some kind of self-awareness.
’Die!’
He clashed fiercely with the Empress, greatly exhausting the latter’s power of elements.
Six months, nine months.
When it was the twelfth month, even if these two people were both invincible Great Emperors, they were now at the end of their rope.
In the past eleven months, they had both been battling fiercely, and were continuously injured. Thus, they had expended a great amount of the four elements.
At this moment, they couldn’t fight any longer.
At first, the Empress had a head of raven black hair, but now, because she had expended too much energy, it had completely turned into silver silk. This gave her an unusual grace.
Unfortunately, Ling Han had absolutely no intention of admiring her beauty. To him, this was an incredibly difficult battle.
Now, they had all reached the end of their line, and both of them were only left with a single breath. It would depend on who could persist more.
"Die!" The Empress moved, her sword slashing out, still as domineering as before.
Ling Han faced this attack head-on, not backing down in the slightest.
Hong! Hong! Hong!
They exchanged blows fiercely. Both knew that the battle was already drawing to a close, and would end with the death of one of them.

Standing on the shoulder of a giant, and added with his similarly outstanding natural talent, how could he not surpass his predecessors?
In truth, it was the Empress’s disadvantage that she was the first person to become an invincible Great Emperor.
Otherwise, if there was someone to help her, she would definitely be able to construct her own heaven and earth.
Even though they were enemies, Ling Han was still filled with admiration.
"If you don’t work hard, you won’t be able to kill me!" the Star Moon Empress said calmly.
"I’ll give you one year.
If you can’t kill me within one year, I’ll charge out of here and destroy this heaven and earth!"
She said the last few words very casually, as if it would not be difficult for her to break through and escape.
This was something that even Boundless and Mysterious Clouds couldn’t do, but Ling Han was very sure that this Empress wasn’t exaggerating.
This person’s natural talent in cultivation was truly indescribably strong.

Merely from the fact that she could forcibly plunder the four elements inside Ling Han’s body, it was clear that even if she was limited by the upper limit of heaven and earth, she could still do what others could not.
With a soft exclamation, the Empress charged towards Ling Han.
With a light wave of her slender hand, at least a few hundred Heavenly Swords appeared, shooting towards Ling Han.
Each Heavenly Sword was made up of four elements, and was filled with destructive power.
In Ling Han’s heaven and earth, of course, nothing could hurt him — as long as he willed it.
However, the Empress had forcefully snatched his four fundamental elements and turned them into weapons to attack him.
This had become a situation that could not be resolved, and could only be repeated endlessly.
How was he supposed to kill her?
To say nothing of one year, he wouldn’t be able to do it even if it was 100 million years or a Stacked Era.
Ling Han frowned upon seeing this.
This was the first time he had been so helpless.

Boundless and Mysterious Clouds were both invincible Great Emperors, but the moment they entered into the heaven and earth of his inner world, they had already confirmed the time of their deaths, but in the case of this Empress, that was completely not the case.
This was undoubtedly the most powerful Great Emperor.
Hong!
Hong!
Hong!
The Empress’s counterattack became stronger and stronger.
She plundered the four elements and turned them into her weapon, using Ling Han’s own power to attack his own defence.
She herself was completely unaffected, as if she had transcended.
One month, two months, three months...
Time flew by, yet Ling Han still couldn’t find a countermeasure.
He was already in his strongest state, and he had even trapped the Star Moon Empress in the heaven and earth of his innver world.
If he still couldn’t kill her, what else could he do?
"Ling Han, you disappoint me!" the Empress said with a shake of her head.
"There are still nine months.
If you still can’t kill me, I won’t play with you anymore!"
There was a subtle change in her expression, and she was exuding a murderous aura.
This kind of her had a bit of austerity, but it did not decrease her beauty in the slightest.
Instead, she had an additional air of martial arts and dominance, which would make others submit even more.
Boom!
The Empress delivered a series of strikes with both hands.
The four fundamental elements were freely manifested in her hands, and she attacked Ling Han in a myriad of ways.
Ling Han took a deep breath.
If this continued, it was destined to be an irresolvable cycle.
He definitely wouldn’t allow the Star Moon Empress to go out and destroy this world.
Thus, he definitely had to suppress her.
Then, the first step would be to sever her communication with the four elements.

—At first, he had thought that it would be fine once he entered into the heaven and earth of his inner world, but now, he discovered that this empress was practically ten times stronger than even Boundless and Mysterious Clouds added together, oh no, a hundred times stronger!
However, he still had to think of some way to solve this problem.
If this problem was not resolved, there was no need to mention anything else.
Ling Han pondered as he fought.
Finally, he showed a hint of ruthlessness.
He was going to give it his all!
With a soft exclamation, his whole person actually began to solidify.
’Hmm?’
He was originally a spiritual body, but because this was the heaven and earth of his inner world, a single thought from him was equivalent to the highest level of heaven and earth’s will.
Thus, there was absolutely no difference whether he had a physical body or not.
Why had he suddenly materialized?
The Empress was also slightly taken aback.
Then, a look of understanding appeared on her face, "You used yourself as a prison, and locked the four elements, forcibly imprisoning them."
Pa, pa, pa!
She clapped her hands, and said, "Not bad, not bad.
This is a very good idea.
I indeed can’t extract any more of the four elements."
"However!" The Empress revealed a baleful expression, "That goes for you too!"
Ling Han used the four elements to form his body, and his original body was a prison, locking in the four elements.
This determined that even Ling Han himself could not possibly extract more of the four elements.
Once they were used up, they would be gone.
Hence, this became a battle to the death.

Ling Han had already made up his mind.

"Good!" The Empress laughed loudly, "These words are finally a little domineering!"
With a soft exclamation, she once again charged towards Ling Han.
Hong!
Hong!
Hong!
The two Great Emperors battled fiercely.
This time, it was really a close-combat battle after they ran out of ammunition.
Neither of them had the supplies of the four elements.
In that case, they had to be extremely careful.
Not only did they have to decrease the expenditure of the four elements, they also had to be careful not to sustain heavy injuries, or even light injuries.
Because one would have to expend the element of life to recover from injuries, it would have an effect on battle prowess.

chapters.title: Chapter 4911: Curtains drop
paragraphs: Fight, fight, fight. The two of them were only left with their last breath.
The Empress showed an expression of pride, and stretched out a finger to point at Ling Han, "Plunder!"

She wanted to snatch the last of the four elements from Ling Han. Though there was only a little bit of the four elements left on both sides, as long as she could snatch it, then there would be no doubt about the outcome.
She felt that it was a pity that she hadn’t been able to attain death even though she had schemed for so long.
—Just wait helplessly for death?
Heh, how could someone like her do such a thing? She naturally had her own pride. Even if she died, she would die in battle.
’I’ve already given you the best conditions, yet you’re still unable to kill me. Do you still want me to go easy on you?’
Of course not. Dying in the hands of such a person would be a humiliation!
So, go die!
However, when the Empress stretched out her hand, Ling Han also stretched out his hand, "Plunder!"
What!
The Empress faltered upon hearing this. She actually hadn’t been able to extract the four elements!
What was going on?
In an instant, she came to a realization, and couldn’t help but laugh loudly. "Not bad, not bad. Your learning ability is really strong. You’ve already grasped the essence of Plunder."
Just now, it was Ling Han who had also used Plunder, cancelling out her ability.
However, she was immediately taken aback.
"Since you have already grasped the ability to plunder, why have you still trapped yourself here?" The Empress was slightly surprised.

That was because Ling Han could completely trap her in the heaven and earth inside his inner world like how he had done at the very beginning, and use Plunder to resist her ability to Plunder. Then, she would not have the four main elements to replenish herself, but Ling Han could.
In this way, was there any doubt about the outcome of the battle?
Ling Han smiled and said, "Firstly, I only comprehended this not too long ago. Secondly, I think that this kind of battle is only fair!"

It could be said that he had only managed to reach this level because of the Star Moon Empress. From the very beginning, the Empress had wanted to make him stronger than herself, and only then would it be possible for him to kill an invincible existence like her.
But the Empress had her pride, and did Ling Han not?
Hence, even if he had grasped the ability to plunder, he did not place himself in a position of definite victory. Instead, he was fighting a fair battle with the Empress.
This was Ling Han’s Dao Heart.
"Hahahaha!" The Empress laughed loudly, then revealed an expression of pride, "All right, as expected of the one I have nurtured myself. Then let us battle!"
Boom!
She gathered the last of her power, and charged towards Ling Han.
Peng, peng, peng! The two of them exchanged blows, and after every blow, massive wounds were left behind on their bodies.
They didn’t pay any heed to this. Instead, they focused all of their power on their attacks.
As proud as a Great Emperor was, how could they possibly adopt a defensive stance?
They firmly believed that their attacks were the strongest in the world.
Peng! Peng! Peng!
After exchanging a few more blows, their bodies were already completely dyed red with blood, covered with fist-sized holes that had completely penetrated through their bodies.
At this time, they no longer had any more element of life to replenish themselves.
"The last move!" the Empress said balefully. After exchanging another blow, with their present injuries, they would definitely not be able to withstand it.
That applied to both of them.
Furthermore, with their strength, neither side would be able to dodge this move. Thus, the greatest possibility was that they would die together.
A smile spread across Ling Han’s face. Since that was the case, then so be it.
’Come!’
He took the initiative to attack, launching an attack at the Empress.
"Die!" The Empress also let out a battle cry, and charged towards Ling Han.
The two of them chose to attack, striking each other’s vital points.
It was over!
Pu!

Ling Han’s fist landed on the Empress’s chest. Under the impact of the terrifying power, it instantly covered the Empress’s body, and there was already no trace of power left in the Empress’s body, so how could she possibly resist?
Her body was glowing everywhere, as if an exquisite piece of porcelain had been shattered, and every crack was spread out chaotically.
However, the Empress’s expression instantly returned to normal. She closed her eyes in satisfaction, and her body began to shatter into pieces.
The invincible Empress had finally died.
Yet Ling Han was surprised, because the Empress’s fist had missed, and stopped right before his left forehead.
This was not a low-level error, but rather deliberate on the Empress’s part.
In this final attack, it should have been the two of them perishing together, but the Empress chose to deliberately miss, so that Ling Han could live on.
At this moment, Ling Han didn’t know what he was feeling.
"Why?" he asked.

"In my whole life, what need is there for others to yield to me, Star Moon?" The Empress released her final words. Then, her body completely shattered, turning into countless specks of light, that scattered all over Ling Han’s inner world.
Ling Han was stunned. The Empress... was still so proud!
With a thought, the seal immediately dissipated. Endless element of Life surged out, and his injuries immediately healed.
In front of him was the spiritual mark of the Empress, which was presently floating.
As long as it was released, or in fact, as long as Ling Han was willing to use the element of Life to replenish it, this supremely peerless Empress would be able to come back to life.
With such supreme talent, it was really a pity that she had died.
However, Ling Han only hesitated slightly, then stretched out a hand. Pa, the power of the four elements blasted out, completely shattering this soul imprint.
What the Empress wanted was to be freed. Otherwise, if she did not want to die, there was absolutely no way she could be dragged into his inner heaven and earth.
Thus, respecting the Empress’s choice was the greatest respect for this supreme Empress.
Ling Han sighed. One day, would he have nothing left to live for? Would he not be able to die even if he wanted to? Would he become crazy?
With his strength, it was clearly even more difficult to kill him.

"No, I have an inner heaven and earth. As long as I’m alive, the people I care about won’t die, and as long as they’re still alive, I won’t go crazy," Ling Han murmured. This was the greatest difference between him and the Empress.
With a thought, his soul returned to his body.
Weng, he opened his eyes.
"Ling Han!" Everyone rushed over. Now that Ling Han had returned, it meant one thing.
The Star Moon Empress had died.
In this way, peace finally returned to the world.
Ling Han nodded, "It’s all over."

All the Great Emperors cheered. Though the last twenty million years could be considered peaceful, the two invincible Great Emperors were still lying in ambush, so they did not dare to be careless at all. But now, they could finally let go of all their worries.
The world went back to normal.
Ling Han once again lived in seclusion. The new Emperor was in charge, overseeing the world.
Eight million years later, the Shatter Wind Great Emperor entered the Primitive Abyss, and began to continue his pursuit of the Imperial Path.

Previously, he had promised Ling Han that he would keep watch over the world and maintain order, and after eight million years, his responsibilities had been fulfilled. He had to continue his own path of cultivation.

Another 15 million years later, the Shatter Wind Great Emperor’s influence on heaven and earth had completely disappeared, and martial arts welcomed another boom. Genius prodigies appeared one after another, and a new Emperor was allowed to attain dao again.
However, in this era, an ancient Pseudo-Emperor appeared, snatching the fortune of heaven and earth, to attain Dao and become Emperor.

This person had been well-known for his viciousness in the ancient times. Afterwards, he had obtained a great opportunity, and suppressed himself. He would reappear in this era, and become the Great Emperor.
Once he became the Great Emperor, he announced all kinds of incredibly harsh rules, treating the world like a toy.
The Great Emperor should have been overseeing the world and maintaining order, yet now, he had transformed into an evil spirit. How could the world not be in chaos?
However, not too many years later, a youth directly charged into the palace of this Great Emperor, and killed this Great Emperor by force.

chapters.title: Chapter 4912: Finale
paragraphs: When the news spread out, it stunned the world.
Who was this youth? He had actually killed the Great Emperor?
The young man was carefree, and left after succeeding, leaving behind only his name.
—Ling Luochen.
Afterwards, this youth was respectfully addressed as Great Emperor Luo Chen. Every time an evil Saint wreaked havoc in the world, he would appear, and perform the duties of a Great Emperor.
Four Origin Planet.

"Father, it’s time for a replacement!" Ling Luochen shouted without any care for his image. "I’ve already guarded the world for a million years, so it’s time for Little Brother Yun, Little Brother Tong and the others!"
"Nephew!" The large black dog immediately approached him. His iron underwear was still shining brightly, and could blind anyone with its brilliance.

A vigilant expression immediately appeared on Ling Luochen’s face. This large black dog was famous for being despicable, and he had even screwed over his own people. Thus, he definitely couldn’t let his guard down.

"Tsk, tsk, tsk, what kind of expression is that!" The large black dog immediately said in displeasure, but very soon, he ignored it and continued, "Grandpa Dog has recently gained quite a bit of insight in the comprehension of the element of Creation. You see, when this is used on the Transcendent Weapon, it can strengthen the effects of the Transcendent Weapon."
"No, no, no!" Ling Luochen revealed a panicked expression. This unreliable elder was obviously going to use him as a test subject again.
He wanted to flee, but it was too late. Shua, a majestic light lit up, and then rapidly changed.
Red, orange, yellow, green, indigo, not only did the color change drastically, but the brightness was also astonishingly strong.
"Ah!" Ling Luochen hurriedly covered his eyes, but his tears couldn’t stop flowing.
"As expected, Grandpa Dog is really awesome. The improvement is successful!" The large black dog laughed loudly.
"Old Black, you’re bullying others again!" The little azure dragon walked over, accompanied by a heroic-looking woman.

"Yi!" When the large black dog saw him, he couldn’t help but feel stunned, "You, you, you, Grandpa Dog has always thought that you were gay, and deliberately wear iron underwear every day to protect my a**. I never thought that you would actually change your personality?"
The little azure dragon sneered, "Before you met me, you’ve always been this perverted!"
The heroic-looking woman smiled, and said brightly, "I am Mei Ruonan. Please take care of me."
"I will, I will." The large black dog nodded, then rubbed his chin, "Now that even the Four-Legged Snake has a wife, shouldn’t Grandpa Dog also look for a good-looking female dog?"
Just as they were speaking, Brother Monkey walked in with large strides, holding the metal rod on his shoulder.
"Uncle Monkey!" Ling Luochen hurriedly paid his greetings. Compared to the large black dog and the little azure dragon that were unreliable, Brother Monkey was much more serious.
Brother Monkey nodded, "Have you discovered any enemies that you can’t deal with?"

Ling Luochen couldn’t help but break out in a cold sweat. The line of the Battle Saint Emperor was either in battle or on the path of battle. Don’t you think that now that the world is peaceful, you should go and find a female monkey?
"We’re here!" Amidst laughter, seven babies appeared at the same time.
The Calabash Brothers were still the same. They didn’t grow up, but they didn’t age in the slightest.

They were not living creatures in the ordinary sense, but rather Source Treasures that had been birthed from the Primitive Abyss. They were completely capable of absorbing the element of Life, and possessed an endless lifespan.

"Yi, why have even the babies come?" Lin Luo descended from the skies. Behind him were Zhou Heng and Chu Hao. The three of them had long since reached the level of Pseudo-Emperor, and had attained Dao at Imperial Island.
"Is it a big day today?" Zhou Heng asked with a smile.
One after another, more people appeared, such as Jing Haoran, Shui Qingchang, Great Emperor Wu Ya, Ancestral King Lingtian, and so on.
It could be said that all the Emperor Tier-level powers had once again gathered.
At this time, Ling Han walked out, his expression slightly solemn.
This shocked everyone greatly. With Ling Han’s current strength, what else could trouble him?

chapters.title: Chapter 4913: Side Story -- City 01
paragraphs: I know that I am Ling Han, but aside from this name, why are my other memories completely blank?
Ling Han stood at the school gates in a daze, staring blankly at the words "Third High School of Zhou Su City".
"Ling Han, what are you standing here for? Let’s go in!" A seventeen or eighteen year old young man walked over and said to Ling Han.
He was... Yang Qi.
A name immediately popped up in Ling Han’s mind. Then, even more information appeared. This was his seat mate, and also his best friend.
"We have worked hard for so long. Whether or not we can enter the martial arts academy will depend on our performance today!" Yang Qi said.
"Martial arts academy?" Ling Han murmured, then the information in his mind suddenly exploded.

Fifty years ago, an astonishing change had suddenly taken place in their world. Wild beasts had mutated, and they were extremely terrifying. There were panthers that could snap an alloy in half with a single bite, golden condors that were even faster than a plane, and giant bears that had shattered a mountain with a single palm strike.
In front of such terrifying Foreign Beasts, humans appeared fragile and powerless. Unless they used nuclear weapons, even missiles could do nothing against the stronger ranks of these Foreign Beasts.

However, the heavens did not exterminate humans. This kind of mutation had happened to wild beasts, and changed humans as well. Numerous powerful cultivators had appeared, and they too could break mountains with a single punch, and firearms were ineffective against them.

After fifty years of conflict, the residential areas of the humans had already shrunk to one tenth of their original size. Only then had they barely managed to defend their territory, and the majority of their territory had been occupied by the Foreign Beasts.

Because only cultivators could stand against Foreign Beasts, the status of cultivators rose steadily. Though they were few in number, they had become the hope of humans, and occupied the dominant position.

Schools also went with the trend and increased the number of martial arts classes. As long as one performed outstandingly, they would be able to enter the martial arts academy and more elites would be nurtured for humanity.
And once one became a cultivator, that meant a great increase in social status. Thus, the students nowadays were all filled with yearning to become a cultivator.

Today, for Ling Han and the other high school students, it was the day of the martial arts test. Once they passed, they would be able to enter into the martial arts academy, and from then onwards, start a completely different life.
If they failed, they could only continue their studies. In future, if they became a white-collar worker or something, they would still be able to live a peaceful life.
If one wanted to enroll into the martial arts academy, they would have to meet all three criteria, which were power, speed, and reaction speed.
Today, students like them would undergo these three tests.

In Ling Han’s case, he was hovering around the passing line for these three indicators. Thus, whether he could pass or not would completely depend on how he acted on the spot. If he was nervous or something, which led to poor performance, he would definitely have no chance of passing.
"Alright," Ling Han said with a nod. He then entered the academy with Yang Qi.
They had not walked too far, when they heard a commotion behind them.
"Wang Hanchen!" A girl screamed shrilly, as if she had seen some superstar.
And in truth, Wang Hanchen was indeed not much different from a superstar in the Third High.
Firstly, he was extremely handsome, and was publicly acknowledged as the campus beau of the Third High.
Secondly, his old man was a deputy with real power in a certain branch of the city, and his uncle was even more impressive. He was a Level One cultivator!

There were a total of nine levels for cultivators, with Level One being the lowest and Level Nine being the highest. However, as long as one could become a cultivator, even Level One would be superior to ordinary people, and was considered a special class.
With the guidance of this uncle, Wang Hanchen also far surpassed his peers in the three indicators. It was a sure bet that he would be able to enter the martial arts academy.
With such a background, Wang Hanchen was naturally publicly acknowledged as being tall, rich and handsome.
"Ling Han, don’t be rash." Yang Qi hurriedly grabbed onto Ling Han.
’Hmm?’
Ling Han faltered for a moment. Then, new information surged into his mind. As it turned out, there was actually a grudge between him and this Wang Hanchen.
—Before the New Year, Ling Han still had a girlfriend, but Wang Hanchen had only used a little trick, and managed to steal his girlfriend away.

If that was all, Ling Han could only blame himself for being blind and falling for a materialistic girl. However, Wang Hanchen actually deliberately came over to mock him. This completely enraged Ling Han, and he came to blows with Wang Hanchen.

In terms of abilities, it was definitely Wang Hanchen that was stronger, but before he became a cultivator, this kind of strength was also limited. Furthermore, Ling Han directly exploded with fury, and actually managed to fight Wang Hanchen to the point that both sides were severely wounded.
This matter also alerted Wang Hanchen’s father, who used his authority to force Ling Han to apologize. Otherwise, the school would expel Ling Han.
Ling Han’s parents were only ordinary employees, and had no background at all. For the sake of his future, Ling Han was forced to bow his head.
From then onwards, every time Ling Han heard Wang Hanchen’s name, he would become quite agitated.
Hence, Yang Qi naturally had to hold Ling Han back, to prevent him from going up and putting his life on the line.
Today was a big day for them, so no matter what, they had to choose to endure.

Ling Han saw Wang Hanchen, and sure enough, he was tall and slender, handsome and confident. However, he clearly detested this person very much, but now, he only felt a kind of indifference, like a lion looking down on a lamb.
No matter how much you, a lamb, provoke your fellow beasts, how could a lion care?
He could just kill him directly.

He couldn’t help but find this strange. He wasn’t a high-ranking official with great power, nor was he an elite who could shatter a mountain with a single punch. Why did he feel that Wang Hanchen was extremely insignificant? Why did he not even have the right to be hated by him?
Where did he get this feeling of superiority from?
Wang Hanchen also saw Ling Han, so he deliberately turned around and walked over.

"From today onwards, I will enter the academy, and as for you—" Wang Hanchen showed a mocking smile, "I know that you are only hovering around the passing mark in the three indicators. My uncle has already issued instructions, and it is guaranteed that you will fail. There is no difficulty at all."
"Additionally, don’t even think of taking the path of arts, because your results for the National Higher Education Entrance Examination would also be a mess!"
"Are you going to ask me how I managed to do it?"
"It’s very simple, because my uncle is a cultivator!"
"Do you understand cultivators? Killing you is as simple as killing an ant!"
He said many things in a single breath, and an excited expression appeared on his face.

He had been born with a silver spoon in his mouth. Not only did his parents treat him like a treasure, but even his uncle, who had no time to marry and have children because he had been cultivating, treated him like his own son. He doted on him extremely much. When had he ever been beaten to the point of having to go to the hospital to get stitches?
How could he easily forget this enmity?
Thus, he had indeed accepted Ling Han’s apology at that time. However, he hadn’t planned to let Ling Han off the hook at all. He had only done this to make Ling Han lose hope.
"Wang Hanchen, you’re far too despicable and shameless!" Yang Qi shouted in anger. Was this really a high school student?
Just because of a fight, he was going to ruin someone’s future?
The martial arts exam, the national exam, these were two great events that would decide the fate of a young man for the rest of his life, but Wang Hanchen was about to destroy Ling Han.

It should be known that in the previous fight between the two of them, he had indeed been injured, but Ling Han was not much better off either. Furthermore, he was forced to apologize to Wang Hanchen, and pay some compensation. How could this matter still not be forgotten with that?
At the end of the day, it was also because Wang Hanchen had not only pried away his girlfriend, but also boasted proudly in front of him. Who would be able to tolerate that?

For the sake of his future, Ling Han was forced to bow his head.
From then onwards, every time Ling Han heard Wang Hanchen’s name, he would become quite agitated.
Hence, Yang Qi naturally had to hold Ling Han back, to prevent him from going up and putting his life on the line.
Today was a big day for them, so no matter what, they had to choose to endure.
Ling Han saw Wang Hanchen, and sure enough, he was tall and slender, handsome and confident.
However, he clearly detested this person very much, but now, he only felt a kind of indifference, like a lion looking down on a lamb.
No matter how much you, a lamb, provoke your fellow beasts, how could a lion care?
He could just kill him directly.
He couldn’t help but find this strange.
He wasn’t a high-ranking official with great power, nor was he an elite who could shatter a mountain with a single punch.
Why did he feel that Wang Hanchen was extremely insignificant?
Why did he not even have the right to be hated by him?
Where did he get this feeling of superiority from?
Wang Hanchen also saw Ling Han, so he deliberately turned around and walked over.
"From today onwards, I will enter the academy, and as for you—" Wang Hanchen showed a mocking smile, "I know that you are only hovering around the passing mark in the three indicators.
My uncle has already issued instructions, and it is guaranteed that you will fail.
There is no difficulty at all."
"Additionally, don’t even think of taking the path of arts, because your results for the National Higher Education Entrance Examination would also be a mess!"
"Are you going to ask me how I managed to do it?"
"It’s very simple, because my uncle is a cultivator!"
"Do you understand cultivators?
Killing you is as simple as killing an ant!"
He said many things in a single breath, and an excited expression appeared on his face.
He had been born with a silver spoon in his mouth.
Not only did his parents treat him like a treasure, but even his uncle, who had no time to marry and have children because he had been cultivating, treated him like his own son.
He doted on him extremely much.
When had he ever been beaten to the point of having to go to the hospital to get stitches?
How could he easily forget this enmity?
Thus, he had indeed accepted Ling Han’s apology at that time.
However, he hadn’t planned to let Ling Han off the hook at all.
He had only done this to make Ling Han lose hope.
"Wang Hanchen, you’re far too despicable and shameless!" Yang Qi shouted in anger.
Was this really a high school student?
Just because of a fight, he was going to ruin someone’s future?
The martial arts exam, the national exam, these were two great events that would decide the fate of a young man for the rest of his life, but Wang Hanchen was about to destroy Ling Han.
It should be known that in the previous fight between the two of them, he had indeed been injured, but Ling Han was not much better off either.
Furthermore, he was forced to apologize to Wang Hanchen, and pay some compensation.
How could this matter still not be forgotten with that?
At the end of the day, it was also because Wang Hanchen had not only pried away his girlfriend, but also boasted proudly in front of him.
Who would be able to tolerate that?

chapters.title: Chapter 4914: Side Story -- City 2
paragraphs: Ling Han, on the other hand, was incredibly calm. That strange feeling came again. No matter how Wang Hanchen jumped around in front of him, in his eyes, he was like an ant. No matter what, he could not anger him. Worse come to worst, he would just stomp him to death.

"Ling Han, I will go and take a look at your test. Haha, seeing your expression with my own eyes at that time should be very exciting!" Wang Hanchen continued to add fuel to the fire, "After four years, I will definitely be able to become a real cultivator, and you, hoho, would only be able to live at the lowest level of society!"
"You would only be able tlook up at my back, tremble, and feel extreme regret for the mistakes that you have once made!"
"You shouldn’t have offended me!"
Ling Han finally spoke up, and asked calmly, "Are you done with your performance?"
Performance?
’Do you think I’m acting for you?’
Wang Hanchen was instantly enraged. He had the urge to make a move, but he immediately suppressed the urge.
Today was the day of the martial arts test, so he definitely couldn’t allow a scandal to arise. Otherwise, even his uncle wouldn’t be able to protect him.
"You’re going to cry later!" he threw down these words, then strode off.
"How detestable!" Yang Qi said with a wave of his hand. Just then, he couldn’t help but want to charge over to pummel this b*stard.
Yet Ling Han smiled faintly, "Just a clown, no need to take it to heart."
An indescribable memory surged in his mind, and he also felt that a power was presently growing in his body, surging like the tide.

"That’s right. Don’t take it to heart," Yang Qi said with a nod. "Just focus on the test. If you panic, you’ll truly fall into his trap! Ling Han, Wang Hanchen! was definitely bluffing. Although his family has some power, it definitely won’t affect the martial arts test."
Ling Han merely smiled, and said, "All right, I know."
They entered the track and field area, where the martial arts test would be held.

Test tools had already been set up here. Because there were many people, they had to be tested in batches. One batch would be tested for power, another batch would be tested for speed, and the last batch would be tested for reaction speed.
Ling Han was first scheduled to undergo the power test, but even though they were divided into batches, there was still a long queue.
"Luo Qi, Ma Dong, Hang Xiaoming..." The examiner called out their names, and those who were called all stepped out. There were a total of ten people, and each walked to stand in front of a machine.
This was a strength tester. As long as one’s attack landed on the strength tester, the power index would immediately appear on the display screen.
"Begin."

Following the examiner’s command, the ten people immediately began to accumulate power. Then, they would either throw punches or kicks. Peng, peng, peng! A series of heavy blows were heard, and the numbers on the display screen kept changing.
As long as they didn’t stop, they could continue to attack, and the machine would only record the highest value.
"Stop." The examiner called out again, and the ten people stopped one after another. The majority looked disappointed, and only one person looked pleased.
He was the only one who met the standard.

However, it was still too early to be happy. Firstly, all three tests had to be passed, and secondly, the number of students enrolled in the martial academy was fixed every time. If there were too many people who passed the test this time, then they could only be accepted based on those who achieved the highest scores.
"Next batch, Han Yue, Zhao Tian..." The examiner was expressionless, and began to call out names again.

This martial arts test was indeed difficult. There were already sixty people who had completed the test, but there were only a mere two people who had reached the standard. Taking into account the two tests of speed and reaction speed, the passing rate might not even be 1%.
This was very normal. The enrollment rate from Third High over the years was only 1%.
When it was the ninth batch, it was finally Wang Hanchen’s turn.
Once he took the field, everyone couldn’t help but discuss. After all, this was an influential figure in the school.
Peng!
Wang Hanchen’s attack was launched, and a number immediately popped up on the display screen: 13.
Was this very low?

According to the official standards, as long as the value of 8 was given, that was the average power of an ordinary eighteen-year-old man, and when it reached 10, it would cross over into the lowest standard for the martial arts academy assessment.
13, this was an outstanding result. Even in the entire Zhou Su City, it could be ranked among the top.

Wang Hanchen also revealed a satisfied smile. He was not like others, who needed to fire a lot of punches, because his uncle was a real cultivator, and had taught him a fist technique. He only needed one punch, and he would be able to perfectly unleash the power in his body.
13, this was indeed his peak-level power.
He didn’t throw another punch. Instead, he caught sight of Ling Han in the crowd, and a mocking smile appeared on his face.
Just see, just how terrifying my power is!

As expected, everyone looked at Wang Hanchen with reverence. At present, they were still classmates, but not too long after, he would become a cultivator, and from then onwards, would be superior to ordinary people, and completely pull away from them.
However, seeing Ling Han’s expressionless face, Wang Hanchen couldn’t help but reveal a hint of disappointment.
En, he must be pretending to be tough.
Wang Hanchen nodded, thinking too highly of himself.
Fine, let’s see how long you can last.
Wave after wave of people underwent the test, and finally, it was Ling Han’s turn.
He and the other nine students stood in front of the strength tester at the same time. Then, with a command from the teacher, they could begin.
Peng, peng, peng! A great many people launched their attacks.
Ling Han wasn’t in a hurry to attack. He raised his fist, and an unfamiliar memory reverberated in his mind.
In his memories, when he threw a punch, stars would be easily shattered, as if they were made of paper.
He pushed out his fist, and his speed was very slow, it he headed towards the strength testing board.
"What is he doing?"
"Is he putting on a show?"
"Such a slow attack, is he hitting an ant?"
A great many people saw Ling Han’s actions, and they all laughed loudly.
Even if you clearly know that you can’t, and have given up on yourself, you don’t have to do this, right?
Even the invigilator at the side was slightly displeased. He had never seen someone treat the exam so passively.
Meanwhile, Wang Hanchen smirked coldly. In his eyes, this was a very normal reaction from Ling Han.
Under extreme disappointment, wasn’t it very normal to do such a thing?
However, do you think I will let you go just like that?
Wrong, I will continue to suppress you. Unless the day comes when you can no longer bear it and commit suicide, I will definitely not stop!
He was the type to seek revenge for the smallest grievance.
Right at this moment, Ling Han’s fist finally touched the strength testing board.
He really did come into contact, and did not make the slightest sound.
However, the following scene caused everyone’s eyes to pop out of their heads.

Ling Han’s fist merely touched the strength tester lightly, yet the strength tester flew up, drawing a beautiful arc in the air. Only then did it crash heavily into the sandpit, raising sand that filled the air.
There was dead silence.
’Holy f*ck! This is far too terrifying!’
How heavy was a Strength Testing Tool?

Furthermore, this thing was fixed to the ground after it had been planted. Looking at the four metal bars left behind on the ground, those were the four metal bars that were used to stabilize the strength tester, and just how wide and long were they!
What kind of power was needed to send the Strength Testing Tool flying with a single punch?
No, no, no, it wasn’t sent flying with a punch. It was just a light touch.
This was practically f***.
