chapters.title: Chapter 4915: Side Story -- City 03
paragraphs: The fist shot out, and everyone was stunned.
Had he f*cking been possessed by a cultivator, and that was why he possessed such terrifying power?
A high school senior student!
At this age, everyone’s strength was usually around 8. Those who could reach 10 had a chance of entering the martial arts academy.
But now, he had sent the Strength Testing Tool flying with a single punch. What kind of monster was this?
Meanwhile, Wang Hanchen was dumbfounded. He could not believe his eyes at all.
How could this kind of power appear on a high school student? What was even more unacceptable to him was that this student was actually Ling Han!
Am I seeing things? Am I seeing things?
That must be the case, that must be the case.
He rubbed his eyes, but what made him despair was the fact that the strength tester was still lying in a sandpit in the distance.
’Is this real?’
Heavens, heavens, was this still the Ling Han that he knew?
Impossible, he definitely could not accept this.
Meanwhile, Ling Han looked towards his teacher, "How should my results be calculated?"
The teacher was speechless. He didn’t know whether to call this brat naive or show off.
However, he immediately became troubled. Ling Han’s power had definitely surpassed the standard of entering the martial arts academy. However, how should he fill in this number?
He thought for a long time, and finally filled in the value of 99. This was the limit of the Strength Testing Tool. If it was further than this, it would reach the standard of a cultivator.
Ling Han smiled, and also walked back. He saw that every student was looking at him in shock, as if they had seen a ghost.
Indeed, this kind of performance from him was too frightening.
"W-what medicine did you take?" Wang Hanchen jumped out and pointed at Ling Han’s nose as he asked.
He definitely did not believe that Ling Han could suddenly become so powerful. He must have taken a forbidden medicine.
Ling Han humphed, and directly threw a punch.
Peng! This punch was very heavy, and Wang Hanchen instantly collapsed to the ground.
"Ling Han, you—"
Peng!
Wang Hanchen had just gotten up, and wanted to rebuke Ling Han angrily, but in the next second, he was once again beaten to the ground.
"You b@stard..."
Peng!
He got up again, but was once again beaten to the ground.
"You’re bullying me too much—"
Peng!
Every time Wang Hanchen got up, he would be knocked down by Ling Han. Everyone gritted their teeth at this sight.
Ling Han was far too domineering. He didn’t waste his breath, instead directly pummeling him.
This was a completely disdainful expression. ’I can’t even be bothered to talk to you. If I don’t like you, I can just beat you up.’
After seven consecutive times, Wang Hanchen finally learnt his lesson. He lay on the ground, neither daring to get up nor daring to speak.

His heart was filled with humiliation. His indicators had already surpassed the admission criteria of the martial arts academy, and he could be called a reserve cultivator, yet now, he had been beaten into a retard by Ling Han.
How could he accept this!
However, was that the end?
Ling Han raised his foot, peng, peng, peng, and began to kick.

On one hand, his mentality was high and lofty, and did not take Wang Hanchen seriously at all, but on the other hand, he still remembered the humiliation and pain that Wang Hanchen had caused him. How could it be resolved with a mere seven punches?
"All right, all right." The teacher at the side could no longer bear to watch, and came over to mediate.
Ling Han looked towards him. His eyes were indifferent, but there was an indescribable pressure exuding from him, causing that teacher to shiver in fear, and be unable to say another word.
He continued to pummel him.
Peng, peng, peng! Every step was incredibly firm, and Wang Hanchen could not bear it any longer. He began to wail.
At this moment, he was really scared out of his wits. He had completely lost all fighting spirit, and was like a child.
When everyone saw this, they could only inhale sharply.
This guy was too terrifying. In the academy, he publicly thrashed someone, and even the teacher did not dare to persuade him otherwise.

"How is he supposed to persuade him? Didn’t you see how Ling Han sent the Strength Testing Tool flying with a single punch? This is power that is close to the strength of a cultivator. That teacher of ours has a strength value of 20, at most. The gap is too wide."
"But if he publicly beat someone up in the academy, would he still be enrolled into the academy?"

"You don’t understand. An eighteen-year-old pseudo cultivator, just how amazing is his natural talent? When the martial arts academy knows, they’ll definitely suppress this matter and turn a big problem into a small one, and a small problem into nothing!"
"True."
Ling Han directly turned around, and walked towards the second examination location.
However, it was impossible for Wang Hanchen to go. He was severely injured by Ling Han, so what was the point of continuing the test!
The school immediately called the medical staff, and sent Wang Hanchen away. Then, they began to have a headache.
If it was just an ordinary fight, it would be easily resolved, but now?

There was no need to mention Wang Hanchen’s background. He had a father with real power, and an even more awesome uncle who was a cultivator. It was absolutely impossible that he could be allowed to be beaten up for nothing.
However, in Ling Han’s case, he was actually so powerful that he could send the Strength Testing Tool flying with a single punch. That was power on the level of a pseudo cultivator!
If they offended a future cultivator, how difficult would their future days be?
After much consideration, the higher ups of the academy still decided to give Wang Hanchen’s father a call first, and see what he planned to do.

—If the other party was also wary of the identity of cultivator that Ling Han was about to obtain, and was willing to settle the matter peacefully, then it would be easy. After all, Wang Hanchen could repeat his studies for a year, and it would be the same for him to go to the martial academy next year.

Moreover, Wang Hanchen’s uncle was also a cultivator. Who knows, he might be able to open a back door for Wang Hanchen. When he recovered from his injuries, he would arrange another examination for him.
However, when Wang Hanchen’s father, Wang Jun, heard that his son had been beaten, he immediately jumped up. He directly hung up the phone, and charged towards the school.
When he arrived, it was not Ling Han’s turn yet to undergo the second test of speed.
"Where’s the little beast that injured my son?" Wang Jun roared.
Instantly, everyone’s eyes turned towards Ling Han.
Though not everyone was familiar with this Deputy Wang, but aside from Wang Hanchen’s father, who else would come so aggressively at this time?
"It’s you!" Wang Jun stared at Ling Han, looking like he wanted to eat him alive.

On the way here, he had already found out about his son’s situation. He knew that his son’s injuries were very serious, and he would definitely miss this martial arts assessment. This was also another reason for his thunderous fury.
Once they missed the martial arts exam, they would have to wait another year, and at Wang Hanchen’s age, how could he afford a gap of a year?
And if he had to use his relationship with Wang Hanchen’s uncle, he would definitely have to use up some of his favors. That would be a great loss.
Thus, he was extremely furious. He definitely had to severely punish the person who had hurt his son.
Meanwhile, Ling Han looked towards the invigilator, "Now is the time for the exam. Shouldn’t such people who disturb order be chased out?"
"You are really arrogant!" Wang Jun strode over, "I am the deputy of the Heaven’s Gate Division, and you actually dare to make me — what are you doing?"
He hadn’t even finished speaking, when Ling Han picked him up and tossed him out.

"To say nothing of the fact that you are only a mere Deputy Minister, even if the Chief of Zhou Su City came, he would not be able to interfere with the examination of the students!" Ling Han said calmly to him.
"You—" Wang Jun’s eyes almost popped out in anger.
’You wounded my son, yet you’re still so calm?’
’You’re far too arrogant!

In the academy, he publicly thrashed someone, and even the teacher did not dare to persuade him otherwise.
"How is he supposed to persuade him?
Didn’t you see how Ling Han sent the Strength Testing Tool flying with a single punch?
This is power that is close to the strength of a cultivator.
That teacher of ours has a strength value of 20, at most.
The gap is too wide."
"But if he publicly beat someone up in the academy, would he still be enrolled into the academy?"
"You don’t understand.
An eighteen-year-old pseudo cultivator, just how amazing is his natural talent?
When the martial arts academy knows, they’ll definitely suppress this matter and turn a big problem into a small one, and a small problem into nothing!"
"True."
Ling Han directly turned around, and walked towards the second examination location.
However, it was impossible for Wang Hanchen to go.
He was severely injured by Ling Han, so what was the point of continuing the test!
The school immediately called the medical staff, and sent Wang Hanchen away.
Then, they began to have a headache.
If it was just an ordinary fight, it would be easily resolved, but now?
There was no need to mention Wang Hanchen’s background.
He had a father with real power, and an even more awesome uncle who was a cultivator.
It was absolutely impossible that he could be allowed to be beaten up for nothing.
However, in Ling Han’s case, he was actually so powerful that he could send the Strength Testing Tool flying with a single punch.
That was power on the level of a pseudo cultivator!
If they offended a future cultivator, how difficult would their future days be?
After much consideration, the higher ups of the academy still decided to give Wang Hanchen’s father a call first, and see what he planned to do.
—If the other party was also wary of the identity of cultivator that Ling Han was about to obtain, and was willing to settle the matter peacefully, then it would be easy.
After all, Wang Hanchen could repeat his studies for a year, and it would be the same for him to go to the martial academy next year.
Moreover, Wang Hanchen’s uncle was also a cultivator.
Who knows, he might be able to open a back door for Wang Hanchen.
When he recovered from his injuries, he would arrange another examination for him.
However, when Wang Hanchen’s father, Wang Jun, heard that his son had been beaten, he immediately jumped up.
He directly hung up the phone, and charged towards the school.
When he arrived, it was not Ling Han’s turn yet to undergo the second test of speed.
"Where’s the little beast that injured my son?" Wang Jun roared.
Instantly, everyone’s eyes turned towards Ling Han.
Though not everyone was familiar with this Deputy Wang, but aside from Wang Hanchen’s father, who else would come so aggressively at this time?
"It’s you!" Wang Jun stared at Ling Han, looking like he wanted to eat him alive.
On the way here, he had already found out about his son’s situation.
He knew that his son’s injuries were very serious, and he would definitely miss this martial arts assessment.
This was also another reason for his thunderous fury.
Once they missed the martial arts exam, they would have to wait another year, and at Wang Hanchen’s age, how could he afford a gap of a year?
And if he had to use his relationship with Wang Hanchen’s uncle, he would definitely have to use up some of his favors.
That would be a great loss.
Thus, he was extremely furious.
He definitely had to severely punish the person who had hurt his son.
Meanwhile, Ling Han looked towards the invigilator, "Now is the time for the exam.
Shouldn’t such people who disturb order be chased out?"
"You are really arrogant!" Wang Jun strode over, "I am the deputy of the Heaven’s Gate Division, and you actually dare to make me — what are you doing?"
He hadn’t even finished speaking, when Ling Han picked him up and tossed him out.

"To say nothing of the fact that you are only a mere Deputy Minister, even if the Chief of Zhou Su City came, he would not be able to interfere with the examination of the students!" Ling Han said calmly to him.
"You—" Wang Jun’s eyes almost popped out in anger.
’You wounded my son, yet you’re still so calm?’
’You’re far too arrogant!

chapters.title: Chapter 4916: Side Story -- City 04
paragraphs: Wang Jun naturally couldn’t tolerate this. He immediately rushed back aggressively, as if he wanted to kill.
However, he had just arrived in front of Ling Han, when he was kicked out by the latter. Peng, he turned into a rolling gourd, and instantly rolled back.
This... was too humiliating.
Wang Jun did not dare believe it. A few months ago, this young man was still trembling in fear in front of him, but just how much time had passed? He actually dared to make a move on him?
He touched his face, and saw that there was blood on his hand!
His nose was broken.
He pointed angrily at Ling Han, but did not make a sound.
What was the point of threatening him now? He was clearly unafraid of him, so no matter what he said, he would only be asking for his own humiliation.
"Good! Good! Good!" He stomped his foot, then took out his phone and began dialing.
He was going to find someone to deal with Ling Han. He did not believe that he would not be able to deal with this young man.
Meanwhile, Ling Han acted as if nothing had happened, and said to the invigilator, "The harrasser has been dealt with, so I can continue, right?"
"Continue, continue." The invigilator looked at him in shock, both impressed and worried.
Ling Han was definitely the first person to dare to go against a clan of cultivators like this. However, did he really have that much confidence?
The speed test itself was very simple. It was to run 100 meters, and one would reach the standard if they could achieve that within 10 seconds.

However, the difficulty of passing was much higher. It was not easy for even a professional jock to run the distance in less than ten seconds, what more high school students like them. Without an outstanding foundation of speed, how could they be qualified to become a cultivator?
Ling Han stood on the track, with seven other people beside him.
"Ready, run!"
With the command, Ling Han instantly charged out. Then, on the other side, the invigilator in charge of keeping time saw that Ling Han had already charged past the finishing line.
’Holy f*ck! Not even a second has passed!’
Looking at the track again, even if he had been in a daze for a while, the fastest of the other seven students had only covered one third of the distance.
Just how wide was the gap between them?
One second.
He wrote down the results under Ling Han’s name, and this was definitely not an accurate number, because he had not reacted in time at all.
It was all right. This result naturally could be enrolled into the martial academy. At that time, the academy could just do another accurate test for him.
Ling Han walked back, and naturally received a large number of stunned gazes.
This young man... was going to defy the heavens!
His power and speed had both reached the standard of cultivators. Although his reaction speed hadn’t been tested yet, who would suspect that Ling Han wouldn’t be able to pass?
Hehe, this was going to be interesting. Wang Hanchen had always strutted around in the academy, and this time, he was finally going to meet his match.
Ling Han moved towards the third testing area. Wang Jun watched helplessly, but did not stop him.

He was here, and there was no way he could escape. Furthermore, he had no wish to deal with this brat again. That guy was young and rash, and did not take authority seriously. It was best that he did not seek his own humiliation.
Ling Han arrived at the third examination area, where reaction speed was tested.
It was very simple, and that was to thrash the gophers. If he managed to hit ten of them within a minute, he would be able to reach the standard.
And how many times did gophers appear in total?
In other words, he only had to hit one-tenth of the total. This requirement was really not high.
But looking at the speed at which the gopher stretched out its head and retreated, it was guaranteed that no one would say it was easy anymore.
—The time for the gopher to appear was only 0.1 seconds!

In other words, in this short 0.1 seconds, the examinee not only had to clearly see where the gopher was poking out from, but also had to strike with the hammer in his hand in the shortest time possible. Whether it was vision, brainpower, or speed of movement that could not keep up, he would only hit empty air.
Thus, this stage not only tested one’s reaction speed, but also one’s mentality. Thus, it became the stage with the highest elimination rate.
"Ling Han!" Yang Qi had just finished this test. He waved at Ling Han, then excitedly said, "I passed, I passed. What about you? Have you taken the test for power or speed first? Have you passed?"
Ling Han broke into a grin, "I have passed both tests, and now I am only missing the final test of reaction speed."
Yang Qi clapped his hands, and said, "Haha, I knew you could do it! Your mind wasn’t disturbed by that guy, Wang Hanchen!"
This caused the people on the sidelines to grit their teeth. Wang Hanchen was disturbing Ling Han?
You probably don’t know, right? That guy had already been sent to the doctor. Even his old man had been thrashed by Ling Han.
"We’ll celebrate after the test," Yang Qi said.
"All right." Ling Han nodded.
Yang Qi left, while Ling Han queued up, preparing to undergo the final test.
This time, he didn’t have to wait for long before his name was called. He walked in front of the gopher machine.

He held a hammer in his hand, and there was no need for him to make any preparations. He tapped the start button, and instantly, the machine began to operate. A gopher popped out of one of the holes in the three-by-three grid.
Pa, Ling Han moved like lightning, and struck the gopher. The number on the counter immediately jumped, turning from zero to one.
Xiu, another gopher appeared, but Ling Han immediately struck it with his hammer.

Then, three, four, five... the numbers on the counter changed rapidly, and Ling Han’s right hand danced as if it was flying. In the eyes of an ordinary person, it was as if he had a dozen over arms, forming overlapping shadows.
Soon, a minute had passed, and the number on the counter stopped at 100.
Full marks!

This naturally stunned everyone again, but because Ling Han had already displayed terrifying abilities twice previously, everyone was prepared this time. Instead, they were not as stunned as they had been the first time they saw Ling Han send the strength tester flying.
The school immediately called the martial academy to inform them that a prodigy had appeared from their school.
Why were they in a rush to call?

Wasn’t this because Wang Jun had come? Merely the higher-ups of the Third High School would definitely not be able to deal with Wang Jun. They would have to mobilize the people from the academy. As long as any random cultivator came, they would be able to immediately make this Deputy Minister become an obedient child.
Moreover, this matter also involved Wang Hanchen’s uncle. That was indeed a matter between cultivators. When it was a clash among the higher-ups, they naturally could not afford to trifle with them.
Not long after, Wang Jun’s reinforcements arrived first.
This was a young man who looked to be in his mid-twenties. He was tall and slender, but he wasn’t thin at all. Every muscle was filled with explosive power.
"Hengming, you’re here." Wang Jun nodded, looking relieved.

This young man’s name was Li Hengming, and he was the disciple of his younger brother, Wang <anno data-annotation-id="de542c3c-fd2c-48fa-8ec2-032cd30729db" data-title="Jun">Jun1</anno>. Though he had not yet stepped into the threshold of cultivation, the gap was already very small. Furthermore, Li Hengming had been training outside the city with Wang Jun, and had killed a great many Foreign Beasts. In terms of actual battle prowess, there were some students in the martial academy that had become cultivators that were no match for him.

Li Hengming smiled, and said, "Master is presently at a crucial moment in his attempt to break through to become a Level 2 cultivator. It is possible that he would be able to succeed today, or even tomorrow, so he has sent me here to solve the problem."

chapters.title: Chapter 4917: Side Story -- City 05
paragraphs: Wang Jun was instantly overjoyed.
His younger brother had long since become a cultivator, but after so many years, he was still unable to rush up to Level 2.
It should be known that with every difference in cultivation level, the gap in strength was like the gap between heaven and earth, and that was the same for social status.
If Wang Jun advanced to Level 2, then he, as the Deputy Minister, would immediately become the Minister!
Of course, this was a matter for the future. The priority now was to deal with that little beast.
"How is Little Brother Chen now?" Li Hengming asked.
Wang Jun instantly looked furious, "Hanchen should not be able to enter into the academy this year."
Li Hengming smiled and said, "Uncle, don’t worry. As long as Master advances to Level 2, it won’t be a problem for Little Brother Chen to undergo a separate make-up exam."
"En." Wang Jun nodded, "Hengming, come with me. It is very possible that that little bastard is already a pseudo-cultivator, and cannot be underestimated."
The so-called pseudo-cultivator was a little inferior to the cultivator, but was incredibly close.

Yet Li Heng Ming smiled confidently, "There is no small number of Level 1 cultivators that have been defeated by me, and in this kind of comfortable place like the city, I would be able to fight five such pseudo-cultivators alone!"
"That’s good."
The two of them walked side by side, looking for Ling Han.
At this time, Ling Han had already arrived at the school gates. When Yang Qi came out, the two of them went to celebrate.

Wang Jun and Li Hengming searched everywhere, but they didn’t expect Ling Han to be at the school gate. Thus, when they circled a few times and confirmed that Ling Han wasn’t in the school and was about to set out in pursuit, they suddenly saw Ling Han.
"That’s him!" Wang Jun gritted his teeth as he pointed at Ling Han.

"Ling Han!" At this moment, Yang Qi also finished his examination and came out. There was shock written all over his face, and he said, "Heavens, this must be fake! I heard that you sent the strength tester flying with a single punch during the power test?"
Ling Han smiled, and said, "It’s true."
"How is this possible?" Yang Qi asked in disbelief. Others might not know, but how could he not be familiar with Ling Han?
He had become a cultivator overnight?
Wasn’t this a joke?
"You’re the criminal who injured Wang Hanchen?" A young man walked over and asked Ling Han. However, his tone was very polite.
’Criminal?’
Ling Han couldn’t help but chuckle coldly. This was truly a poisonous snake.
On the surface, he was very polite, but in truth, he had laid a trap in his words. If one was not careful, even if he was beaten up by him, it would be Li Hengming that was in the right.
—You are a criminal, so shouldn’t I have hit you?
Ling Han didn’t answer, but instead asked, "Who are you?"
Li Hengming smiled. This brat actually didn’t fall for it. Looks like his reaction speed was quite fast.
"My name is Li Hengming, and Wang Hanchen is my Junior Brother," he said calmly. "You hit my Junior Brother, so it’s not unfair for me to seek you out for an accounting, right?"
"Cultivator?" Ling Han asked casually.
Li Hengming shook his head, "I’m still a little short. However, I have killed quite a number of Level 1 Foreign Beasts."
Hiss!
Yang Qi couldn’t help but inhale sharply upon hearing this.

With the same level, the Foreign Beasts should be even stronger, because Foreign Beasts were born with sharp teeth, claws, and thick skin, and in the case of cultivators, whether it was weapons or armor, they would have to be prepared, and the construction cost of such items was exorbitantly high. It was definitely not something that every cultivator could possess.
Thus, since Li Hengming could kill a Level 1 Foreign Beast, he was completely capable of killing a Level 1 cultivator as well. In fact, it would be even easier.
He hadn’t become a cultivator yet, yet he could actually kill a cultivator?
"You’re from the army?" Yang Qi asked in a trembling voice.
The students of the martial arts academy weren’t that fierce. Only the army, who bathed in blood and fought fiercely every day, could nurture such fierce people.
Li Hengming didn’t even glance at Yang Qi. Such a measly mortal wasn’t even worthy of garnering his attention.
"Come with me." He only looked at Ling Han, and said calmly, "Don’t force me to make a move. Otherwise, you will not have a good time."
Ling Han shook his head, and said, "I’m going to celebrate now, so I don’t have time to deal with you."
Li Hengming couldn’t help but laugh in spite of himself, "Don’t you have ears? Like I said, I want to take you away."
Ling Han turned to Yang Qi, and said, "Whatever you want to say is up to you, but whether you can do it or not will depend on your own abilities. Where are we going later?"
Yang Qi couldn’t help but feel astonished. ’You’re actually thinking of going somewhere now?’
That was a soldier of the army, an existence that was just a step away from Level 1. Could you not be so careless!
"Humph, you really don’t know what’s good for you!" Li Hengming sneered, and stretched out a hand to grab Ling Han’s shoulder.
"We’re not familiar with each other, so don’t put your hand on another’s shoulder!" Ling Han said, as he stretched out a hand to slap the hand that Li Hengming had grabbed out with.
Pa!
How fast was his reaction speed and speed of attack? He accurately slapped onto Li Hengming’s hand, and instantly sent it flying.
"En?" Li Hengming couldn’t help but reveal a hint of surprise. He had not thought that Ling Han would move so quickly, and actually managed to slap his hand away.
Looks like he could not underestimate this young man too much.

"You asked for this," he said with a slight bow. He clenched his left hand into a fist, and his right hand into a palm. His entire body tensed up, and he was like a cheetah ready to pounce at any moment. He was brimming with explosive power.

"Ling Han, be careful!" Yang Qi hurriedly warned. The soldiers of the army were completely different from the students of the martial academy. The students were like flower buds that had grown up in a greenhouse, and as for the soldiers of the army? They had become stronger step by step through slaughter and bloodshed.
Peng, Li Hengming suddenly bounced off his feet, and his figure instantly shot out, his speed astonishingly fast.
Ling Han also started to move. Memories flashed through his mind, and he naturally knew how he should face such a situation.
Li Hengming attacked repeatedly, but was more and more surprised. He had thrown so many punches, yet none of them actually hit Ling Han. In fact, there wasn’t even any physical entanglement.

Furthermore, after this burst of power, his physical power was greatly exhausted. If he could not deal with Ling Han in a short period of time, he would definitely be unable to maintain the intensity of this kind of attack.
He was very experienced in battle. The moment he realized that he could not deal with Ling Han in a short period of time, he immediately slowed down the rhythm of the battle.
However, the moment he slowed down, Ling Han became even faster.
Boom, he delivered a vicious punch, the speed of his punch astonishingly fast.
Li Hengming had just slowed the rhythm, so how could he possibly immediately speed up? Thus, faced with this punch, he could no longer dodge, and could only throw out a punch to parry.
He couldn’t help but feel shocked. Could it be that Ling Han had calculated this before?
If that was the case, that would really be terrifying. He was a soldier that had been on the battlefield for a long time.
Peng!
Their fists crashed into each other. Li Hengming had raised his fist in a rush, and definitely couldn’t use his full strength. Instantly, he retreated continuously, his face flushed red.
Ling Han didn’t press his advantage. Instead, he said calmly, "I said it would have to depend on your abilities. It’s clear... that’s not enough!"

Li Hengming took a few deep breaths to adjust his condition. A solemn expression appeared on his face. This young man was very strong, and did not seem like a student at all. He was very experienced in battle.
He could not be careless, or it was really possible that he would fail.

Li Hengming smiled.
This brat actually didn’t fall for it.
Looks like his reaction speed was quite fast.
"My name is Li Hengming, and Wang Hanchen is my Junior Brother," he said calmly.
"You hit my Junior Brother, so it’s not unfair for me to seek you out for an accounting, right?"
"Cultivator?" Ling Han asked casually.
Li Hengming shook his head, "I’m still a little short.
However, I have killed quite a number of Level 1 Foreign Beasts."
Hiss!
Yang Qi couldn’t help but inhale sharply upon hearing this.

With the same level, the Foreign Beasts should be even stronger, because Foreign Beasts were born with sharp teeth, claws, and thick skin, and in the case of cultivators, whether it was weapons or armor, they would have to be prepared, and the construction cost of such items was exorbitantly high.
It was definitely not something that every cultivator could possess.
Thus, since Li Hengming could kill a Level 1 Foreign Beast, he was completely capable of killing a Level 1 cultivator as well.
In fact, it would be even easier.
He hadn’t become a cultivator yet, yet he could actually kill a cultivator?
"You’re from the army?" Yang Qi asked in a trembling voice.
The students of the martial arts academy weren’t that fierce.
Only the army, who bathed in blood and fought fiercely every day, could nurture such fierce people.
Li Hengming didn’t even glance at Yang Qi.
Such a measly mortal wasn’t even worthy of garnering his attention.
"Come with me." He only looked at Ling Han, and said calmly, "Don’t force me to make a move.
Otherwise, you will not have a good time."
Ling Han shook his head, and said, "I’m going to celebrate now, so I don’t have time to deal with you."
Li Hengming couldn’t help but laugh in spite of himself, "Don’t you have ears?
Like I said, I want to take you away."
Ling Han turned to Yang Qi, and said, "Whatever you want to say is up to you, but whether you can do it or not will depend on your own abilities.
Where are we going later?"
Yang Qi couldn’t help but feel astonished. ’You’re actually thinking of going somewhere now?’
That was a soldier of the army, an existence that was just a step away from Level 1.
Could you not be so careless!
"Humph, you really don’t know what’s good for you!" Li Hengming sneered, and stretched out a hand to grab Ling Han’s shoulder.
"We’re not familiar with each other, so don’t put your hand on another’s shoulder!" Ling Han said, as he stretched out a hand to slap the hand that Li Hengming had grabbed out with.
Pa!
How fast was his reaction speed and speed of attack?
He accurately slapped onto Li Hengming’s hand, and instantly sent it flying.
"En?" Li Hengming couldn’t help but reveal a hint of surprise.
He had not thought that Ling Han would move so quickly, and actually managed to slap his hand away.
Looks like he could not underestimate this young man too much.
"You asked for this," he said with a slight bow.
He clenched his left hand into a fist, and his right hand into a palm.
His entire body tensed up, and he was like a cheetah ready to pounce at any moment.
He was brimming with explosive power.
"Ling Han, be careful!" Yang Qi hurriedly warned.
The soldiers of the army were completely different from the students of the martial academy.
The students were like flower buds that had grown up in a greenhouse, and as for the soldiers of the army?
They had become stronger step by step through slaughter and bloodshed.
Peng, Li Hengming suddenly bounced off his feet, and his figure instantly shot out, his speed astonishingly fast.
Ling Han also started to move.
Memories flashed through his mind, and he naturally knew how he should face such a situation.
Li Hengming attacked repeatedly, but was more and more surprised.
He had thrown so many punches, yet none of them actually hit Ling Han.
In fact, there wasn’t even any physical entanglement.
Furthermore, after this burst of power, his physical power was greatly exhausted.
If he could not deal with Ling Han in a short period of time, he would definitely be unable to maintain the intensity of this kind of attack.
He was very experienced in battle.
The moment he realized that he could not deal with Ling Han in a short period of time, he immediately slowed down the rhythm of the battle.
However, the moment he slowed down, Ling Han became even faster.
Boom, he delivered a vicious punch, the speed of his punch astonishingly fast.
Li Hengming had just slowed the rhythm, so how could he possibly immediately speed up?
Thus, faced with this punch, he could no longer dodge, and could only throw out a punch to parry.
He couldn’t help but feel shocked.
Could it be that Ling Han had calculated this before?
If that was the case, that would really be terrifying.
He was a soldier that had been on the battlefield for a long time.
Peng!
Their fists crashed into each other.
Li Hengming had raised his fist in a rush, and definitely couldn’t use his full strength.
Instantly, he retreated continuously, his face flushed red.
Ling Han didn’t press his advantage.
Instead, he said calmly, "I said it would have to depend on your abilities.
It’s clear... that’s not enough!"
Li Hengming took a few deep breaths to adjust his condition.
A solemn expression appeared on his face.
This young man was very strong, and did not seem like a student at all.
He was very experienced in battle.
He could not be careless, or it was really possible that he would fail.

chapters.title: Chapter 4918: Side Story -- City 06
paragraphs: Li Hengming bent his body, like a cheetah that could suddenly attack at any time, his whole body filled with a feeling of power.

He was a pseudo-cultivator, and was only a line’s breadth away from becoming a true cultivator. However, he had rich battle experience, and had walked all the way through slaughter. In terms of sparring, he may not be as good as some Level 1 cultivators, but in terms of killing... he could crush the majority of Level 1 cultivators.
He was searching for an opening. Once Ling Han revealed the slightest bit of weakness, he would move, and knock Ling Han down with lightning speed.
"Ling Han, be careful!" Yang Qi was on tenterhooks.
This was a soldier of the army, and could be considered a killing machine. Who knew how much blood his hands had been stained with.
Ling Han looked towards him, and even nodded.
It was now!
Li Hengming immediately charged out, exploding with astonishing speed in an instant.
50 meters per second? Even faster than that!

Yang Qi was astonished. He wanted to scold Li Hengming for being despicable, yet at the same time, he also wanted to scold himself for speaking up at this moment. This had distracted Ling Han instead.
"It’s over now."
Xiu, Li Hengming had already rushed in front of Ling Han, and shot out a punch, aimed directly at Ling Han’s ribs and waist.
If this punch landed solidly, it was guaranteed that Ling Han would immediately lose all ability to resist, and would only be at his mercy.
Right at this moment, Ling Han actually turned around and smiled at him.
Li Hengming was instantly numb with shock.
You actually have the time to turn your head around at a time like this?
How had he been able to do this in time?
Instantly, his whole body was covered with cold sweat, and an extremely ominous feeling rose up in him.
Countless battle experience told him that this was too strange.
However, it was too late for him to change his move now, so he could only forge head-on.
Peng!
The punch landed solidly, and Li Hengming couldn’t help but smile again, as if a heavy burden had been lifted from his shoulders.

He was filled with confidence in himself. As long as one was hit by his punch, and it was in a position like the ribs and waist, then even a Level 1 cultivator would immediately lose the ability to resist.
So it turned out that he had worried for nothing.
However, he immediately discovered that something was off.
Something didn’t feel right.
His fist had landed on his ribs and waist, but this didn’t feel like it.
He looked down, and saw that his fist had shockingly landed on the palm of Ling Han’s hand — no, it should be said that Ling Han had grabbed his fist with his hand.
Hiss!
’How did you do it?’
Ling Han smiled, and his right hand began to exert force. Ka, ka, ka! Li Hengming’s fist bones immediately groaned.

"Wu!" Li Hengming groaned in pain, but his battle experience was extremely abundant. In the face of danger, he did not panic. Immediately, he shot out a fist, and delivered a punch right at Ling Han’s temple.
If this punch landed solidly, it would not be as simple as making Ling Han lose his mobility. He could possibly die on the spot.
"You’re seeking death!" Ling Han’s eyes turned cold, and with a tightening of his right hand, ka, ka, ka, the sound of bones breaking rang out repeatedly.
"Ah—" Li Hengming screamed tragically, even his tears spurted out. The fist he had thrown out instantly missed its target.
Ling Han gave him another push, and Li Hengming stumbled backwards.

Like a boneless snake, Li Hengming’s right arm hung down. In reality, this was also the case. With Ling Han’s move just now, the bones in Li Hengming’s entire right arm shattered into at least a dozen pieces. How could he still raise it up?
Seeing this scene, both Yang Qi and Wang Jun could not believe their eyes!

Previously, though Ling Han’s test results were very kickass, and had reached the height of pseudo-cultivator, Li Hengming was also a pseudo-cultivator In fact, he had even killed a Level 1 Foreign Beast before, and according to battle prowess, he should be able to crush Ling Han.
But what was the result?
It was Li Hengming that had suffered a terrible defeat.
Looking at the other’s right arm, it must have been broken into a great many segments, and that was why it was drooping to this extent.
Heavens, the result of this battle would actually be so one-sided. Who could believe this?
"You, you—" Li Hengming pointed at Ling Han, yet could not speak a complete sentence.
How was this possible?
He was only a high school student, so why was his battle prowess even fiercer than his?
"Scram!" Ling Han said calmly. His eyes turned to Wang Jun, and he strode over.

"You, what do you want to do?" Wang Jun showed a hint of fear. Though he had an official position, his abilities were mediocre, and could not even be considered a pseudo-cultivator. Now that he saw Ling Han approach him, how could he not be afraid?
"I am the Deputy Minister. If you dare touch a single hair on my head, that would be considered a rebellion!"
Ling Han laughed in spite of himself, "You think you’re worthy!"
He threw a punch. Peng! Wang Jun instantly collapsed to the ground, his face covered in blood.
"Ling Han!" Yang Qi walked over, his face filled with both excitement and worry.
He was naturally happy because of Ling Han’s strength, but Ling Han had also gotten into trouble.
—Hitting Wang Jun was actually a small matter, but offending a cultivator was a big issue.
Cultivators were high and noble, belonging to the true privileged class.
Ling Han smiled faintly, "Don’t worry, I know what I’m doing!"

Right at this moment, an off-road vehicle raced over, scaring the students at the school gate so much that they scattered like birds. Just as it was about to crash into the main gate, the off-road vehicle made a beautiful drift and stopped steadily.
A young man in martial arts attire walked down from the driver’s seat. His expression was sloppy, and he looked very much like a ruffian.
He looked at Ling Han and the others, and said with a smile, "Let me ask you guys, do you know a student called Ling Han?"
Yang Qi was still pondering whether this person was friend or foe, when Ling Han said, "I am."

"Oh, so you’re Ling Han." The young man nodded, and said, "I’m Shu Zhengyang from the Zhou Su Martial Arts Academy. I heard that you encountered a small problem, so I specially came to help you deal with it."
The academy!

A look of delight spread across Yang Qi’s face upon hearing this. He bowed to Shu Zhengyang, and said, "Hello, Senior Brother. My name is Yang Qi, and I’m Ling Han’s friend. We’ve indeed come across some trouble."

He spoke very quickly, and related the process of how Ling Han and the Wang Clan had become enemies. Though he did not know all the details, he was naturally on Ling Han’s side. His words were incredibly partial towards Ling Han.
Unfortunately, both Wang Jun and Li Hengming were powerless to refute. Otherwise, they would definitely curse loudly. They were the real victims, all right?

When Shu Zhengyang heard this, he revealed an uncaring expression, "It’s fine. Putting aside the fact that it is only a Level 1 cultivator, even if it was a Level 6 cultivator, he would not dare enter into the martial academy to demand someone! Thus, Junior Brother Ling, you come to the academy tomorrow. With your natural talent, the academy would definitely not mind having you enroll ahead of time."
"Of course, you still have to undergo another test."
Yang Qi was overjoyed, and he hurriedly pushed Ling Han, saying, "Thank you, Senior Brother Shu!"

Wang Jun and Li Hengming also heard this. They had secretly said that when they returned later, they would inform Wang Jun of this matter. Tomorrow, they would intercept Ling Han outside the martial academy. They definitely wouldn’t allow this guy to hide inside the martial academy.
"Senior Brother, why don’t we have a meal together?" Yang Qi invited earnestly.
"Sure!" Shu Zhengyang rubbed his stomach, "I just happen to be a little hungry."
He beckoned with his hand, "Get on."
"All right!" Yang Qi hurriedly pulled Ling Han into the car. This was the Senior Brother Disciple of the martial academy, so it would definitely be useful to maintain a good relationship with him.

chapters.title: Chapter 4919: Side Story -- City 07
paragraphs: Ling Han and Yang Qi boarded the car, and Shu Zhengyang began speeding his car again.

He was a Level 1 cultivator, and after advancing into the level of a cultivator, his reaction speed and speed far surpassed ordinary people. Thus, though he had driven the car to above 150 km/h, there was only scares but no real danger.
In the meantime, a great many police officers began to pursue them, but they were easily thrown off their tail.
They chose a hotpot restaurant, sat down, and began to eat.
Even in the dire situation of the Foreign Beasts besieging the city, food was still everyone’s keenest interest. There were the most restaurants in the city, and they had all kinds of food.
At the dining table, the three of them chatted a lot.
Actually, it was mostly Yang Qi who was asking the questions, and Shu Zhengyang was answering. These questions were mainly related to the matters after entering the academy.
When they were almost done eating, Shu Zhengyang took his leave.
He was very polite towards Ling Han, because an eighteen-year-old pseudo-cultivator was really too rare. His future prospects were boundless.
Ling Han and Yang Qi returned to their respective homes. When Ling Han’s parents found out that he had passed the martial arts test, they were all extremely excited.
This meant that Ling Han had a chance of becoming a cultivator — though this hope was very vague, and once he became a cultivator, it meant that Ling Han would become one of the privileged.

They didn’t know that Ling Han’s current strength had already reached the level of a pseudo-cultivator. Otherwise, they would definitely be even more pleasantly surprised. This meant that it was already a sure bet that their son would become a cultivator.

After passing the martial arts test, there was no need for him to go to school to attend classes anymore. Added with the fact that they had a previous agreement with Shu Zhengyang, Ling Han met up with Yang Qi on the second day, heading to the academy.
They took a bus, and after several stops, the two of them alighted. They only had to walk another 200 meters to reach the academy.
The two of them arrived at the entrance of the academy. Looking at the words "Zhou Su Martial Arts Academy" on the plaque, they both felt rueful.
In the future, they would become one of these people.
"Hey, two country bumpkins, what are you looking at?" A voice rang out from behind them.
’Hmm?’

Yang Qi immediately turned around, only to see a young man standing behind them. He was only a few years older than them, and his arms were crossed before his chest. There was a look of disdain on his face.
He was naturally defiant, and hurriedly said, "Could it be that we can’t just stand here and look?"

"This is the martial academy, a place that you can only look up to in your whole lives. Stop daydreaming." The young man waved his hand dismissively, wanting nothing more than to write the words ’disdain’ on his face.

Yang Qi was young and impetuous, so how could he withstand such provocation? "We’re third year high school students, and we’ve already passed the martial arts exam. We’ll be able to enter this place soon!"

"You have only passed the assessment, and have not been accepted into the academy." The young man scoffed, "Let me tell you, the quality of students nowadays is getting higher and higher year after year. Thus, if you have only just passed the assessment, there is at least an 80% chance that you would not be able to pass the assessment this time round!"
What!
Yang Qi couldn’t help but gape in shock and anxiety.
He indeed knew that passing the martial arts test was only the first stage. Next, enrollment in the academy would be based on merit.
If it was really as the other party had said, then he was in a tight spot.
Unlike Ling Han, who was already a pseudo-cultivator, no matter how high the standards set by the academy were, he could still pass.
"So, a piece of trash like you had best extinguish your desire to enter these doors as soon as possible," the young man said calmly. "You can’t! You’re not worthy! You’re not qualified!"
Yang Qi’s confidence had been shattered, and his expression was extremely dejected.
Ling Han shook his head, and pulled Yang Qi behind him, saying, "Whether my friend is qualified to enter this door or not isn’t up to you, nor is it any of your business."
"What is it? You want to stand up for him?" The young man glanced at Ling Han, his eyes filled with provocation.
Ling Han’s expression was calm, and he said, "We don’t know each other, yet you provoked us the moment we met. Thus, if you’re not under someone’s command, there’s something wrong with your brain."

The young man couldn’t help but feel his heart skip a beat. His guess was extremely accurate. He had indeed been commanded by someone, and that was why he had deliberately waited for Ling Han and Yang Qi today, deliberately provoking them.
He naturally would not admit it, and said calmly, "If you have the guts, then fight me. If you don’t, then just shut your mouth obediently, and be a coward!"

"Ling Han!" Yang Qi hurriedly stretched out a hand to pull Ling Han back. With Ling Han’s reminder, he also realized that there was something off with this young man. He was deliberately angering him.
Ling Han smiled, and said, "Fine, let’s fight. If you lose, apologize to my friend!"
"All right." The young man nodded first, "Then let’s sign a life-and-death contract, in case I can’t stop myself, and kill you, and still have to pay with my life!"
When Yang Qi heard this, he hurriedly went to pull Ling Han back. At this point, if he still couldn’t tell that this was a trap, then he would really be too stupid.
Ling Han’s eyes froze over. He only had to apologize to Yang Qi, yet the latter was clearly trying to take his life.
"All right!" He nodded.
The young man smirked coldly, took out a tablet computer, and handed it over to Ling Han, "Sign."
Yang Qi leaned over to take a look, and couldn’t help but feel even more furious. This life and death contract had already been prepared in advance, so wasn’t it still deliberately targeting him?
"Ling Han, you can’t fall for it," he advised.
"Don’t worry." Ling Han patted his shoulder, and said, "The mantis stalks the cicada, unaware of the oriole behind. Right now, we still don’t know who the hunter is!"
He stretched out a finger and signed his name on the tablet computer.
"Hey, hey, hey. It seems like there’s going to be a duel over there."
"What, with Ruan Zhiping?"
"He’s a third-year senior, and he’s also officially become a cultivator. Isn’t dueling with him courting death?"
"Which idiot would actually duel with Ruan Zhiping?"
At the school gate, many people saw this scene, and they were all discussing spiritedly.
Hearing everyone’s words, Yang Qi couldn’t help but feel anxious. Pointing at Ruan Zhiping, he exclaimed, "You are too treacherous!"
If they had known that he was a cultivator, Ling Han wouldn’t have agreed to a duel with him.
Though Ling Han possessed the strength of a pseudo-cultivator, but compared with a real cultivator, the gap was definitely obvious.
"Believe me!" Ling Han said to Yang Qi. "I think... I can do it!"
"Have you finished your last words?" Ruan Zhiping asked coldly. The life and death contract had already been signed, so there was no need for him to pretend any longer.
Ling Han smiled faintly, "At first, I had only planned to have you bow your head and admit your mistake, but since you are so determined to seek death, then I shall oblige you."
"Hahaha, your boasting is quite big." Ruan Zhiping sneered, and crooked a finger at Ling Han. "Come on then."
Yang Qi still wanted to persuade him, yet Ling Han resolutely pushed him aside.
He was pacing around in panic, and only now did he suddenly recall Shu Zhengyang. Hurriedly, he took out his phone and began to dial.
Meanwhile, Ling Han looked at Ruan Zhiping. With every second, unfamiliar memories would appear in his mind, and his strength was also increasing at an astonishing speed.
Today, he was at least ten times stronger than yesterday.
"Come on!" Ling Han also crooked a finger at him.
How arrogant!
Ruan Zhiping humphed, and strode towards Ling Han.
He could kill a mere pseudo cultivator with a single punch.

When they were almost done eating, Shu Zhengyang took his leave.
He was very polite towards Ling Han, because an eighteen-year-old pseudo-cultivator was really too rare.
His future prospects were boundless.
Ling Han and Yang Qi returned to their respective homes.
When Ling Han’s parents found out that he had passed the martial arts test, they were all extremely excited.
This meant that Ling Han had a chance of becoming a cultivator — though this hope was very vague, and once he became a cultivator, it meant that Ling Han would become one of the privileged.
They didn’t know that Ling Han’s current strength had already reached the level of a pseudo-cultivator.
Otherwise, they would definitely be even more pleasantly surprised.
This meant that it was already a sure bet that their son would become a cultivator.
After passing the martial arts test, there was no need for him to go to school to attend classes anymore.
Added with the fact that they had a previous agreement with Shu Zhengyang, Ling Han met up with Yang Qi on the second day, heading to the academy.
They took a bus, and after several stops, the two of them alighted.
They only had to walk another 200 meters to reach the academy.
The two of them arrived at the entrance of the academy.
Looking at the words "Zhou Su Martial Arts Academy" on the plaque, they both felt rueful.
In the future, they would become one of these people.
"Hey, two country bumpkins, what are you looking at?" A voice rang out from behind them.
’Hmm?’
Yang Qi immediately turned around, only to see a young man standing behind them.
He was only a few years older than them, and his arms were crossed before his chest.
There was a look of disdain on his face.
He was naturally defiant, and hurriedly said, "Could it be that we can’t just stand here and look?"
"This is the martial academy, a place that you can only look up to in your whole lives.
Stop daydreaming." The young man waved his hand dismissively, wanting nothing more than to write the words ’disdain’ on his face.
Yang Qi was young and impetuous, so how could he withstand such provocation?
"We’re third year high school students, and we’ve already passed the martial arts exam.
We’ll be able to enter this place soon!"

"You have only passed the assessment, and have not been accepted into the academy." The young man scoffed, "Let me tell you, the quality of students nowadays is getting higher and higher year after year.
Thus, if you have only just passed the assessment, there is at least an 80% chance that you would not be able to pass the assessment this time round!"
What!
Yang Qi couldn’t help but gape in shock and anxiety.
He indeed knew that passing the martial arts test was only the first stage.
Next, enrollment in the academy would be based on merit.
If it was really as the other party had said, then he was in a tight spot.
Unlike Ling Han, who was already a pseudo-cultivator, no matter how high the standards set by the academy were, he could still pass.
"So, a piece of trash like you had best extinguish your desire to enter these doors as soon as possible," the young man said calmly.
"You can’t!
You’re not worthy!
You’re not qualified!"
Yang Qi’s confidence had been shattered, and his expression was extremely dejected.
Ling Han shook his head, and pulled Yang Qi behind him, saying, "Whether my friend is qualified to enter this door or not isn’t up to you, nor is it any of your business."
"What is it?
You want to stand up for him?" The young man glanced at Ling Han, his eyes filled with provocation.
Ling Han’s expression was calm, and he said, "We don’t know each other, yet you provoked us the moment we met.
Thus, if you’re not under someone’s command, there’s something wrong with your brain."
The young man couldn’t help but feel his heart skip a beat.
His guess was extremely accurate.
He had indeed been commanded by someone, and that was why he had deliberately waited for Ling Han and Yang Qi today, deliberately provoking them.
He naturally would not admit it, and said calmly, "If you have the guts, then fight me.
If you don’t, then just shut your mouth obediently, and be a coward!"
"Ling Han!" Yang Qi hurriedly stretched out a hand to pull Ling Han back.
With Ling Han’s reminder, he also realized that there was something off with this young man.
He was deliberately angering him.
Ling Han smiled, and said, "Fine, let’s fight.
If you lose, apologize to my friend!"
"All right." The young man nodded first, "Then let’s sign a life-and-death contract, in case I can’t stop myself, and kill you, and still have to pay with my life!"
When Yang Qi heard this, he hurriedly went to pull Ling Han back.
At this point, if he still couldn’t tell that this was a trap, then he would really be too stupid.
Ling Han’s eyes froze over.
He only had to apologize to Yang Qi, yet the latter was clearly trying to take his life.
"All right!" He nodded.
The young man smirked coldly, took out a tablet computer, and handed it over to Ling Han, "Sign."
Yang Qi leaned over to take a look, and couldn’t help but feel even more furious.
This life and death contract had already been prepared in advance, so wasn’t it still deliberately targeting him?
"Ling Han, you can’t fall for it," he advised.
"Don’t worry." Ling Han patted his shoulder, and said, "The mantis stalks the cicada, unaware of the oriole behind.
Right now, we still don’t know who the hunter is!"
He stretched out a finger and signed his name on the tablet computer.
"Hey, hey, hey.
It seems like there’s going to be a duel over there."
"What, with Ruan Zhiping?"
"He’s a third-year senior, and he’s also officially become a cultivator.
Isn’t dueling with him courting death?"
"Which idiot would actually duel with Ruan Zhiping?"
At the school gate, many people saw this scene, and they were all discussing spiritedly.
Hearing everyone’s words, Yang Qi couldn’t help but feel anxious.
Pointing at Ruan Zhiping, he exclaimed, "You are too treacherous!"
If they had known that he was a cultivator, Ling Han wouldn’t have agreed to a duel with him.
Though Ling Han possessed the strength of a pseudo-cultivator, but compared with a real cultivator, the gap was definitely obvious.
"Believe me!" Ling Han said to Yang Qi.
"I think...
I can do it!"
"Have you finished your last words?" Ruan Zhiping asked coldly.
The life and death contract had already been signed, so there was no need for him to pretend any longer.
Ling Han smiled faintly, "At first, I had only planned to have you bow your head and admit your mistake, but since you are so determined to seek death, then I shall oblige you."
"Hahaha, your boasting is quite big." Ruan Zhiping sneered, and crooked a finger at Ling Han.
"Come on then."
Yang Qi still wanted to persuade him, yet Ling Han resolutely pushed him aside.
He was pacing around in panic, and only now did he suddenly recall Shu Zhengyang.
Hurriedly, he took out his phone and began to dial.
Meanwhile, Ling Han looked at Ruan Zhiping.
With every second, unfamiliar memories would appear in his mind, and his strength was also increasing at an astonishing speed.
Today, he was at least ten times stronger than yesterday.
"Come on!" Ling Han also crooked a finger at him.
How arrogant!
Ruan Zhiping humphed, and strode towards Ling Han.
He could kill a mere pseudo cultivator with a single punch.

chapters.title: Chapter 4920: Side Story -- City 08
paragraphs: A fight was about to break out, and it was a duel at that.
All of a sudden, the martial academy’s students all gathered around, preparing to watch the excitement.
Ruan Zhiping didn’t unleash his full speed, but he didn’t slow down either. He quickly approached Ling Han, then suddenly threw a punch at Ling Han.
This punch was aimed directly at Ling Han’s head. This was obviously aiming to take his life.
Bursting his head with a single punch!
In this instant, countless memories appeared in Ling Han’s mind. Then, his eyes suddenly lit up, as if a bolt of lightning had flashed across a sunny day.
Ruan Zhiping was actually shocked by this gaze, and involuntarily stopped.
Then, he flew into a humiliated rage.
He was a Level 1 cultivator, and he had killed Foreign Beasts outside the city before, so his hands were covered in blood.
But now, he was actually intimidated by a single look from Ling Han. This was really utterly humiliating.
Aside from feeling angry and embarrassed, he also did not understand why an ordinary high school student would actually possess such a terrifying gaze.
At this moment, Ling Han threw a punch at Ruan Zhiping.
This punch looked very ordinary in the eyes of others, extremely ordinary, but Ruan Zhiping’s feeling was completely different.
He felt as if all his paths of retreat had been cut off, and he couldn’t even parry.
It was as if this punch was destined, and the only thing he could do was take this punch.
Peng!

With this punch, Ruan Zhiping seemed to have become stupid. He did not know how to dodge, nor did he know how to parry. Naturally, he could only be hit by the punch. His whole person was sent flying, and he was sent flying at an incredibly fast speed.
There was a loud bang, and his head crashed into the doors of the academy. A terrifying power exploded, and his head was instantly shattered.
What!
Seeing this scene, the surrounding students were all dumbfounded.

Though signing a life-and-death contract was naturally taking responsibility for one’s own life, the majority of duels would not result in death. As long as one admitted defeat in time, though it was possible that one would be injured or crippled, he was completely capable of preserving his life.
Thus, the sudden death of this person was far beyond everyone’s expectations.
All of this happened too quickly. It was only a single punch, and Ruan Zhiping had already died. The strength of both sides were on completely different levels.
Why?
Ruan Zhiping seemed to have become stupid. He did not dodge or parry this punch, as if he was deliberately giving up his life.
They had seen people who gifted gifts, gave money, or even actually gave their wives away, but to deliberately give their lives... this was really something they had never seen before.
Everyone whispered among themselves, all talking about their own shock. This was really too baffling.
Only Yang Qi wore an expression of pleasant surprise. He hadn’t imagined that Ling Han would not only win, but also win so easily.
He clenched his fists tightly, appearing to be extremely excited.
Though Ling Han had killed someone in public, both parties had signed a life and death contract. This had a legal effect. No one could cause trouble for Ling Han because of this.

However, he was also extremely shocked. Yesterday, Ling Han had only defeated a pseudo-cultivator, yet today, he had easily insta-killed a Level 1 cultivator. Then, would he be able to defeat a Level 2 tomorrow, and a Level 1 the day after?
As Ling Han’s friend, he knew Ling Han best, but it was precisely because of this that he realized that he didn’t know Ling Han at all.
"To dare commit murder in front of the academy gates of the martial academy, Ling Han, how dare you!" A voice rang out behind Ling Han, carrying an incredibly harsh tone.
Ling Han looked over, only to see four people walking toward him. However, one of them was sitting in a wheelchair.
That was Wang Hanchen. Aside from him, there was also Wang Jun and Li Hengming — their right arms were heavily bandaged.
There was only one person that Ling Han had never seen before. This person looked to be in his thirties, and was not very tall, but his whole person exuded an indescribable feeling of power.
Wang Jun, Wang Jun’s younger brother, a Level 1 cultivator!
No, he had completed the breakthrough from Level 1 to Level 2 last night, and was already a Level 2 cultivator. It was just that he had not reported this to the military yet.
It was him who had spoken just now, his expression baleful and menacing, filled with killing intent.
Yang Qi hurriedly defended Ling Han and said, "Ling Han and Ruan Zhiping signed a life and death contract. Even if someone died in battle, that would be their own responsibility."
"Oh, where’s the life-and-death contract?" Wang Jun asked calmly, but his eyes were incredibly vicious.
Yang Qi hurriedly picked up the tablet computer. However, after flipping through it for a while, his expression changed drastically.
The life and death contract had disappeared!
How was this possible? He had clearly seen clearly just now that no one had approached the tablet at all. It was definitely impossible for anyone to have erased it.
"What is it? You can’t find it?" Wang Jun smirked coldly, "I am a member of the military. When I encounter a criminal who commits murder in public, I can execute him on the spot!"
"No, there is a life-and-death contract. Let me search again!" Yang Qi hurriedly said. He started to search on the tablet again.

"There’s no need to look," Ling Han said. Then, he looked at Wang Jun, and said, "That idiot just now should have come to provoke us under your command. If I was beaten to death by him, the life and death contract would exist in this computer. On the other hand... you would be able to control it from afar and erase that life and death contract, right?"
Yang Qi instantly became anxious upon hearing this. This was far too despicable!
Wang Jun faltered slightly. He had not thought that Ling Han would react so quickly.
He naturally wouldn’t admit it. He merely sneered, and walked towards Ling Han.

There was no life or death contract — then it was definitely impossible to find. It had indeed been erased through remote control, and it was definitely impossible to recover. Thus, Ling Han was a murderer. As a member of the military, he naturally had every reason to make a move.
Though Ling Han’s victory had surprised him slightly, and in fact, he had even insta-killed Ruan Zhiping with a single punch, he was still a Level 2 cultivator.
What kind of concept was this?
Completely suppressing a Level 1 cultivator!
Thus, he was naturally filled with confidence, and did not think at all that he would not be able to kill Ling Han.
"Ling Han, do you regret it now?" Wang Hanchen said through gritted teeth. "My uncle officially advanced to Level 2 last night. In front of him, you can’t even withstand a single blow!"
What!
Yang Qi’s eyes instantly widened in shock. ’Level 2! He’s actually a Level 2!’
In his eyes, a Level 1 cultivator was like an Immortal. A Level 2 cultivator was an unimaginable existence.
Though Ling Han’s performance just now had been extraordinary, faced with a Level 2 cultivator... it was completely impossible for him to have any hope of winning.
Where was Shu Zhengyang? Why hadn’t he come yet?
Now, he could only place his hopes on this Senior Brother.
Ling Han smiled at Yang Qi, and said, "There’s no need to be so tense. He’s merely a Level 2 cultivator."
A mere Level 2?
Wang Jun raised a brow, "How boastful. In your eyes, a Level 2 cultivator is only worthy of the evaluation of ’merely’! Fine, I’ll let you see how powerful a mere Level 2 cultivator can be!"

"Ling Han, regret it in hell!" Wang Hanchen shouted loudly. At present, his hatred towards Ling Han could not be described with words. Thus, though his injuries were extremely severe, he still insisted on personally witnessing Ling Han’s death.

Wang Jun and Li Hengming both smirked coldly. Wang Jun had moved, and Ling Han’s only fate would definitely be death. Furthermore, Wang Jun was in the right now. Even if he killed Ling Han in public, that would be considered within reason and legal anywhere.

As expected, the older one was, the wiser they were. They had initially thought that it was superfluous for Wang Jun to plant the virus in Ruan Zhiping’s computer, but who would have thought that it would have such an amazing effect now?
By the looks of it now, this step was truly amazing.
