chapters.title: Chapter 4921: Side Story -- City 09
paragraphs: Hearing such boastful words from Ling Han, the students at the entrance were also stunned.
A Level 2 cultivator, what kind of concept was that?
Was it difficult to become a cultivator?
It would be difficult!

Being accepted into the martial academywas only the first step. Moreover, only 30% of the students could become pseudo-cultivators in their second year of university, and only 10% of the students could truly become cultivators in their third year.

It could be said that the majority of students would only be pseudo cultivators when they graduated in their fourth year. They would need to fight in actual battle for many years, and only then would it be possible for them to become a cultivator.
A Level 1 cultivator!
With this in mind, just how valuable was a Level 2 cultivator?

Of course, there were prodigies everywhere. For example, in the academy of Zhou Su City’s martial arts academy, there were also Level 2 or even Level 3 students, but this was really an existence as rare as phoenix feathers and unicorn horns. There were pitifully few of them. Once they graduated, they would definitely directly enter into an important position in the army.
Thus, Ling Han actually boldly declared that he was merely a Level 2 cultivator. How could this not make people laugh their heads off?
’Oh, do you think that just because you killed a Level 1 cultivator, you can look down on Level 2 cultivators?’
How naive. A Level 2 cultivator could completely crush a Level 1 cultivator; there was no comparison at all!
There were nine levels in cultivation, and every difference of a single level was like the distance between heaven and earth.

Wang Jun walked towards Ling Han. His speed was very slow, but his steps were very steady, exuding a terrifying pressure. He was like a fierce tiger that had set its eyes on its prey, causing its prey to not even have the thought of fleeing.
Even the faces of the surrounding students had turned pale, and they all stepped back.
They were shocked. This was a Level 2 cultivator; he was too terrifying.

And it should be known that Wang Jun was not as simple as any Level 2 cultivator. He had also fought his way out of seas of corpses and blood, which naturally formed killing intent. It was almost tangible, and could be intimidating.
He deliberately walked very slowly. This was exerting pressure on Ling Han. If Ling Han’s willpower was slightly weaker, he might even directly collapse from fright.
However, Ling Han remained calm and composed.

In the memories that he suddenly recalled, even a great elite that could shatter a planet with a single punch could only be shattered with a single thought from him. Calling a Level 2 cultivator ’merely’ was really not a boast, but merely the truth.
"Pretentious!" Wang Jun sneered, and suddenly sped up, charging towards Ling Han.
So fast!
Everyone felt their vision blur, and saw that Wang Jun had already rushed in front of Ling Han, his fist blasting towards the top of Ling Han’s head.
Hiss, was this the speed of a Level 2 cultivator?
A Level 1 cultivator couldn’t compare at all. If it was any of them, they wouldn’t even know how they had died.
Sigh, Ling Han was definitely done for.

Furthermore, the life and death contract had mysteriously disappeared. Even if Ling Han died, he would have died for nothing. In fact, Wang Jun’s actions to execute him could be considered a meritorious service.
Boom, the punch had already arrived.
Ling Han didn’t even blink as he stared at Wang Jun. This was truly an ant.
The punch arrived, yet it came to an abrupt stop.
—It was blocked by a single finger.
’Holy f*ck!’
Seeing this scene, everyone was numb with shock.
How was this possible?
The attack of a Level 2 cultivator was actually blocked by a single finger.
Was this for real?
’Are you two sure you’re not putting on an act together?’
Wang Jun was also incredibly stunned. He hadn’t used his full strength in this punch, but he had already advanced into Level 2. This punch could still insta-kill a Level 1.
Could it be that... Ling Han was also a Level 2?
Hiss, this guy was pretending to be a pig to eat a tiger. He was really hiding too deeply, wasn’t he?
Wang Jun, Wang Hanchen and Li Hengming’s eyes also widened. They felt like their outlook on life was about to collapse.
Especially Wang Jun and his son. It should be known that a year ago, they had personally witnessed Ling Han humiliatingly apologize to them.
It had only been a year, and this young man had gone from an ordinary person to a Level 2 cultivator?
Who could believe this?
This was practically a freak.

If he had known this earlier, then no matter how lecherous Wang Hanchen was, he would not have had any designs on Ling Han’s girlfriend — to steal the woman of a Level 2 cultivator, just how bold was he?
Wang Jun calmed down, and immediately cast aside the doubts and reservations in his heart.
Now that things had come to this, it was inevitable that the arrow was already drawn.
If he didn’t kill Ling Han this time, just how powerful would Ling Han be in another year or two?
Level 3? Level 4?

Thus, taking advantage of the fact that Ling Han wasn’t especially strong yet, and with the evidence of him "committing a crime in public" in his hands, this was the best chance to settle the matter once and for all. Otherwise, in future, the Wang Clan would have to worry about Ling Han taking revenge on them.
’Die!’
He roared softly, and suddenly drew his saber.

This was a curved blade. It wasn’t long, and the blade was only about a foot long. However, it was forged from super-fitted steel, and was extremely sharp. Even the thick skin of a Level 1 Foreign Beast, the Iron Bull Rhinoceros, could be easily sliced open.
Cultivators were very proficient at earning money, and Wang Jun spent most of his income on this saber.
Having spent so much money, it was naturally worth it.
Die!
Shua, a cold light flashed, and the curved saber swept towards Ling Han’s lower abdomen, intending to disembowel Ling Han.
Ling Han still had his hands behind his back, looking calm and composed.
’Haha, you’re far too arrogant and haughty. You’re seeking death!’
Wang Jun smirked coldly. With his incredibly rich battle experience, he was 100% sure that Ling Han was already a corpse.
However, an instant later, he shockingly discovered that his hand seemed to have fallen into iron pincers, and could no longer move.
He looked down, and saw that the thin blade had been caught between two fingers.
Heavens!
He was absolutely stunned, but the countless battles caused him to instinctively react. With a twist of his hand, the blade sliced towards Ling Han’s fingers.
At this moment, it was as if he could already foresee Ling Han’s fingers falling off, one after another.
However, he shockingly discovered that the saber’s blade did not move in the slightest.
Hiss, what kind of terrifying power was this?
It was just a pinch between two fingers, but it was like the blade had grown roots, and could not be moved in the slightest.
How was this possible?
This time, Wang Jun was really shocked to the core. He had used his full strength in that attack just now, and added with the help of his weapon, he actually still did not succeed.
His power could be ranked in the late stage of Level 2, or even Level 3!
A high school student actually possessed such terrifying abilities. Who would believe it? Who would dare believe it?
Not only Wang Jun, but the others were also numb with shock. They could barely believe their eyes.
This was heaven-defying. This was heaven-defying!

Wang Jun resolutely abandoned his saber. At this moment, they were too close, so whether it was his fist or palm, it was not easy to exert force. He immediately bent his arm, and at the same time, took a step forwards with his right foot, using his elbow to crash towards Ling Han’s abdomen.
This was the display of battle experience, making the most correct choice in a split second.
Peng!

However, Ling Han raised his foot, and Wang Jun was sent flying. Then, he fell heavily onto the ground, coughing up large mouthfuls of blood, right until he spat out his internal organs. He collapsed dejectedly, his eyes still wide open.

He had died with remaining grievances. He had definitely died with remaining grievances. It should be known that he had just broken through to Level 2, and had initially been about to walk to a new height. Who would have thought that his life would suddenly end like this?

sentences.text: Hearing such boastful words from Ling Han, the students at the entrance were also stunned.
A Level 2 cultivator, what kind of concept was that?
Was it difficult to become a cultivator?
It would be difficult!
Being accepted into the martial academywas only the first step.
Moreover, only 30% of the students could become pseudo-cultivators in their second year of university, and only 10% of the students could truly become cultivators in their third year.
It could be said that the majority of students would only be pseudo cultivators when they graduated in their fourth year.
They would need to fight in actual battle for many years, and only then would it be possible for them to become a cultivator.
A Level 1 cultivator!
With this in mind, just how valuable was a Level 2 cultivator?
Of course, there were prodigies everywhere.
For example, in the academy of Zhou Su City’s martial arts academy, there were also Level 2 or even Level 3 students, but this was really an existence as rare as phoenix feathers and unicorn horns.
There were pitifully few of them.
Once they graduated, they would definitely directly enter into an important position in the army.
Thus, Ling Han actually boldly declared that he was merely a Level 2 cultivator.
How could this not make people laugh their heads off?
’Oh, do you think that just because you killed a Level 1 cultivator, you can look down on Level 2 cultivators?’
How naive.
A Level 2 cultivator could completely crush a Level 1 cultivator; there was no comparison at all!
There were nine levels in cultivation, and every difference of a single level was like the distance between heaven and earth.
Wang Jun walked towards Ling Han.
His speed was very slow, but his steps were very steady, exuding a terrifying pressure.
He was like a fierce tiger that had set its eyes on its prey, causing its prey to not even have the thought of fleeing.
Even the faces of the surrounding students had turned pale, and they all stepped back.
They were shocked.
This was a Level 2 cultivator; he was too terrifying.
And it should be known that Wang Jun was not as simple as any Level 2 cultivator.
He had also fought his way out of seas of corpses and blood, which naturally formed killing intent.
It was almost tangible, and could be intimidating.
He deliberately walked very slowly.
This was exerting pressure on Ling Han.
If Ling Han’s willpower was slightly weaker, he might even directly collapse from fright.
However, Ling Han remained calm and composed.
In the memories that he suddenly recalled, even a great elite that could shatter a planet with a single punch could only be shattered with a single thought from him.
Calling a Level 2 cultivator ’merely’ was really not a boast, but merely the truth.
"Pretentious!" Wang Jun sneered, and suddenly sped up, charging towards Ling Han.
So fast!
Everyone felt their vision blur, and saw that Wang Jun had already rushed in front of Ling Han, his fist blasting towards the top of Ling Han’s head.
Hiss, was this the speed of a Level 2 cultivator?
A Level 1 cultivator couldn’t compare at all.
If it was any of them, they wouldn’t even know how they had died.
Sigh, Ling Han was definitely done for.
Furthermore, the life and death contract had mysteriously disappeared.
Even if Ling Han died, he would have died for nothing.
In fact, Wang Jun’s actions to execute him could be considered a meritorious service.
Boom, the punch had already arrived.
Ling Han didn’t even blink as he stared at Wang Jun.
This was truly an ant.
The punch arrived, yet it came to an abrupt stop.
—It was blocked by a single finger.
’Holy f*ck!’
Seeing this scene, everyone was numb with shock.
How was this possible?
The attack of a Level 2 cultivator was actually blocked by a single finger.
Was this for real?
’Are you two sure you’re not putting on an act together?’
Wang Jun was also incredibly stunned.
He hadn’t used his full strength in this punch, but he had already advanced into Level 2.
This punch could still insta-kill a Level 1.
Could it be that...
Ling Han was also a Level 2?
Hiss, this guy was pretending to be a pig to eat a tiger.
He was really hiding too deeply, wasn’t he?
Wang Jun, Wang Hanchen and Li Hengming’s eyes also widened.
They felt like their outlook on life was about to collapse.
Especially Wang Jun and his son.
It should be known that a year ago, they had personally witnessed Ling Han humiliatingly apologize to them.
It had only been a year, and this young man had gone from an ordinary person to a Level 2 cultivator?
Who could believe this?
This was practically a freak.

If he had known this earlier, then no matter how lecherous Wang Hanchen was, he would not have had any designs on Ling Han’s girlfriend — to steal the woman of a Level 2 cultivator, just how bold was he?
Wang Jun calmed down, and immediately cast aside the doubts and reservations in his heart.
Now that things had come to this, it was inevitable that the arrow was already drawn.
If he didn’t kill Ling Han this time, just how powerful would Ling Han be in another year or two?
Level 3?
Level 4?

Thus, taking advantage of the fact that Ling Han wasn’t especially strong yet, and with the evidence of him "committing a crime in public" in his hands, this was the best chance to settle the matter once and for all.
Otherwise, in future, the Wang Clan would have to worry about Ling Han taking revenge on them.
’Die!’
He roared softly, and suddenly drew his saber.
This was a curved blade.
It wasn’t long, and the blade was only about a foot long.
However, it was forged from super-fitted steel, and was extremely sharp.
Even the thick skin of a Level 1 Foreign Beast, the Iron Bull Rhinoceros, could be easily sliced open.
Cultivators were very proficient at earning money, and Wang Jun spent most of his income on this saber.
Having spent so much money, it was naturally worth it.
Die!
Shua, a cold light flashed, and the curved saber swept towards Ling Han’s lower abdomen, intending to disembowel Ling Han.
Ling Han still had his hands behind his back, looking calm and composed.
’Haha, you’re far too arrogant and haughty.
You’re seeking death!’
Wang Jun smirked coldly.
With his incredibly rich battle experience, he was 100% sure that Ling Han was already a corpse.
However, an instant later, he shockingly discovered that his hand seemed to have fallen into iron pincers, and could no longer move.
He looked down, and saw that the thin blade had been caught between two fingers.
Heavens!
He was absolutely stunned, but the countless battles caused him to instinctively react.
With a twist of his hand, the blade sliced towards Ling Han’s fingers.
At this moment, it was as if he could already foresee Ling Han’s fingers falling off, one after another.
However, he shockingly discovered that the saber’s blade did not move in the slightest.
Hiss, what kind of terrifying power was this?
It was just a pinch between two fingers, but it was like the blade had grown roots, and could not be moved in the slightest.
How was this possible?
This time, Wang Jun was really shocked to the core.
He had used his full strength in that attack just now, and added with the help of his weapon, he actually still did not succeed.
His power could be ranked in the late stage of Level 2, or even Level 3!

Then, he fell heavily onto the ground, coughing up large mouthfuls of blood, right until he spat out his internal organs.
He collapsed dejectedly, his eyes still wide open.
He had died with remaining grievances.
He had definitely died with remaining grievances.

chapters.title: Chapter 4922: Side Story -- City 10
paragraphs: Ling Han’s actions were incredibly simple. He merely stretched out his hand, kicked out his foot, and then a Level 2 cultivator died.
What did this mean?
He was completely overwhelmed by his abilities!
Heavens, then what level was Ling Han?
Late stage of Level 2? Or even... Level 3?
It should be known that he was only a high school senior student.
Everyone was transfixed with shock. They couldn’t believe their eyes.
Heavens! Heavens! Heavens!

Meanwhile, Wang Jun and his son were trembling in fear. Wang Jun’s death was equivalent to Wang Jun having one less pillar of <anno data-annotation-id="007e8bea-1803-4e85-a825-213d8314f73a" data-title="support">support1</anno>. The sky was about to collapse.
Why was it like this?
At this moment, Wang Jun really wanted to beat his son to death. Why did this idiot have to become enemies with Ling Han?

Now, it was great. Wang Jun was dead, and Wang Hanchen’s chance of entering the academy this year was also gone. In fact, his chance of entering the academy would be gone forever. Then, would the Wang Clan still have any hope of rising?
Without the support of Wang Jun, how long could he continue to be the Deputy Minister?
There were a great many people who were envious and wanted to replace him.
At this time, Ling Han turned his eyes towards this father and son pair and Li Hengming.
"I have already spared your lives, yet you all are still so overbearing. Do you think that I am an easy target to bully?" His baleful voice rang out, as he walked towards the three of them.
"You, you, what do you want to do?" Wang Jun asked in a trembling voice.
"I’ll send you on your way!" Ling Han raised his fist.

"No, you can’t kill us! To commit a crime in public, you have completely no regard for the law, so don’t even think about living!" Wang Jun shouted loudly. In order to survive, he had overcome the fear in his heart.
Ling Han smiled faintly and said, "I’ve already committed murder, so what difference does it make if I kill one more or one less?"

"Run!" Wang Jun hurriedly turned around and ran, and Li Hengming’s speed was much faster than his. After all, he was a pseudo-cultivator. However, it was hard on Wang Hanchen. How could he flee in a wheelchair? He could only use both hands to push the wheels.
Needless to say, humans could unleash astonishing potential when they were seeking survival. Wang Hanchen was actually quite fast in pushing the wheelchair.
However, what use was this?

Ling Han made his move. Peng! Peng! Peng! With three punches, Wang Jun and his son, as well as Li Hengming, all collapsed onto the ground. There was an obvious indentation on their backs, and it was obvious that their hearts had all exploded.
It hadn’t been long, and five people had already died by his hand. In fact, there were two cultivators and one pseudo-cultivator among them.
At the entrance, everyone was as silent as cicadas in the cold, completely rendered speechless.
"How dare you, to actually commit a crime in front of the academy gates!" A baleful voice rang out, carrying a strong displeasure.
Ling Han turned around, only to see a group of four people walking out the main doors. One of them was none other than Shu Zhengyang.
"Administrative members of the student union!"
"The Vice-President, Zhou Zheng!"
"Administrative, Shu Zhengyang."
"Administrative, Lin Ce."
The students spoke one after another, looking reverent.
The student union of the martial arts academy would be completely different from the student unions of other academies. The requirements for acceptance were much higher.

First of all, only cultivators were qualified to enter, and this alone was enough to make 90% of students not qualified to enter the student union even until graduation. As for other requirements, there were even more.
In short, being able to enter into the student union represented outstanding strength.
Thus, the vice-president and staff members of the student union were naturally even more awesome.
Shu Zhengyang was also stunned, as well as feeling very awkward.

Previously, when he had received news from Yang Qi, he had coincidentally been in the student union for a meeting. Thus, he had not paid much attention at first. It was only when Yang Qi had announced that someone was about to die, that he ran out.
He was afraid that he wouldn’t be able to suppress Wang Jun, so he also brought out the Vice-President and the others. In the end, he saw Ling Han committing a crime.
How could he bear with that?
Ling Han looked towards Zhou Zheng. It was him that had shouted at him just now.

"These people are scheming against me. You’ll find out after some investigation," he said calmly. "Before finding out the truth of the matter, don’t use your own justifications to randomly accuse others."

"Impudence! No matter how many reasons you have, you are not allowed to commit murder in front of the academy gates!" Zhou Zheng said balefully. "Are you going to surrender yourself, or do I have to move to apprehend you?"
"Senior Brother Zhou is about to make a move!"
"In the academy, it is already very rare to see Senior Brother Zhou making a move."
"Hehe, Senior Brother Zhou is a Level 3 cultivator. Aside from Li Chenghai, the student union’s President, who else in the academy is a match for him?"
"Senior Brother Zhou was famous for being merciless in the past. If Senior Brother Zhou really makes a move, this guy would definitely be in trouble."
The students began to discuss spiritedly again, all of them optimistic about Zhou Zheng, even if Ling Han had just kicked a Level 2 cultivator like Wang Jun to death.
There were no more than five students who had reached this level in the academy of Zhou Su City. In fact, some teachers with weaker abilities were only Level 3.
Ling Han shook his head, "I won’t choose either!"
"Humph, that is not up to you to decide!" Zhou Zheng shouted lightly, and was just about to make a move.
"Old Zhou, give me some face!" Shu Zhengyang hurriedly stepped out to stop him, then winked at Ling Han. "Junior Brother Ling, when it’s time to admit defeat, you have to bow your head!"
"Ling Han!" Yang Qi also ran over, and said, "That’s a Level 3 cultivator! You definitely can’t be rash again!"
"I think... I can," Ling Han said to Yang Qi. He was brimming with confidence.
This line again!

Yang Qi didn’t know what else to say. Previously, Ling Han had also said that he could do it, yet in the end, he had beaten Wang Jun to death. Now, he was saying this again. Could it be that he was going to perform another miracle?

"Shu Zhengyang, get lost," Zhou Zheng said coldly. Previously, he had given Shu Zhengyang face, yet Ling Han did not know what was good for him at all. Thus, he was now furious, and wanted to apprehend Ling Han.
Shu Zhengyang didn’t dare to persuade him anymore. How terrifying would it be for a Level 3 cultivator to be angered?
He did not dare to trifle with this misfortune.
Zhou Zheng strode towards Ling Han. The aura of a Level 3 cultivator fluctuated, forming a terrifying pressure.

He was different from Wang Jun. He had not walked out from a sea of blood. Thus, this intimidation naturally did not possess overflowing killing intent. However, he was a Level 3 cultivator, and his aura was much stronger than Wang Jun’s.
Instantly, the surrounding students felt as if there was a hand gripped tightly around their necks, making it difficult for them to breathe.
Ling Han’s expression was calm, and there was a strong indifference in his eyes as he looked at Zhou Zheng, as if the latter was only an ant.
"You are really arrogant!" Zhou Zheng shouted angrily, and delivered a palm strike at Ling Han.
"Scram!" Ling Han said calmly. He threw a punch at Zhou Zheng.
Peng!
Instantly, Zhou Zheng was seen stumbling backwards. In terms of power, he was actually no match for Ling Han.
This, this, this, this, this, everyone was dumbfounded, completely unable to believe their eyes.
Someone as powerful as Zhou Zheng was actually no match for Ling Han?
That was a Level 3 cultivator!
"F***, this is too freakish!" Shu Zhengyang muttered. He knew that Ling Han was very freakish. At eighteen years old, he already possessed the strength of a pseudo cultivator.

But to be honest, even in the academy, this could only be considered very strong, but he was definitely not the only one. For example, Zhou Zheng had also become a pseudo cultivator in his third year of high school.
Thus, he had a very high opinion of Ling Han, but definitely had no intention of betting his entire family and life.
But now... he realized that he had far underestimated this future junior.

chapters.title: Chapter 4923: Side Story -- City 11
paragraphs: Zhou Zheng did not dare believe this.
He was the vice-president of the student union, and was more so a Level 3 cultivator. Yet, he was actually blocked by a young man who hadn’t even entered the martial academy yet.
How could he endure this?
Did he not care about his pride?

"You do have some abilities. No wonder you dare to be so arrogant!" he said through gritted teeth. He was already truly angered, his aura burning fiercely, as if he wanted to devour someone. "However, the stronger you are, the more I want to take you down. Otherwise, since you dare to kill in public today, you would dare to rebel against humanity tomorrow!"
Ling Han couldn’t help but laugh in spite of himself. "I’ve only killed a few people who wanted to harm me. Is there any need to go so far?"
Zhou Zheng humphed coldly, "Tell these words to the people in the security office!"
With a leap, he charged towards Ling Han.
He definitely had to capture Ling Han, and only then would he be able to redeem his name.

Ling Han shook his head, and stretched out a hand to control the air. A terrifying scene appeared, and Zhou Zheng seemed to have been suppressed by some kind of power. With a bang, he knelt heavily onto the ground.
This kneel actually shattered his knees, and the sound of bones breaking could be heard clearly. Blood was also seeping out from his knees.
Hiss!
A dead silence instantly fell over the area.
That was Zhou Zheng!

Not only had he been defeated, he had been defeated in such a humiliating manner. What was even more shocking was the fact that Ling Han had not even touched him. He had merely stretched out a hand and pressed down, and Zhou Zheng had been forced to kneel by the power he exerted from afar.
Are you a demon?
"Capable of unleashing power outside the body, Medium Grade cultivator!" At this moment, a senior student said in a trembling voice, feeling an indescribable excitement.
Not many people knew about the words "unleashing power outside the body", but every student knew what Medium Grade cultivator meant.

Level 1, Level 2, and Level 3 cultivators were also called Low Grade cultivators, while Level 4, Level 5, and Level 6 cultivators were Medium Grade cultivators. Low Grade cultivators and Medium Grade cultivators were two completely different concepts. Taking this step was as difficult as ascending the heavens.

Similarly, Level 7, Level 8 and Level 9 cultivators were also called High Grade cultivators. This was another level of existence, and the number of High Grade cultivators on the entire planet could be counted.
Releasing power outside the body was the symbol of Medium Grade cultivators.
Everyone was dumbfounded as they looked at Ling Han. None of them could speak.

Fifty years after the mutation of heaven and earth began, there were only a total of three students in the academy of Zhou Su City who had reached Level 4 upon graduation, and advanced into the ranks of Medium Grade cultivators.
Ling Han was the fourth.
But the point was, those three students had only reached Medium Grade after graduating, and what about Ling Han? He hadn’t even enrolled into the martial academy yet!
Then what level would he be able to reach when he graduated?
Level 5? Or even Level 6!
If he advanced another step further, and reached Level 7... Heavens, a High Grade cultivator!
Zhou Zheng had also forgotten his pain. He raised his head to look at Ling Han, his face filled with disbelief.
This was actually a Medium Grade cultivator!

Heavens, with such a young Level 4 cultivator, as long as he did not rebel against humanity, even if he killed a few more people, the government would still think of ways to turn a big issue into a small one, and turn a small issue into nothing.
He was too prodigious. If he was properly nurtured, it was very possible that he would become the saviour of the entire human race.
However, it was also a fact that he had committed a crime right in front of the academy gates of the martial academy, which made all the students feel embarrassed.

"Ling, Ling Han!" A high voice rang out, and a young girl dressed fashionably appeared. She had taken a cab here, and had just gotten out of the car, and was currently looking around with an inconceivable gaze.
Dead people!
In broad daylight, and at the entrance of the martial academy at that, a considerable number of people had actually died. Wasn’t this just a dream?
Ling Han looked over, and couldn’t help but feel slightly surprised, because this young girl was his ex-girlfriend, Zhu Yan.
Why had she come here?
"I called her over," Yang Qi said. "She said she didn’t believe that you entered the academy, so I told her to come see for herself and make her regret her actions!"
Ling Han was unconcerned.
In his eyes, Zhu Yan was already a thing of the past, and was no longer worthy of a second glance from him.
However, when he was called, he was called. He would not deliberately avoid her, or chase her away. He couldn’t even be bothered to say anything mocking.

Zhu Yan didn’t believe that Ling Han had become a pseudo-cultivator at all, but she had just gotten off the carriage when she heard the discussions of others. Ling Han was actually a Medium Grade cultivator!
Medium Grade cultivator, what kind of concept was that?
That was an existence that surpassed all others. Furthermore, he was an eighteen-year-old Medium Grade cultivator, so where would his future limit be?
High Grade?
Once he became a High Grade cultivator, Ling Han would be superior to tens of thousands of people.
In comparison, what was Wang Hanchen worth?
"Ling Han, I was wrong. I still love you. Let me return to your side, all right?" She immediately adjusted her emotions, a pitiful expression appearing on her face.
"Are you worthy?" A cold voice rang out, and a woman in white walked over.

She was dressed in a white dress, and was as graceful as a celestial maiden. There was not a single ornament on her body. Her raven black hair naturally hung down, and her feet were bare, as white as jade. However, her beautiful face was breathtakingly beautiful.
The strange thing was that her feet were clearly bare, but her jade-like feet were incredibly white, without the slightest bit of dust.
"The Empress!"
"The Empress has actually come out."
"My Empress!"
The students all looked like they were about to go crazy. They wanted nothing more than to kneel down and worship the woman in white.
Ling Han also looked over. When his eyes swept over the beautiful face of the woman in white, endless memories instantly exploded in his mind. He remembered everything.
"Who are you?" Zhu Yan asked the woman in white, and couldn’t help but look stunned.
She was so beautiful that she felt inferior.
The empress walked over. Pa, with a slap, Zhu Yan was sent flying, like a kite with a broken string.
What was going on?
Everyone was surprised, because they had never seen the empress actually make a move to hit someone!
In their impression, the empress was an incredibly proud existence. In fact, she was so proud that even hitting others would dirty her hands.
And it was this empress that had actually struck a woman?
Inconceivable! This was too inconceivable. This was really something that could only be seen after living for a long time.
"Are you worthy of such an outstanding man?" the empress asked coldly. Then, without another glance at Zhu Yan, she quickly walked towards Ling Han.
What was the meaning of this?
How could it be!
No!

Everyone wanted to shout loudly. The empress was a teacher that had just entered into the academy, but the moment she entered into the academy, she had won the admiration of all the teachers and students, and her attraction did not differentiate between men and women.
But now, the empress was charging towards Ling Han. What was the meaning of this?
At this moment, Ling Han also spread open his arms and embraced the empress.
The two of them embraced tightly.
No!
Seeing this scene, everyone wanted to cry. This was the goddess of everyone in the academy, yet now, she had thrown herself into the arms of a man.
So hateful! So hateful! So hateful!
In just a short while, Ling Han had become everyone’s public enemy. They wanted nothing more than to castrate him, inch by inch.
Ling Han embraced the empress, and all his memories returned.

He came from the last Stacked Era, and watched the birth of this universe in this Stacked Era. He would also watch the destruction of this universe in this Stacked Era, while he himself was eternally indestructible.
Because he was invincible and bored, he chose to seal his memories and run to this planet to become an ordinary person. Now, his memories had completely returned.

Hiss!

chapters.title: Chapter 4924: Side Story -- City 12
paragraphs: "Are we going back?" the empress asked.
This time, they didn’t set out with their entire family. Instead, a limited number of people secretly ran out for a small trip.
"Since you’re already here, why don’t you stay for a few more days and settle the matters here?" Ling Han said, a sharp look in his eyes.
After this Stacked Era began, Ling Han secretly spread his knowledge of martial arts and formulated the corresponding Regulations.
High level civilizations could not interfere with the evolution of low-level civilizations. This was an ironclad rule.
But now, he discovered that the evolution of this planet had been disturbed.
—The sudden change was the result of man-made interference.

This planet had not experienced any kind of ancient war, but rather was very poor by nature in terms of Spiritual Qi. Theoretically speaking, there shouldn’t have been any evolution of martial arts, and could only take the path of technology.
But now, the Spiritual Qi had suddenly increased tenfold or a hundredfold, causing both wild beasts and humans to evolve. Naturally, there was a mastermind behind all this.

With Ling Han’s abilities, as long as he released his divine sense, he would be able to envelop the entire universe. However, since he was already engrossed in this game, he naturally wouldn’t mind playing.
"All right." The empress nodded gently, and snuggled into Ling Han’s arms, as obedient as a cat.
How detestable!
Everyone wanted nothing more than to rush up and take a few bites, and dismember Ling Han.
This was too much of a b@stard. That was everyone’s goddess, so how could you blaspheme her?
At this time, the leaders of the police and the academy were also alerted, and appeared one after another.
Logically speaking, Ling Han should have returned to the police station to record his statement after committing murder in public. However, he had already proven his strength.
A Level 4 cultivator!
This was too awesome, breaking the record of the Zhou Su City’s martial academy. When he graduated, what heights would he reach?
Hence, the academy naturally had to do their utmost to protect this kind of prodigy. With a personal call from the headmaster, Ling Han was allowed to stay in the academy for the investigation.
What level was the Headmaster of the martial academy?
The weight of a High Grade Level 8 cultivator was far too heavy.

Thus, the police force had no choice but to give face to this high-ranked cultivator. They only said that before the results of the investigation were out, they definitely could not allow Ling Han to leave the city.
In truth, the area outside the city was filled with wild beasts, so where could one go outside the city?
Soon, the results of the investigation were out. It was indeed deliberate targeting from the Wang Clan, including the records of the transfer of funds from Wang Jun to Ruan Zhiping.
Thus, Ling Han had only received some verbal reprimands. He shouldn’t have been too ruthless, but as for other things... he was completely fine.
This was the special privilege of cultivators.
Compared to a Level 4 cultivator who had boundless future prospects, what was a mere Level 2, Level 1 or pseudo cultivator worth?
At Ling Han’s request, Yang Qi was also accepted into the martial academy in advance. He had been in a daze the entire day; how had his childhood friend suddenly become so powerful?
And Ling Han had also become a legend of the academy all of a sudden.

—He had not even officially enrolled into the academy, and was already a Level 4 cultivator. This was practically unprecedented, and would never be seen again in future. Furthermore, what was even more enthralling was the fact that he had courted the goddess of the academy the moment he appeared. This was what made people feel the most bitter and hateful.
Less than two days later, someone from the military suddenly came, wanting to join forces with the academy to destroy the lair of a high-level Foreign Beast.
This was also a training trip for the students. Thus, the main force was high-ranked cultivators, but they would also bring a lot of low-ranked students.
After some discussion, the leaders of the academy agreed to this joint mission.

The candidates were quickly chosen. Though Ling Han was a pseudo-new student, because his cultivation level was as high as Level 4, he had naturally entered into the main list of candidates. Accompanying him was the empress. She was presently a High Level teacher of the academy, and the cultivation level that she had reported had reached Level 6, which was considerably higher than even Ling Han.

Soldiers were naturally swift and resolute in their actions. On this side, the moment the academy prepared itself, the military immediately sent out personnel, who arrived at the entrance of the academy.

This time, the academy had mobilized 12 students. Aside from Ling Han, a pseudo-new student, the others were all elites, and had reached at least Level 1. Additionally, there were also five teachers, and the one in charge was the vice-principal, Ge Hui, a Level 7 High Grade cultivator.
And in the case of the army, they had similarly mobilized twelve young soldiers, and there were also five Medium and High Grade cultivators standing guard among them.
"Principal Ge, long time no see," a military elite greeted Ge Hui. He was about forty years old, and was at the peak of his life. His vitality was extremely vigorous.
"General Tan!" Ge Hui also greeted him. His name was Tan Yuan, and he had the military rank of a major general. He was a Level 7 High Grade cultivator, and was of the same level as himself.
The two big shots began to chat casually, and the others also greeted each other.
"I heard that your academy took in a prodigy who even killed two soldiers of our army!" a young man from the army suddenly said.
Though he had used the word "heard", his eyes were fixed on Ling Han.
Obviously, he had seen Ling Han’s information before, and had directly locked onto his target.
Though Wang Jun and Li Hengming were the culprits, to the military, the fact that these two people had been killed by Ling Han was still an extremely great humiliation.
Thus, this young warrior could not wait to draw his sword.
—Wang Jun and Li Hengming indeed deserved to die, but the military had to get their pride back.
Ling Han glanced at this young man, then shifted his gaze, treating this person like air.
"How arrogant!" That young soldier smirked coldly, "My name is Xiao Hu, and my current military rank is Second Lieutenant, a Level 3 cultivator. Do you dare battle me?"
Level 3 cultivator!
This cultivation level was a little scary. In the martial academy, this cultivation level could squeeze into the top ten. Obviously, the military had also sent out elite recruits this time.

However, the strength that Ling Han had displayed to the outside world was Level 4, and the gap between Level 3 and Level 4 was a qualitative leap. Xiao Hu would definitely be aware of this fact, yet still dared to challenge Ling Han, so what kind of backing did he have?

"Hehe, it is inevitable that young people would be competitive," Tan Yuan said with a smile. "However, we cultivators grow through fighting. If we don’t have that kind of fighting spirit, all of us should just become clerical staff!"
"Headmaster Ge, let the two youngsters spar for a while."
He was a Level 7 High Grade cultivator, and since he had spoken, anyone would have to give him some face.
Thus, Ge Hui only paused slightly, then nodded, "All right."

Though he felt that it was illogical for a Level 3 cultivator to challenge a Level 4 cultivator, he himself was a Level 7 cultivator, and knew very well just how massive the gap was between Level 4 and Level 3.
Thus, as long as Ling Han wasn’t too careless, he would definitely win this battle.
Since he would definitely win, he naturally would not mind a battle.
Xiao Hu immediately jumped out, pointed at Ling Han and said, "Come!"
Yet Ling Han had absolutely no intention of making a move. He stated calmly, "You are unqualified!"
Unqualified?
Xiao Hu was naturally enraged. Just how much was he looking down on him?
"Young man, it’s just a fight, so it won’t take too much time," Tan Yuan said to Ling Han. He then joked, "Just treat it as giving me some face?"
"Why should I give you face?" Ling Han retorted directly.

chapters.title: Chapter 4925: Side Story -- City 13
paragraphs: ’What?’
Hearing Ling Han’s words, everyone was first taken aback, and then inhaled sharply.
Who was Tan Yuan?
To say nothing of the Hua Nation, even in the entire world, a High Grade Level 7 cultivator was still a lofty existence.
Ling Han was indeed very freakish. He had already reached Level 4 at the mere age of eighteen, but compared with Tan Yuan, they were on two completely different levels.
Thus, what right did Ling Han have to not give Tan Yuan face?
Tan Yuan was also filled with disbelief. He had only been joking casually, and Ling Han had actually rebuked him so harshly.

He couldn’t help but show a baleful expression, but did not show his anger. Instead, he looked towards Ge Hui, and said, "Headmaster Ge, the students of your esteemed academy are really well-defined, showing off their abilities!"
These words were definitely not meant to praise Ling Han.
Ge Hui hadn’t expected Ling Han to be so arrogant either. ’You’re only at Level 4, so how do you dare to face a Level 7 elite so head-on?’
’Do you have any brains?’
Did he really think that just because he was an eighteen-year-old Level 4 cultivator, he could do as he pleased?
Did he really think that everyone in the world would cherish him?

In this era, martial arts was the most important. Level 7 elites could crush Level 4. No matter how bright your future was, before you became the strongest, you had to adhere to the rules of the mortal world.
"Ling Han, since General Tan has spoken, why don’t you spar with him?" Ge Hui said.
Ling Han looked towards him, and shook his head, "Not interested."
What right did he have?
He was not a clown that was entertaining the masses. Oh, just because you said to spar, he should agree?
Now that he had been rebuffed, Ge Hui’s expression also changed drastically.
What was going on?
This student was really too arrogant. He did not even take his words to heart?

It should be known that Tan Yuan was a higher up in the military, but indeed, he could not control the matters of the academy. However, he, Ge Hui, was the vice-principal of the academy, and was Ling Han’s direct superior. What right did Ling Han have to disobey him?
"You—" He took a deep breath, and looked furious.

No matter how freakish Ling Han was, and no matter how much of a star of hope he was, he was still so rebellious. He definitely had to teach him a good lesson about his temper. Otherwise, if he really became a supreme elite of the human race one day, yet did not seek benefits for the human race, and instead harmed them, that would really be raising an ingrate.
"Ling Han, you don’t have to go to this training camp. Go back and put yourself in confinement. Reflect on yourself!" he said in a deep voice.
"Do you want to die?" the empress asked. There was a haughty look on her face, and it was as if Ge Hui were an insignificant speck of dust.
What was going on?
Ge Hui’s expression was filled with shock as he looked at the empress.

He naturally knew of the empress, who wasan influential figure. She was incomparably beautiful, and was the goddess of the entire martial academy. However, because of his status, he naturally would not court her like the youngsters did. In fact, he had never faced the empress head-on before.

However, in comparison, he valued his reputation more.
’I’m the vice-principal, and you’re just an ordinary teacher. Yet, you’re actually talking to me like this?’

Er!

Had they... seen wrongly?

Now, a woman in her twenties was actually showing the strength of Level 8.
This, this, this, this was practically going to scare them to death.
In comparison, Ling Han, an eighteen-year-old Level 4 cultivator, wasn’t freakish at all.

However, could it be that it was going to use force with the empress?
She was a great elite of Level 8!
He couldn’t afford to offend. He couldn’t afford to offend.

Why? Why? Why!

Their main goal this time was to annihilate that newly advanced Level 7 Foreign Beast. At the same time, they would also eradicate the low-level Foreign Beasts on their way, so that the youngsters could gain some experience.
Precisely because this high-level Foreign Beast was newly advanced, they only needed to send out two High Grade Level 7 cultivators.
Of course, there was one less Ge Hui now, but the empress was stronger, and was enough to fill the gap.
They swept through the Foreign Beasts on their way, and after a whole three days, they finally arrived at the lair of that Foreign Beast.

This newly advanced high-level Foreign Beast was a Crimson Flame Tiger, and it had been mutated from a fierce tiger. Not only was its power immense, its speed astonishing, but it could also spit out fiery flames that were powerful enough to melt alloys. It was truly terrifying.

Hence, this kind of Foreign Beast had to be eliminated at the first instant. Otherwise, when it became Level 8 or even Level 9, it would spit out a mouthful of fiery flames, and half the city could possibly be directly destroyed.

They saw that there was actually another group of people walking over.
"Principal Li!" he immediately greeted.

"Haha, what a coincidence," Tan Yuan said with a laugh.

The Demon Sea City was adjacent to the Zhou Su City, so once the Crimson Flame Tiger grew to Level 8 or even Level 9, the Zhou Su City would be threatened, and so would the Demon Sea City.
Hence, it was not strange for the Demon Sea City to make a move as well. Coincidentally, two teams had actually arrived at the same time.
Very quickly, the eyes of the Demon Sea City team focused on the empress.
She was too beautiful.

chapters.title: Chapter 4926: Side Story -- City 14
paragraphs: "General Tan, since everyone is here, why don’t we work together?" the Vice Principal from the Demon Sea Martial Academy said.
His name was Li Xiong, and he was also a High Grade Level 7 cultivator.
Tan Yuan nodded, "Sure."
"Please."
"Please."
The two Level 7 elites made way for each other modestly, then walked side by side, heading forwards.

A long time ago, this was a popular sightseeing area, but since fifty years ago, this place had been completely abandoned. Without the interference of humans, the vegetation here was flourishing. Large trees rose from the ground, their leaves dense, blocking sunlight.
The members of the Demon Sea team clearly did not know how strong the empress was. Seeing that she was as beautiful as a fairy, they all tried to strike up a conversation with her.

The empress was so proud, so she naturally ignored them completely. She merely walked side by side with Ling Han, causing the members of the Demon Sea team to feel incredibly jealous. They wanted nothing more than to kill Ling Han with their eyes.
—This brat was too young. Clearly, his cultivation level was low, so how could he be worthy of such a beautiful celestial maiden?
"Celestial maiden, let’s be friends."
"This beauty, how should I address you?"
"My name is Mo Hai. Beauty, it seems like I’ve seen you before somewhere!"
They all used their respective abilities, wanting to win the empress’s attention.

Tan Yuan was well aware of how terrifying the empress was. Upon seeing these people recklessly provoke a High Grade Level 8 elite, he hurriedly chided, "We’re facing a powerful enemy, so hurry up and focus!"

Those members of the Demon Sea team had no direct relationship with Tan Yuan. However, now that a Level 7 elite had spoken up to reprimand them, they naturally did not dare to disobey. They all shut their mouths.
However, they immediately gritted their teeth again, because the empress was still clinging onto Ling Han.
F***, why don’t you reprimand them? They were about to get into a fight with the Foreign Beast, and these two people were still so lovey-dovey. Who were they showing off their love for!
Tan Yuan naturally knew this, but did he dare to say it?
Whatever a Level 8 elite wanted to do, was there any need for a mere Level 7 cultivator to interfere?
As they walked, they saw corpses appear by the roadside. Some were complete, and some were only left with parts.
Were these all prey that had been eaten by the Crimson Flames Tiger?
There were burn marks everywhere, as if reminding everyone that this Foreign Beast was an expert in controlling flames.
After walking for a while longer, Tan Yuan and Li Xiong stopped at the same time, their expressions grave.
"That Foreign Beast sensed us."
"Everyone, get ready!"

The two of them had just finished their words, when they heard a deafening beast’s roar. A fierce tiger that was completely crimson in colour suddenly appeared. It was as tall as five metres, and as long as about ten metres. Standing in front of them, it was like a small building.
The fur of this fierce tiger were like burning flames, fluttering in the breeze.
"Let’s go!" Tan Yuan was the first to charge up.
Li Xiong did not refuse either, and charged towards the Crimson Flame Tiger.
This was a battle among High Grades, and even Medium Grade cultivators weren’t qualified to interfere. Otherwise, they would definitely die if they were struck by the aftermath of these attacks.
However, if Tan Yuan and Li Xiong joined forces, the two of them would be enough.

Tan Yuan’s strength was slightly weaker. He was only in the middle stage of Level 7, but Li Xiong was in the late stage of Level 8. He alone was enough to suppress the Crimson Flames Tiger. Otherwise, he would not have dared to lead a team all by himself.
In Tan Yuan’s case, it was because he knew that the empress, a Level 8 elite, was in the team.

The two of them joined forces, and very soon, suppressed the Crimson Flames Tiger, continuously widening their advantage, but they were still a little bit away from completely dealing with this Foreign Beast.

There was nothing that could be done. The Foreign Beasts had tough hides, and their claws and teeth also possessed great might. Their destructive power was astonishing, and their recovery ability was also astonishing. Thus, Tan Yuan and Li Xiong did not dare to come too close, but rather chose to slowly grind their enemy down.
After a whole half day’s time, this Foreign Beast was finally ground to death. When it collapsed to the ground dead, everyone cheered.

It should be known that though Foreign Beasts were great enemies of humans, they were also full of treasures, especially high-level Foreign Beasts. Even a piece of meat was filled with energy, and had astonishing effects on the cultivation of cultivators.

Thus, even though this Foreign Beast had been killed by Tan Yuan and Li Xiong, those that were with them would still be able to get a share of the loot. At the very least, they would be able to eat two pieces of meat.
Tan Yuan and Li Xiong both looked weary. After battling fiercely for half a day, even with their abilities, they were slightly strained.
Next, it was the distribution of the spoils of battle. This was naturally decided by the two big shots.
However, right at this moment, an incredibly terrifying aura surged over, causing everyone to feel cold all over. In fact, even their hearts were about to stop beating.
This was too terrifying. What kind of powerful existence could possess such an astonishing aura?
Huala, the sound of tree leaves rubbing against each other rang out, approaching from afar.
Very soon, everyone could see that the tree branches ahead of them were moving fiercely, and the commotion was astonishingly huge.
Something was about to come out!
Tan Yuan and Li Xiong both went into a defensive stance. This aura was too terrifying, causing them to feel immense pressure.
Xiu, a black shadow darted out.

Everyone couldn’t help but be taken aback. This aura had already spread out to such a shocking extent, but who would have thought that it was actually a black dog that had scuttled out? It was slightly larger than an ordinary dog, and its fur was smooth and shiny.
However, what made people splutter was the fact that this dog was actually wearing a pair of underpants. Furthermore, they were made of metal, and there was a metallic light flickering on them.

As soon as the large black dog appeared, he leaped to the side of the Crimson Flames Tiger. Then, he grinned at everyone, and taking advantage of the fact that they were all dumbfounded, picked up the corpse of the Crimson Flames Tiger with his mouth and fled.
Even though it was small in size, its power was astonishing. Dragging the Crimson Flame Tiger, it was still extraordinarily fast. In an instant, it had disappeared without a trace.
"Am I seeing things, or is there really a large black dog wearing iron underwear and stealing all our spoils of battle?" someone murmured.
"You’re not seeing things, I saw it too."
"Me too."
Only now did everyone come to their senses. Tan Yuan and Li Xiong had even set off in pursuit, but not too long after, they returned in disappointment. Clearly, they had lost track of their target.
"Have you guys realized that the large black dog is extremely human-like?"
"That’s right. It was clearly smiling at us just now, as if it was mocking us."
"Also, it’s actually wearing underpants!"
"There should be no sunlight shining here, but why can that pair of underpants still glow? It almost blinded me!"
Everyone was talking about this matter, all of them incredibly stunned.
Who would have thought that they would actually be robbed by a dog? If this was told to others, it was guaranteed that no one would believe it.
Weng, right at this moment, another terrifying aura pressed over, and the trees in the distance were also swaying violently.
Was the large black dog about to return?
Everyone looked furious. This large black dog was really too despicable. He wanted to humiliate them again?
Humph, this time, they were prepared. They were definitely going to beat this despicable dog until he wet his pants in fright.
Sha, sha, sha! The movement of the branches was getting closer and closer.
"I’ll go!" Li Xiong shouted loudly, and charged into the forest.
Peng!
In just an instant, a figure flew out.
It was Li Xiong.
"Pu—" As he was sent flying backwards, he was still throwing up blood.
And a fiery red figure also leaped out. It was shockingly a second Crimson Flames Tiger, and it was much larger than the previous one.

What!

They could clearly sense the strength of this Crimson Flame Tiger’s aura, which had reached a level that could overwhelm them.
Level 8!
This was a Level 8 Foreign Beast.
Heavens, they only knew that there was a Crimson Flame Tiger here that had just advanced to Level 7, but they had never imagined that there would actually be an even stronger existence here.
What could they do?

Both of them were only at Level 7, so dealing with the small Crimson Flame Tiger was no problem at all. They were more than enough. However, if it was a Level 8 Foreign Beast, it was completely capable of killing them.
However, compared to Li Xiong, Tan Yuan was still relatively calm.
This was because he knew that the empress was also in Level 8.
Thus, as long as the empress was willing to move, she would at least be able to stop this Crimson Flame Tiger.

The second Crimson Flame Tiger released a low growl, as if summoning the first Crimson Flame Tiger. Naturally, it was impossible to get a response. The aura it exuded became heavier and heavier, and its killing intent also became stronger and stronger.
These humans... all had to die!

A terrifying aura pressed down, and those below Level 7 could not even think of resisting.
This was the crushing advantage of a superior cultivation level.
Oh no, they couldn’t even escape!
Shua, right at this moment, an incredibly brilliant saber light streaked past, slashing out towards the Crimson Flame Tiger.
The timing of this strike was really too ingenious. It just happened to be the instant when the Crimson Flames Tiger pounced out, and there was no way to change its course at all.
However, this Crimson Flames Tiger was a Level 8 Foreign Beast, so it wouldn’t be killed so easily. It still brandished its claws to parry the saber light.

This was far too astonishing. With a single slash, the Foreign Beast was actually wounded.

This was because he had a good father.

Lu Hao, the commander of the army, a Level 9 elite, and was also one of the strongest elites of the nation. Even in comparison of the whole world, he could be considered one of the top elites.

—With his abilities, dealing with a Level 8 Foreign Beast was actually a very easy matter. The only thing he was wary of was the fiery flames of the Crimson Flames Tiger, which also had strong destructive power against a Level 9 elite.

As expected of Level 9!

How could they not be impressed?

Then, he looked towards Lu Hao, and asked, "Father, why have you come?"

"I received news that it is very possible that there is an even stronger Crimson Flame Tiger here. I was afraid that something would happen to you, so I deliberately made a trip." Lu Hao said smilingly, as he shook hands with Tan Yuan and Li Xiong, causing the two of them to look overwhelmed by his favour.

That was a supreme elite of Level 9, and he actually took the initiative to shake hands with them, causing them to go numb with excitement, just like a minor cultivator that had just stepped onto the path of martial arts.

Lu Songlai looked at the empress again, and said, "Miss Luan Xing, are you interested in joining the academy of martial arts of the Demon Sea City? I think that it would be a waste of your talent to stay in Zhou Su City. In terms of future prospects, our Demon Sea City is definitely brighter!"
This action of publicly poaching one of their own was too much. Didn’t they see that the teachers and students of Zhou Su Martial Arts Academy were all present?

However, Lu Songlai was completely unconcerned. His old man was one of the few elites of the Hua Nation. With such a background, so what if he publicly poached someone? Who would dare have any objections against him?
The empress merely glanced at him coldly, completely having no intention of speaking.
"Miss Luan Xing, I truly like you!" Lu Songlai directly confessed. This was a rare opportunity. If they returned to their respective campuses later, who knew when they would meet again.
—Between the two cities, there were innumerable Foreign Beasts, and it was too difficult to even meet once.
Ling Han stretched out a hand, "She is already taken, so you had best give up."
"Oh, is that you?" Lu Songlai wore a haughty expression. Who do you think you are? Are you worthy of such a beautiful woman?
Ling Han cracked a smile, and ignored him.

Lu Songlai looked furious. He did not think that the empress had disregarded him. Instead, he thought that the goddess had a strong personality. However, in his eyes, Ling Han’s disregard was too rude.
"Do you dare to battle me?"

chapters.title: Chapter 4928: Side Story -- City 16
paragraphs: Ling Han smiled faintly, "Why should I fight you?"
"Just say whether you dare or not!" Lu Songlai used provocation. He was sure that Ling Han was only eighteen or nineteen years old, so he would definitely not be able to take the provocation.
Moreover, he was already 21 years old this year, and he also had a father who was a Level 9 elite. It was because of this that he had been able to advance to Level 4. Who could compare to him?
Thus, as long as Ling Han dared to agree, he would thrash Ling Han to a tragic state. He was sure that the empress would despise this person; how could she still like him then?
Ling Han smiled, and said, "All right!"

"Everyone, step back a bit," Lu Songlai said. He was a Level 4 cultivator, and the might of his attack was too terrifying. In fact, even the aftermath of his attack had astonishing destructive power, and there was no shortage of Level 2 and Level 3 cultivators here, so they naturally had to step back a little.

Since the purpose of this trip had been achieved, and there was also a supreme elite of the Level 9 standing guard, everyone was naturally relaxed. They were not in a rush to return, and stepped back a little, to make space for Ling Han and Lu Songlai.
"I’ll let you have the first three moves." Lu Songlai appeared very domineering.

In his eyes, Ling Han was only 18 or 19 years old. At most, he was only a Level 1 cultivator. At most, he was only a Level 2 cultivator. Even if he didn’t use his hands and feet, he could still defeat his opponent.
Ling Han smiled, and asked, "Are you sure?"
"Of course!" Lu Songlai declared proudly.
Ling Han didn’t say anything else. Instead, he threw a punch.
However, this punch did not land on Lu Songlai. Instead, it landed on the empty area beside him. A majestic light surged out, turning into an incredibly dazzling pillar of light.
Boom!

A terrifying scene appeared. This place had originally been a primeval forest, and there were still some small mountains that had been man-made at that time, but when the pillar of light surged past, everything disappeared.
The area of at least ten kilometers ahead of them had all been razed to the ground.
’Holy f*ck!’
At this moment, everyone was dumbfounded and unable to breathe.
What kind of terrifying destructive power was this!
Even the bombardment of guided missiles could just barely reach this level of destruction, right?
Level 8? Or even Level 9?
At least, Tan Yuan and Li Xiong knew that the might of their strike definitely could not reach this level.
Heavens, this young man was actually stronger than them?
And he was actually a newly enrolled student, no, a pseudo-student that had yet to enter into the martial academy?
An eighteen-year-old Level 8 cultivator?
Ancestors!
Even Lu Hao looked astonished. The might of this attack had reached at least Level 8.
Even if it was only Level 8, that was too shocking, too inconceivable.
Just think, what level had he been when he was eighteen years old?
Level 2, and this was already incredibly freakish. Few people in history could compare to this.
However, how many times over had this record been broken all of a sudden?
Meanwhile, Lu Songlai was shaking greatly.
He turned his head with great difficulty, and looked at the large stretch of flat land behind him. He almost couldn’t catch his breath.
Then, he felt that the inside of his pants was a little sticky. He looked down, and there was actually a large patch of wetness.
—He had wet himself in fright.
This couldn’t be blamed on him. That attack just now was truly shocking. Although he was a Level 4, he didn’t have much actual combat experience, so the impact he suffered was too great.
Ling Han shrugged, and said, "Sorry, I missed. Let’s do it again, and I promise I’ll improve."
Improve your sister!
Lu Songlai hurriedly shook his head. If he had really sustained such an attack, he would definitely not even be able to leave behind any dust.
"Hehe, you’re a Level 8 cultivator, so what’s the point of bullying a junior like this?" Lu Hao stepped forward. His son had wet himself in fright, so he was naturally displeased.
He only had one son, and he treasured him immensely.

Moreover, he didn’t think that Ling Han was truly a young man. Instead, he thought that Ling Han had eaten some spirit fruit to maintain his youthful appearance—after the world went through a mutation, this spirit fruit definitely existed.
Thus, Ling Han was bullying the weak with his superior strength, so he naturally had to stand up for his son.
Ling Han was a Level 9?
Bu so what?
The position of commander of the army was not obtained through seniority, but through battle!
Level 9 cultivators were the strongest in the world, so who did he need to fear?
"You want to stand up for your son?" Ling Han asked.
"You’re a bully, so why can’t I uphold justice for my son?" Lu Hao said calmly.
"Didn’t you realize that it was your son who provoked me first?" Ling Han said with a smile.
Lu Hao paused slightly. This was the truth.

It was his son who coveted Ling Han’s girlfriend and took the initiative to provoke him. On the other hand, Ling Han didn’t attack ruthlessly. He only displayed his strength to make Lu Songlai retreat.
If he claimed that he was bullying someone weaker than himself, then he was truly trying to pin a crime on an innocent person.
But the problem here was, Lu Songlai had actually wet himself in fright!
This was something that Lu Hao could not accept.
"You insulted my son, and this justice must be avenged!" Lu Hao declared balefully, his whole body exuding killing intent.
The commander of the army had battled all his life, and his killing intent was almost tangible.
Ling Han shook his head. Just as he was about to speak, he heard rustling sounds. The tree leaves were moving again. Something was about to appear.
In an instant, a large black dog dashed out. Its iron underwear shone with golden light, the kind that could blind one.
Yi, that damn thieving dog!
It actually ran back?
"Was it that b@stard that sneak attacked Grandpa Dog just now?" The large black dog suddenly stood up on his hind legs, and he was even speaking in human language.
’F*ck!’
Everyone was dumbfounded. Even Lu Hao had forgotten to continue exerting pressure on Ling Han.
This!

The world had changed, and wild beasts had evolved, becoming incredibly terrifying. However, no matter how strong a Foreign Beast was, it would not open its mouth to speak. This was something that everyone knew, and humans were still the only living beings with true intelligence.
But now?

Not only did the large black dog stand up like a human, but he was also wearing underpants like a human. Although this made him look even more vulgar, and he even spoke human language, this had broken the iron rule that humans were the only beings with true intelligence.
This caused the feeling of superiority of humans to completely vanish.
"Was it you?" The large black dog stared at Lu Hao.
Lu Hao gritted his teeth. There were so many people here, so why are you targeting me?
He frowned, "Why can you speak human language?"

"Grandpa Dog has already existed since the beginning of the Stacked Era, and is the ancestor of all living things!" The large black dog mumbled. "You all were also created by Grandpa Dog. What’s so strange about Grandpa Dog being able to speak human language?"
"Insignificant human, are you still not going to kneel down in front of me and show me your respect?"
Lu Hao humphed upon hearing this. Of course, he didn’t believe a single word of this.

"This is the first time I’ve discovered this kind of mutated species. It should have great research value," he murmured. If there were other Foreign Beasts that could also speak, that meant that aside from the fact that Foreign Beasts looked different from humans, they had already caught up to humans in terms of intelligence level. That would be too terrifying.
Thus, capturing the large black dog and dissecting it to figure out the extent that a Foreign Beast’s intelligence had evolved to was extremely important.

"Little Han, this guy wants to challenge Grandpa Dog. Say, do you think Grandpa Dog will light a sky lantern for him, or r@pe him and throw him into the toilet?" the large black dog asked Ling <anno data-annotation-id="057e602b-b8a5-401b-8ea7-dab9383442a4" data-title="Han">Han1</anno>.
What, this despicable dog that was exuding an air of vulgarity actually knew Ling Han?
<annotations style="display: none;">’Lighting someone as a sky lantern’ refers to burn someone’s body hung on a stake, either as execution or post-mortem humiliation.</annotations>

It should have great research value," he murmured.

If there were other Foreign Beasts that could also speak, that meant that aside from the fact that Foreign Beasts looked different from humans, they had already caught up to humans in terms of intelligence level.
That would be too terrifying.
Thus, capturing the large black dog and dissecting it to figure out the extent that a Foreign Beast’s intelligence had evolved to was extremely important.
"Little Han, this guy wants to challenge Grandpa Dog.

Say, do you think Grandpa Dog will light a sky lantern for him, or r@pe him and throw him into the toilet?" the large black dog asked Ling <anno data-annotation-id="057e602b-b8a5-401b-8ea7-dab9383442a4" data-title="Han">Han1</anno>.
What, this despicable dog that was exuding an air of vulgarity actually knew Ling Han?
<annotations style="display: none;">’Lighting someone as a sky lantern’ refers to burn someone’s body hung on a stake, either as execution or post-mortem humiliation.</annotations>

chapters.title: Chapter 4929: Side Story -- City 17
paragraphs: Ling Han shrugged, and said with a smile, "Is there any need to lower yourself to the level of such a minor character?"
A, a minor character?
Everyone had gone mad. Though you are a Level 8 elite, and may even possibly have reached Level 9, Lu Hao was also a Level 9 elite, and not weaker than you, so where did you get such arrogance from?
However, in this place, only Lu Hao could suppress Ling Han, or be his equal. Thus, they naturally had no right to interfere, and could only watch obediently from the sidelines.
Meanwhile, the large black dog chuckled, and said, "Grandpa Dog wants to show off, so I don’t mind who the target it."
"Do as you like, but be mindful of propriety," Ling Han said indifferently.
"All right." The large black dog nodded, and wagged his behind at Lu Hao, "Come on, come on. You can’t bear to see Grandpa Dog, right? Come and beat Grandpa Dog up. If you can, come!"
This kind of vulgarity and lowliness was something that no one could bear to look at directly.
Lu Hao was so furious that he started to laugh. He had really had enough. Whether it was Ling Han or the large black dog, they actually treated him like he was nothing.
Who was he?
A supreme elite of Level 9, one of the few ultimate elites in the world!
’Fine, I’ll capture this despicable dog first, then deal with Ling Han.’
He moved. Boom, he stretched out a palm, and an invisible power actually materialized, turning into a massive palm that grabbed out at the large black dog.
"Look at Grandpa Dog’s trump card, it’s going to blind you!" The large black dog twisted his behind, and a flash of light instantly shot out from his iron underwear, shooting toward Lu Hao.
"Wu!" Even with Lu Hao’s abilities, he could not help but use his hands to shield his eyes, to protect them from being hurt.
Peng!
The large black dog charged forwards, and took advantage of the opening to deliver a kick, which landed between Lu Hao’s legs.
Instantly, Lu Hao’s face became incredibly pale, and his hands involuntarily covered the space between his legs.
Even the great elite of Level 9 couldn’t cultivate that part to the point that it was impervious to weapons, and could withstand heavy blows.
"You!" Lu Hao pointed angrily at the large black dog. It was too despicable, too vulgar, and too shameless.
The large black dog shook his behind, and another blinding light shot over, so Lu Hao could only guard his eyes.
Peng! The result was another kick landed between Lu Hao’s legs.
’F*ck! Can’t you switch to another location?’
Lu Hao was about to collapse. His lower body was such a sensitive and fragile part, and he had actually suffered two consecutive kicks. The pain was bone-piercing.
However, he was also incredibly stunned.

Even though the large black dog had intiially used blinding light to force him to use his hands to block the light, thereby exposing his weakness, in truth, if it was someone else whose abilities were slightly weaker, he would completely be able to react in time, and destroy the other party with a single strike.
However, the large black dog kicked him again and again, almost shattering his balls.
This was a display of incomparable strength.
In other words, this despicable dog’s strength was definitely not inferior to his.
A Level 9 Foreign Beast!
However, you are clearly so strong, so why did you have to resort to such underhanded means?
Just how dark was his mentality!
However, a Level 9 elite was still a supreme elite, after all. Lu Hao forcefully suppressed his pain, and with a loud shout, charged towards the large black dog again.
This time, he was on full alert. He definitely wouldn’t be hit again.
However, with a flash of brilliance from the iron underwear, Lu Hao instantly cried out in pain, his figure falling down.
This was f*cking impossible to block.
Everyone was once again dumbfounded. Under the prerequisite that he was already prepared, Lu Hao had actually still been hit. What was going on here?
Could it be that this iron underwear was a legendary treasure?

Lu Hao also looked at the large black dog in disbelief. At this moment, he was completely unable to determine whether it was the large black dog that was inconceivably strong, or whether it was that iron underwear on him that had this heaven-defying effect.
He didn’t dare to continue the battle. He was one of the few elites of the human race. If he fell here, it would be a great loss to the entire human race.
Thus, he immediately let out a battle cry, leaped over, picked up his son, and ran away madly.
The speed of a Level 9 elite was truly astonishingly fast. In the blink of an eye, he had already left without a trace with Lu Songlai.

"Little Han!" The large black dog swung its hind legs as it charged over. It spread open its arms and grabbed at Ling Han, but just as it was about to place its paws on Ling Han’s shoulder, it suddenly shot out a leg, kicking out at Ling Han’s crotch.
Peng!
A figure suddenly charged out, crashing directly into the large black dog.
"Holy f*ck!" the large black dog howled in agony. His body was instantly sent flying like a meteor.

"Ling Han, you guys are so mean! You didn’t even bring Niu with you when you went out to play! Niu is very angry, and the consequences are very serious!" An incredibly beautiful woman appeared, her hands on her hips, looking very angry.
Everyone watched with gaping mouths, not knowing what kind of expression they should have.
Was the large black dog vulgar? Vulgar! However, was he strong? Strong!
Just look, even a Level 9 elite had been scared off by it, which was proof enough.
However, this beauty had only crashed into the large black dog, and the large black dog had already disappeared without a trace. Just how powerful were her abilities?
Heavens, what was going on with this world? Supreme elites had popped out one after another, yet they had never been heard of before. Furthermore, they were all too young.
"Tsundere girl, you’ve come to snatch Ling Han from Niu again!" Hu Niu stared at the empress, her fighting spirit beginning to rise.
The empress was proud, and couldn’t even be bothered to pay her any regard.
How long had they been fighting for?
They had already passed through a Stacked Era, but neither of them was willing to concede to the other.
"All right, all right," Ling Han said with a smile. He walked over and pulled Hu Niu into his arms.
Hu Niu’s anger instantly turned into delight, and she hugged Ling Han. At the same time, she made a face at the empress and stuck out her tongue.
The empress was still cold and aloof, and did not even cast a second look at this kind of child-like behaviour competing for favour.

"Little Han, you have to discipline your wife. She keeps kicking Grandpa Dog like a ball! Thankfully, Grandpa Dog is wearing iron underwear. Otherwise, I would definitely be crippled by the kicks." The large black dog suddenly ran over again.
Instantly, the empress and Hu Niu both glared at it.
"Er, Grandpa Dog didn’t say anything." The large black dog stood up on its hind legs, drawing circles on the ground with one of its hind legs.
"Come, let’s go back first," Ling Han said.
"Sure, where are we going to play?" Hu Niu immediately asked.
Ling Han smiled, "There is an idiot that has interfered with the evolution of this world. I am waiting for him to appear."
"Then let Niu capture him!" Hu Niu volunteered.
Ling Han shook his head, and said, "No need. I’ll just play around with him. I’m sure that it’s about time for him to appear."

With the current strength of this planet’s Spiritual Qi, at most, it could only nurture out so-called Level 9 elites, and in terms of the cultivation level Ling Han had set out for this universe, that would only be the consummate level, which belonged to the first level of martial arts.
And now, Level Nine had already appeared in this world. Thus, if this mastermind had any ulterior motives, it was almost time for him to appear.
"Okay!" Hu Niu agreed without any principles. In any case, she would be happy as long as Ling Han was by her side.
Everyone returned, and the Demon City team naturally parted ways with them, each returning to their respective bases.
Ling Han and the others returned to Zhou Su City. Only two days had passed, and among the fourteen elites of Level 9 from the Hua Nation, five of them had come together.
This naturally was for Ling Han, the empress and the large black dog. En, there was also Hu Niu.
There were so many mysterious Level 9 elites, and there was even a Foreign Beast that could speak human language. They had to investigate thoroughly.
