chapters.title: Chapter 4930: Side Story -- City 18
paragraphs: The supreme elites of Level 9 had arrived, and there were even as many as five of them!
Thankfully, the ordinary people of Zhou Su City did not know. Otherwise, they would think that the Foreign Beasts were going to riot, and join forces to attack the city.
These five supreme elites were Zhou Leyu, Wang Bowen, Wang Jingsheng, Yan Lan and Lu Hao, respectively. They were either high-ranking officials of the government, or high-ranking military officials.
They had come in secret. After making some arrangements, they sent someone to invite Ling Han, the empress, and the others.
Ling Han didn’t mind. He brought the empress, Hu Niu, and the large black dog to the academy field.

Lu Hao and the others were standing with their hands clasped behind their backs, all of them wearing solemn expressions. Yang Shan, the Peincipal of the Martial Arts Academy, was beside them as well. There were five Level 9 elites, and there was another Level 8 elite. This kind of lineup could be considered terrifying.

"Ling Han, who exactly are you people?" Lu Hao was the first to speak. That day, after he had rushed back to the army, and for the sake of today, he had moved around the various departments, which had also caused a commotion among the higher-ups, which led to the scene of five elites coming together.
Ling Han’s background was too important. Why had he become a Level 8 or even a Level 9 elite at such a young age? Why could a Foreign Beast speak? Why did the two of them actually know each other?
Without clarifying this, it would be a great calamity for humans.
"Also, why can this Foreign Beast speak?"
The large black dog was displeased, and he said, "Hey, hey, hey, don’t you know how to speak properly? This is Grandpa Dog! When you address me, you have to use words of respect!"
Hearing the large black dog speak, Zhou Leyu and the others could not conceal their shock.
As expected, this Foreign Beast actually knew how to speak!
This was too shocking. This was a completely different story.
Lu Hao humphed upon hearing this. He had suffered a loss at the hands of the large black dog, and his b@lls were hurting even now. He was filled with hatred and resentment!
"Ling Han, you’re a human, so we’re giving you a chance to explain!" Zhou Leyu interrupted.

"You need to give us a proper explanation. Otherwise... we will consider you traitors to humanity!" Yan Lan also said. She was the only female among the five supreme elites. Her hair was completely white, yet her aura was intimidating, and she did not look old at all.
Ling Han was just about to speak, yet he suddenly exclaimed in surprise. A smile then spread across his face, and he said, "The person I’ve been waiting for has finally appeared!"
The words had just fallen, when a doorway of light actually appeared out of thin air on the field.
Everyone instantly felt that the space was showing signs of being forcibly warped.
What was going on?

At this moment, a person walked out of the doorway of light. His attire was very retro. He was dressed in brocade, and his hair was draped over his shoulders. It was black and shiny, and every strand of hair seemed to be glowing.
There was an incredibly proud expression on his face. He had one foot on the field, yet it was as if the whole world was crawling beneath his feet.
He was very young, at most in his twenties, but the aura he exuded was not inferior to Zhou Leyu and the others at all.
Behind this person, another figure appeared. He was also incredibly young, but was also astonishingly strong.
What was going on?
Lu Hao and the others all felt their scalps go numb. A doorway of light appeared out of thin air, and multiple people actually walked out from within. What kind of advanced technology was this?
However, if this was technology, then how could the aura exuding from these two people be so terrifying?

Then, a third person appeared, a fourth appeared, a fifth... a total of eleven young people walked out. There were both men and women, but they all had a terrifying aura that could move a Level 9 elite.

"That’s right. This world has already been completely transformed," the first young man said. "Everyone, let’s begin hunting. A month later, the results will be assessed based on the number and quality of the prey."
"Alright!" The other anomalies nodded, one after another.
What!
Lu Hao and the others exchanged looks. Judging by their words, it was actually them who had caused their world to become like this!
However, spending fifty years’ time was actually just for the sake of a hunting competition?
Also, prey?
Were they referring to the Foreign Beasts, or... were they included as well?
"Who are you people?" Wang Bowen asked darkly. These eleven people were definitely all elites of Level 9, and all of them were too young. This meant that there were even more elites behind them.

"Your rulers!" The first young man said, "I am Han Feng, the son of Hundred Feathers Spiritual Master. Long before I was even born, my father had already modified this planet of yours for me. It was all for today, to provide a hunting ground for me, so that I could train."
"All the resources on this planet are mine, and you people... are both my prey and my slaves!"
Hundred Feathers Spiritual Master?
Hiss, the mutation of the world was actually engineered?
Then, just how strong was this Hundred Feathers Spiritual Master, to be able to use such a heaven-defying technique?

Zhou Leyu and the others were all trembling. It was as if they had seen an invisible hand interfering in the operations of this world, and this person was so strong that even they could not fathom his abilities.
How were they supposed to block this?
Could they only be reduced to prey, or slaves?

Han Feng’s eyes swept over them, and when he saw the empress and Hu Niu, his eyes involuntarily lit up. "I really had not thought that I would actually be able to find such beauties on such a backward planet! Haha, this time is really worth it!"
The other youngsters also looked at the empress and Hu Niu with admiration, then showed expressions of pity.
Though their strength was not inferior to Han Feng, their backgrounds were far too inferior. They were completely unqualified to compete.

"Humph, the people of Hua Nation would rather die than be dishonored!" Yan Lan reprimanded, her face filled with fury. She had a strong personality, and was also a female. Thus, when she saw Han Feng and the others actually having designs on the empress and Hu Niu, she was immediately angered.
"Old hag, get lost!" Han Feng said nonchalantly, waving his hand dismissively.

Yan Lan despised evil as if it was her natural enemy. She immediately pounced over, brandishing a crimson walking stick in her hands. This was forged from a high grade alloy, and was both hard and heavy. If one was struck solidly by this walking stick, it was completely capable of beating Han Feng into mush.
"Ignorant!" Han Feng smiled faintly, and with a casual grab, the other end of the walking stick was grasped in his hand.
This!
Lu Hao and the others all broke out in a cold sweat as they watched. They naturally knew Yan Lan’s strength, but it was precisely because they knew that they were afraid.

Could it be that this guy’s hand was also forged from a high level alloy? Furthermore, just how strong was he to be able to easily stretch out his hand and firmly grab onto the walking stick that was rushing towards him?

Han Feng laughed mischievously, and stretched out a hand in a shove. Peng, Yan Lan’s walking stick instantly slipped from her grasp. The head of the walking stick slammed heavily into her chest, causing her expression to change drastically, and she stumbled backwards.
’So powerful!’
They were clearly both at Level 9, but Han Feng’s strength was more than double that of Yan Lan.
Han Feng looked towards the empress and Hu Niu again, and showed an expression of arrogance, "Two beauties, you will follow me in future. How about it?"
Hu Niu giggled, and said, "If you can block a punch from Niu, Niu will consider it!"
If it was another woman saying this, Han Feng would definitely be extremely displeased.
What a joke. It is your fortune that I have taken a fancy to you, and you still want to be picky?
However, hearing these words from the mouth of a beauty like Hu Niu, he felt an itch in his heart.
"All right then," he agreed.
Peng! There was a flash of blood, and Han Feng was instantly torn into pieces, turning into a pool of blood.

Then, just how strong was this Hundred Feathers Spiritual Master, to be able to use such a heaven-defying technique?
Zhou Leyu and the others were all trembling.
It was as if they had seen an invisible hand interfering in the operations of this world, and this person was so strong that even they could not fathom his abilities.
How were they supposed to block this?
Could they only be reduced to prey, or slaves?
Han Feng’s eyes swept over them, and when he saw the empress and Hu Niu, his eyes involuntarily lit up.
"I really had not thought that I would actually be able to find such beauties on such a backward planet!
Haha, this time is really worth it!"
The other youngsters also looked at the empress and Hu Niu with admiration, then showed expressions of pity.
Though their strength was not inferior to Han Feng, their backgrounds were far too inferior.
They were completely unqualified to compete.
"Humph, the people of Hua Nation would rather die than be dishonored!" Yan Lan reprimanded, her face filled with fury.
She had a strong personality, and was also a female.
Thus, when she saw Han Feng and the others actually having designs on the empress and Hu Niu, she was immediately angered.
"Old hag, get lost!" Han Feng said nonchalantly, waving his hand dismissively.
Yan Lan despised evil as if it was her natural enemy.
She immediately pounced over, brandishing a crimson walking stick in her hands.
This was forged from a high grade alloy, and was both hard and heavy.
If one was struck solidly by this walking stick, it was completely capable of beating Han Feng into mush.
"Ignorant!" Han Feng smiled faintly, and with a casual grab, the other end of the walking stick was grasped in his hand.
This!
Lu Hao and the others all broke out in a cold sweat as they watched.
They naturally knew Yan Lan’s strength, but it was precisely because they knew that they were afraid.
Could it be that this guy’s hand was also forged from a high level alloy?
Furthermore, just how strong was he to be able to easily stretch out his hand and firmly grab onto the walking stick that was rushing towards him?
Han Feng laughed mischievously, and stretched out a hand in a shove.
Peng, Yan Lan’s walking stick instantly slipped from her grasp.
The head of the walking stick slammed heavily into her chest, causing her expression to change drastically, and she stumbled backwards.
’So powerful!’
They were clearly both at Level 9, but Han Feng’s strength was more than double that of Yan Lan.
Han Feng looked towards the empress and Hu Niu again, and showed an expression of arrogance, "Two beauties, you will follow me in future.
How about it?"
Hu Niu giggled, and said, "If you can block a punch from Niu, Niu will consider it!"
If it was another woman saying this, Han Feng would definitely be extremely displeased.
What a joke.
It is your fortune that I have taken a fancy to you, and you still want to be picky?
However, hearing these words from the mouth of a beauty like Hu Niu, he felt an itch in his heart.
"All right then," he agreed.
Peng!
There was a flash of blood, and Han Feng was instantly torn into pieces, turning into a pool of blood.

chapters.title: Chapter 4931: Side Story -- City 19
paragraphs: What!
Seeing this scene, Lu Hao and the others were shocked to the point of becoming speechless.
Was Han Feng strong?
Yes!
He had severely wounded Yan Lan with a single strike.
But in front of Hu Niu, he was insta-killed.
This, this, this, what was going on with this world?
They were clearly already standing at the pinnacle of the world, but why had they suddenly become no match for anyone?
However, the faces of Han Feng’s ten companions had all turned green.
"You, you guys have gotten into big trouble!"
"Do you guys know who Han Feng is?"
"He’s the only son of the Hundred Feather Spiritual Master, and he treasures him immensely!"
"And Hundred Feathers Spiritual Master... that is the overlord of this galaxy!"
"After killing Han Feng and Feng, you people won’t be able to live, and won’t get an easy death even if you beg for it!"
These ten people were all trembling in fear. That was because they would also garner the anger of Hundred Feathers Spiritual Master, and would probably be buried with Han Feng as well.
Unreasonable? That’s right, but Hundred Feathers Spiritual Master was just that domineering.
Who asked him to be the overlord of this galaxy?
The entire galaxy was under his rule. Whoever was allowed to live, could live, and whoever was allowed to die, could only die.
Seeing how these ten people looked like they had lost both their parents, Lu Hao and the others were both confused and terrified.
As they saw it, they were already standing at the pinnacle of martial arts, so who could be stronger than them?
However, the ten people on the other side were not the slightest bit weaker than them, but when it came to the Hundred Feathers Spiritual Master, they did not even have the courage to resist.
How could theyaccept this?
The problem was that the fear of these ten people was not faked at all.
Hiss, was there really someone that was strong enough to suppress the galaxy all by himself?
Weng!
Right at this moment, an indescribable pressure enshrouded them, as if the sky was about to collapse, causing everyone to feel a shiver that came from their souls.
In the skies, a human face appeared, its eyes as massive as the sun.
"Lord Hundred Feather!"
Those ten people trembled, and plop, plop, they all knelt down, kowtowing towards the face in the skies.
Lu Hao and the others were also rendered speechless. This was the Hundred Feather Spiritual Master?
Heavens, humans could actually be as strong as this!
No wonder those ten people just now, who were obviously all Level 9 elites, were so terrified that they almost wet their pants.
In front of such a majestic existence, what was Level 9 worth?
Not even enough to be considered trash.
"You actually dare to kill my son!" The face spoke up, his voice booming out, reverberating throughout the entire planet, causing everyone on the planet to feel his fury.
"Everyone, die with my son!"
Boom! A large hand reached over. This hand was even larger than the planet, and it could easily crush this planet into pieces.
All of a sudden, all the living beings felt the arrival of doomsday. The shadow of death enshrouded them, and no one could escape. No one could escape.
This was a crushing power, capable of plucking stars with one hand, and destroying the sun with a single palm.
Lu Hao and the others were all trembling. What use were those as strong as Level 9? In front of such great power, they were completely no different from infants, and could only wait for death.

"Old b@stard, have you gone blind? You actually dare to hit Grandpa Dog!" Right at this moment, the large black dog suddenly raised its behind with a roar. Suddenly, a ray of light shot out, striking towards that human face in the skies.

"Wu!" This light was too bright. Even if the Hundred Feathers Spiritual Master could suppress the galaxy, so what? This was only a Dao Manifestation that he had manifested, but so what? His eyes still hurt from the light, and the palm strike that he had shot out was instantly withdrawn.
’You can do that?’
Lu Hao and the others all looked towards the large black dog. Who would have thought that the destroyer of the human race was a similar human, while the savior was a wretched, lowly large black dog?
"Who are you?" In the galaxy, the Hundred Feather Spiritual Master shouted angrily, "You were the one who killed my son?"
No wonder!

He had given his son a protective talisman, which could ensure his son’s safety. Unless — the person who had made the move was as strong as he was, that the protective talisman would not be able to save his life.

Ling Han shook his head, and stretched out a hand to grab him. Peng, a middle-aged man dressed in a green robe appeared out of thin air. Looking at his appearance, he was actually 70% similar to that massive human face in the skies.
He was Hundred Feathers Spiritual Master, and this was his true self.
How was this possible!
Hundred Feathers Spiritual Master wore a dumbfounded expression. His true self was on the incredibly distant Great Prosperity Planet, so why had he suddenly appeared here?

He had formed the Dao Manifestation, and could instantly reach any place that was covered by his divine sense. However, if his true self wanted to traverse the universe, he would still need some time.
But now, his true self had instantly traversed an endless distance, and appeared here.
Most importantly, he had been captured and brought here at that.
Who was it, who was it? This strength was so strong that even he felt a wave of coldness.
But for Lu Hao and the others, the Hundred Feather Spiritual Master was too strong, too strong. Merely the aura he exuded was enough to make their bodies explode.
Was this an existence that could create a manifestation that was even larger than the sun?
If this kind of elite wanted to kill them, a single thought would be enough, right?
But right at this moment, the Hundred Feather Spiritual Master fell to his knees with a plop, "Lord, Lord!"

He worshipped Ling Han. To be able to bring him from his lair to this place without him noticing, this person’s strength was definitely on the level of Ultimate Elites of the universe. As a Galaxy Overlord, he was not even qualified to compare.
Pu!

Lu Hao and the others spluttered. An existence like the Hundred Feathers Spiritual Master, a great elite that was tens of thousands or hundreds of millions of times stronger than them, actually knelt down on both knees in front of Ling Han, and called out ’Lord’?
Were they seeing things, or was this world too crazy?
Heavens, and they actually wanted to interrogate Ling Han!
All of a sudden, they held their breaths, fearing that if their breathing was a little heavier, they would startle Ling Han.

"This junior was blind, and made a wrong move on Milord. Please forgive me, Milord!" Hundred Feather Spiritual Master said respectfully, "This junior is a disciple of Ultimate Elite Dongwu. Please spare this junior for the sake of Ultimate Elite Dongwu."
What was an ultimate elite?
Strongest in the universe, and below the level of Ultimate Elite, there was Indestructible Galaxy elites, and followed by Galaxy Overlords.
The Hundred Feather Spiritual Master actually had quite a distant rwlationship with Ultimate Elite Dongwu, but now, in order to save his life, he had no choice but to bear this great flag.
Lu Hao and the others were trembling even more violently. Someone as strong as the Hundred Feather Spiritual Master, and there was actually an even stronger existence above him?
Heavens!

Ling Han shook his head and said, "From the beginning of the Stacked Era, I established the rules. No one is allowed to interfere with the cultivation and evolution of planets. You can cultivate to the level of Galaxy Overlord, so you naturally know this."
"Yet you still knowingly acted. You merely wanted to build a training ground for your son, and thus interfered in the evolution of this planet."
"Commit suicide!"

The Hundred Feather Spiritual Master couldn’t help but feel his expression change drastically. The rules that all the powerful races in the universe had to adhere to together was actually drawn up by Ling Han?
How was this possible!
The Regulations of heaven and earth were naturally set by Heavenly Dao. Though you are very strong, are you the Heavenly Dao ?
No, the Heavenly Dao wasn’t a specific existence, so how could it possibly be a person?

"Impossible! Absolutely impossible!" Hundred Feathers Spiritual Master shouted loudly, "Heavenly Dao is high and noble, transcendent above all else, so how could you possibly be Heavenly Dao’s manifestation!"
Ling Han smiled faintly, "Heavenly Dao?"
He stretched out a hand and pressed down. Countless drops of blood condensed, and a person appeared out of thin air.
Han Feng!
Everyone was dumbfounded. Wasn’t he already dead? How had he come back to life?
"Father!" Han Feng hurriedly called out, appearing very surprised. Why had his old man suddenly come?
—His memories were still stuck on before he had been killed by Hu Niu.
However, Ling Han pressed his hand down again. Pa! Han Feng once again transformed into a cloud of blood.
Controlling life and death.
This had surpassed the Ultimate Elite of the universe, and only the Heavenly Dao could do this!

chapters.title: Chapter 4932: Side Story: City 20 (End)
paragraphs: Everyone’s mouths were wide open. Today, they had already been stunned who knew how many times, but they were still stunned by this scene.
They dared to bet with their lives. That scene just now was definitely not an illusion, but rather incredibly real.
But how was this possible?
Was this a reverse of time? Or a reverse of life and death?
Whichever one it was, they had both surpassed imagination. In fact, they had even surpassed cultivation.
The creator of the Regulations of heaven and earth?
They looked dumbly at Ling Han. This man was actually the Creator?
Otherwise, how could he possibly reverse time or life and death!
But compared to the shock of the others, the Hundred Feather Spiritual Master was practically cursing in his heart.
Oh, you have revived my son, proving your supreme ability, but why beat him to death again?
Are you playing around with me?
His only son had died, and he was already in enough pain. Now, he actually had to experience it again.
How could you do that!
However, Ling Han was far too powerful. In fact, he was so powerful that he had even surpassed the Ultimate ELites of the universe. Thus, what could he do no matter how displeased or furious he was?

He shivered even more. Ling Han had already proven that he had surpassed the Ultimate Elites of the universe. Even if Ultimate Elite Dongwu came personally, he would probably still have to pay his respects to Ling Han. In fact, Ling Han didn’t even need to move, as the Ultimate Elite Dongwu would kill himself first.
"Grandpa Dog knows how to do it too!" The large black dog loved to show off and strut around, so how could it be willing to be quiet at this moment? It immediately stretched out a paw.
Instantly, it was as if time had turned around, and blood and flesh reformed, turning into a person.
Han Feng.
"Father, why are you—"
Pa! He hadn’t even finished speaking, when he saw the large black dog’s paw descend once more. Han Feng exploded once more, turning into a shower of blood.
This!
He had already died three times.
If he was to be judged as the most tragic person in history, Han Feng would definitely be on the list — dying three times in a row in a single day was probably enough to break any record.
Everyone was once again dumbfounded.
This kind of ability that surpassed the mortal world was something that even a dog could learn?
This was a dog!

Furthermore, this dog was really too vulgar. He was even wearing a pair of iron underwear, which was completely capable of blinding one! Such a vulgar existence actually also possessed the ability of Heavenly Dao?
This, this, this, how could anyone believe this?
And Hundred Feathers Spiritual Master was really about to go mad.
His son had died twice over again!
F***, just how much enmity was there between them? Why did he have to kill his son again?
If you guys want to show off your strength, wouldn’t it be enough to revive others? Han Feng had only stepped onto the first level of cultivation, so what could killing him prove?
"Niu knows how to too!" Hu Niu said.
She loved to play, so she was instantly delighted upon seeing this.
She stretched out a hand. Xiu, the rain of blood that had fallen immediately gathered again, and then condensed into a human figure.
En, it was still Han Feng.
"Father, why have you come?" Han Feng asked curiously. Wasn’t it just hunting on a primitive planet? He had a protective talisman on him, and no one on this planet could hurt him at all.
Thus, why had his father come?
No one could bear to look at him.
Though this guy should be punished for his misdeeds, he had already died three times, and no one was willing to watch him die a fourth time.
How unlucky.
"No!" Hundred Feathers Spiritual Master shouted loudly.
Han Feng was even more confused. Why did his father look like he was about to die of anxiety?
He was a Galaxy Overlord, and the entire galaxy was under his control. What could not be resolved?
"Hehe." Hu Niu giggled, and pressed down with her hand again. Pa! Han Feng died for the fourth time, which was also the second time in her hands.
He was definitely the most unlucky guy in history.
Everyone shook their heads. He had died four times. In future, there should be no one that could break this record.
"Tsundere girl, do you want to play?" Hu Niu looked towards the empress.

Among the four of them, three of them had already displayed the terrifying ability to reverse life and death or time. Though the empress had not moved yet, everyone was sure that since the four of them could stand side by side, the empress definitely had this kind of ability as well.
The empress scoffed. She was such a proud person, so how could she possibly do something so childish?
Seeing that she did not make a move, Hundred Feathers Spiritual Masterbreathed a sigh of relief.
"Big dog, then let’s compete." Hu Niu’s interest was piqued, "After I revive, you come and kill him, and we’ll see if you can do it. Then, we’ll switch."
"Sure!" The large black dog’s interest was also piqued.
Hu Niu stretched out her hand again, and Han Feng was revived for the fourth time.
"Father—"
When he said this, his expression changed drastically, because the large black dog had already stretched out a paw and was pressing down on him.
In an instant, this dog’s paw turned into the size of the sun, indescribably terrifying.
"Sh*tty dog, you’re so evil!" Hu Niu said coquettishly. She hurriedly raised her hand, and xiu, Han Feng was sent flying, directly turning into a star.
Under the intense friction, hong, Han Feng instantly combusted, instantly turning into ash.
"You’ve lost!" the large black dog said smugly.

Hu Niu’s eyes darted around, and she said, "According to the rules of the competition, it’s your victory if you kill him. However, Niu was the one who killed him, so this can only be considered a draw. Again!"
"Little Han, your wife is still as shameless as she used to be," the large black dog said to Ling Han, his expression speechless.
"Enough! Enough!" Hundred Feathers Spiritual Master was extraordinarily furious. He roared loudly, "I will fight you all to the death, and this whole world shall be buried with me!"
Boom, a terrifying energy suddenly exploded from his body.
He was going to self-destruct and destroy the entire planet.
What!

Lu Hao and the others instantly felt a chill run down their spines. They could sense how terrifying this energy was. It was countless times more powerful than the largest nuclear bomb in existence. It was completely capable of instantly destroying the planet they were on.
They were done for. They were still going to die.
This was the gap in strength. If elites wanted you dead, you wouldn’t even be qualified to resist.

Ling Han smiled, and pressed out his right hand. Boom, the Hundred Feather Spiritual Master’s explosion was confined to a three-dimensional space of less than two meters. Endless seals lit up, shining brilliantly.
After a while, everything returned to calm.
"Want to play again?" the large black dog asked Ling Han.
Ling Han shook his head, "Forget it. There’s no need for that."
"G-greetings, Lord!" Lu Hao and the others immediately knelt on the ground. The person in front of them was even more powerful than gods, and was unfathomably powerful.
Ling Han pondered for a moment, before saying, "Since the Spiritual Qi of this planet has already awakened, I’ll leave it at that. Yang Qi is my friend, so please take care of him."
"Yes, yes!" Lu Hao and the others all nodded, incredibly respectful.
Merely the word "friend" meant that they would spare no resources to nurture Yang Qi.
Xiu, a figure appeared out of thin air. It was a slender young man, his aura astonishingly strong.
"Great Ancestor!" This man bowed towards Ling Han, then bowed towards Hu Niu and the empress. "Greetings, great-grandmothers!" Then, he bowed towards the large black dog, "Greetings, Grandpa Dog."
Ling Han nodded. This was his great-grandson, and also one of the more outstanding descendants. His name was Shi Taigen.
"What is it?" he asked.

"In reply to Great Ancestor, a drastic change has taken place in the Netherworld. It is suspected that something big has happened. Great Ancestor, please go and take charge of the overall situation," Shi Taigen said.
Ling Han made a prediction, and couldn’t help but smile.
"What is it?" the empress asked.
"The Son of Destiny of the Netherworld is called Shi Hao," Ling Han said. "He’s a very interesting guy."
(—Finished—)
